def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant helium blimp
    SUBSTANCE: helium gas
    CAUSE: Data pumps helium with a bellows into the blimp's nose cell until it swells full
    The whole blimp holds the reserves of the four nations in the data, one
    gas cell per country, each cut at its true share of the envelope. Qatar's
    cell is the nose. It starts sagging, and with three strokes of the bellows
    it swells to full size inside the dashed outline of its full shape. Once
    it is full, its share is printed on the cell. The blimp bobs on its mooring
    mast in front of its hangar, and a helium tube trailer drives past the
    camera."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    lq, vq = rows[0]
    share = vq / tot

    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.55
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    infl = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + ease(seg(f, 0.35, 0.8))) / n

    gtop = landscape(cr, t, "desert")

    # the airship hangar far behind, under haze
    building(cr, 620, 1010, 1170, 170, (176, 168, 156), roof_rgb=(120, 124, 132),
             roof="gable", boards=False)
    haze(cr, 900, 1180, (236, 214, 184), a=0.45)

    CX, CY, RX, RY = 590, 1000, 460, 235
    CYb = CY + 12 * math.sin(t * 1.3)
    cut = CX - RX + 2 * RX * share

    def half_h(x, ry):
        d = clamp((x - CX) / RX, -1.0, 1.0)
        return ry * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - d * d)) * (1 - 0.28 * max(0.0, d) ** 1.5)

    def env(ry):
        N = 72
        for i in range(N + 1):
            x = CX - RX + 2 * RX * i / N
            y = CYb - half_h(x, ry)
            if i == 0:
                cr.move_to(x, y)
            else:
                cr.line_to(x, y)
        for i in range(N, -1, -1):
            x = CX - RX + 2 * RX * i / N
            cr.line_to(x, CYb + half_h(x, ry))
        cr.close_path()

    # the blimp's long shadow on the sand, the mooring mast
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - RX + 80, CX + RX - 80, 1452, length=260, a=0.22)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX + 40, 1458, 780, a=0.3)
    MX = 64
    contact_shadow(cr, MX, 1456, 110, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, MX - 22, 1452, 44, 1452 - CY + 10, (150, 156, 166), finish="metal")
    for yy in range(int(CY + 60), 1440, 70):           # mast ladder rungs
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 82)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(MX - 30, yy)
        cr.line_to(MX + 30, yy)
        cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, MX, CY - 4, 20, (120, 126, 136), finish="metal")

    # tail fins, behind the envelope
    for sgn in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(880, CYb + sgn * 90)
        cr.line_to(1030, CYb + sgn * 250)
        cr.line_to(1068, CYb + sgn * 230)
        cr.line_to(1050, CYb + sgn * 30)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (176, 60, 48))

    # gondola with its windows, hung under the middle
    gy = CYb + RY + 70
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 62, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for sx in (CX - 100, CX + 80):
        cr.move_to(sx, CYb + RY - 12)
        cr.line_to(sx + 10, gy - 66)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(CX - 140, gy - 70)
    cr.line_to(CX + 130, gy - 70)
    cr.curve_to(CX + 165, gy - 60, CX + 160, gy - 10, CX + 120, gy)
    cr.line_to(CX - 120, gy)
    cr.curve_to(CX - 150, gy - 10, CX - 160, gy - 60, CX - 140, gy - 70)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (226, 228, 232), finish="gloss")
    for i in range(6):
        cr.rectangle(CX - 115 + i * 40, gy - 56, 26, 26)
        solid(cr, (70, 110, 150), finish="glass", rim=False)

    # the rest of the envelope: the other three nations' cells, full
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(cut, 0, W, H)
    cr.clip()
    env(RY)
    solid(cr, (214, 218, 226), finish="gloss")
    cr.restore()

    # Qatar's cell, the nose, swelling with every stroke of the bellows
    ryq = RY * (0.3 + 0.7 * infl)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, cut, H)
    cr.clip()
    env(ryq)
    solid(cr, P["accent2"], finish="gloss")
    cr.restore()

    # the envelope's fabric gores, running nose to tail
    cr.save()
    env(RY)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 66, 80), 0.28))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for g in (-0.66, -0.33, 0.33, 0.66):
        for i in range(61):
            x = CX - RX + 2 * RX * i / 60
            ry = ryq if x < cut else RY
            y = CYb + g * half_h(x, ry)
            if i == 0:
                cr.move_to(x, y)
            else:
                cr.line_to(x, y)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # seams between the gas cells, at the true proportions
    cuts = [cut]
    c = cut
    for _, v in rows[1:-1]:
        c += 2 * RX * v / tot
        cuts.append(c)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 42, 50)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for x in cuts:
        hh = half_h(x, RY)
        cr.move_to(x, CYb - hh)
        cr.line_to(x, CYb + hh)
    cr.stroke()
    if infl < 0.999:
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(0, 0, cut, H)
        cr.clip()
        env(RY)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        cr.restore()

    # country names on their cells
    def short(lab):
        ws = lab.split()
        return (".".join(w[0] for w in ws) + ".").upper() if len(ws) > 1 else lab.upper()

    bounds = [CX - RX] + cuts + [CX + RX]
    for i, (lab, _) in enumerate(rows):
        if i == 0:
            continue
        mx = (bounds[i] + bounds[i + 1]) / 2
        s_ = short(lab)
        text(cr, s_, mx, CYb + 14, fit_size(cr, s_, 38, bounds[i + 1] - bounds[i] - 30),
             look.INK, anchor="center", shadow=False)
    qx = (CX - RX + cut) / 2 + 26
    text(cr, lq.upper(), qx, CYb - 58 * infl, 40, look.INK, anchor="center",
         alpha=ease(seg(infl, 0.4, 0.9)), shadow=False)
    done_a = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04))
    if done_a > 0:
        text(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%", qx, CYb + 66, 104, look.INK,
             face="display", anchor="center", alpha=done_a)

    # tether from the mast to the nose
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 50, 56)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(MX, CY - 4)
    cr.line_to(CX - RX + 2, CYb)
    cr.stroke()

    # Data walks to the nose, then pumps helium up the hose into it
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08))
    dx = 820 - 520 * walk_in
    fy = 1452
    nx = CX - RX + 120
    ny = CYb + half_h(nx, ryq)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 36, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(dx + 60, fy - 70)
    cr.curve_to(dx + 150, fy - 150, nx - 30, ny + 150, nx, ny - 4)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, nx, ny - 2, 9, (90, 94, 102), finish="metal")

    # a helium tube trailer passes right by the camera
    tx = W + 120 - ((t * 220) % (W + 820))
    ty = 1780
    contact_shadow(cr, tx + 280, ty + 4, 600, a=0.38)
    cr.rectangle(tx + 150, ty - 52, 420, 22)
    solid(cr, (60, 62, 70))
    for j in range(3):
        y0 = ty - 96 - j * 44
        cr.move_to(tx + 175, y0)
        cr.line_to(tx + 545, y0)
        cr.curve_to(tx + 565, y0, tx + 565, y0 + 40, tx + 545, y0 + 40)
        cr.line_to(tx + 175, y0 + 40)
        cr.curve_to(tx + 155, y0 + 40, tx + 155, y0, tx + 175, y0)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (206, 212, 220), finish="metal")
    # a painted band round the tubes in place of lettering (no text in the caption band)
    for bx in (tx + 250, tx + 470):
        cr.rectangle(bx, ty - 186, 22, 130)
        solid(cr, (190, 52, 42), rim=False)
    box(cr, tx, ty - 20, 140, 130, (190, 52, 42), depth=40, finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(tx + 14, ty - 140, 70, 46)
    solid(cr, (80, 120, 160), finish="glass", rim=False)
    for wx in (tx + 60, tx + 230, tx + 300, tx + 500):
        disc(cr, wx, ty - 14, 26, (40, 40, 44))
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", dx, fy, 230)
    else:
        beat = k if u < a1 else n + int((u - a1) / 0.14)
        host("pump", dx, fy, 230, beat=beat)

    fit_readout(cr, f"{vq:g}B m³", f"helium reserves · {lq}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _gas_bottle(cr, cx, cy, r, a=1.0):
    # a helium cylinder lying in the rack, its valve end to the camera and its
    # long steel body running back into the picture; the brown shoulder band
    # is helium's colour code, so no lettering is needed on it
    dx, dy = 0.95 * r, -0.55 * r
    L = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    nx, ny = dx / L, dy / L
    px, py = -ny, nx
    ang = math.atan2(py, px)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(cx + r * px, cy + r * py)
    cr.line_to(cx + dx + r * px, cy + dy + r * py)
    cr.arc_negative(cx + dx, cy + dy, r, ang, ang - math.pi)
    cr.line_to(cx - r * px, cy - r * py)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (118, 124, 136), finish="metal", a=a)
    disc(cr, cx, cy, r, (178, 184, 194), finish="metal", a=a)
    disc(cr, cx, cy, r * 0.68, (152, 98, 56), finish="gloss", a=a)
    disc(cr, cx, cy, r * 0.36, (92, 96, 106), finish="metal", a=a)
    cr.rectangle(cx - r * 0.12, cy - r * 0.5, r * 0.24, r * 0.3)
    solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal", a=a)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a rack of helium gas cylinders
    SUBSTANCE: steel helium cylinders
    CAUSE: Data places the next cylinder into the rack from a rising lift, one per step of demand
    Helium demand at a chip fab, as the cylinders it eats: the 2024 rack
    holds six; Data rides a scissor lift up the rack and places cylinder
    after cylinder until it holds the 2035 projection. The 2024 load stays
    as a dashed ghost with its top marked, so the rack reads at a glance as
    nearly twice as full."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    n0 = 6
    nN = max(n0 + 1, int(round(n0 * ratio)))
    m = nN - n0
    cols = 3
    nrows = max(4, (nN + cols - 1) // cols)
    BASE = 1440
    rowh = min(165.0, 660.0 / nrows)
    r = rowh * 0.46
    RX0 = 300
    slot = r * 2.15
    RX1 = RX0 + cols * slot + 24

    def shelf_top(R):
        return BASE - 14 - R * rowh

    def slot_xy(i):
        R, c = i // cols, i % cols
        return RX0 + 12 + slot * (c + 0.5), shelf_top(R) - r - 2

    a0, a1 = 0.1, 0.88
    span = (a1 - a0) / m
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, m - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    idx = n0 + k
    if u < a0:
        placed = n0
    else:
        placed = n0 + k + (1 if f >= 0.8 else 0)
    flying = u >= a0 and f < 0.8

    # the lift: up from the ground to the first new row, then a row at a time
    first_row = n0 // cols
    if u < a0:
        py = 1400 + (shelf_top(first_row) - 1400) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
    else:

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a heap of gold coins beside one helium tank
    SUBSTANCE: gold coins
    CAUSE: Data shovels gold coins onto the heap, one scoop at a time, until it is four times its 2011 size
    The price of ONE helium cylinder, paid in gold. The heap beside the tank is
    what that cylinder cost in 2011 (index 100). Scoop by scoop, Data piles on
    coins until the heap is what the same tank costs in 2013. The 2011 heap
    stays as a dashed ghost with its year marked, and 1x..4x ticks up the side
    measure the new price against the old one: four times as much."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    n = 6
    a0, a1 = 0.1, 0.9

    moving, and Data keeps digging: more loads keep rolling off the top."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0

    for j in range(3):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant plastic bottle
    SUBSTANCE: crushed plastic bottles
    CAUSE: Data pours bucketfuls of plastic into the bottle and it fills fate by fate
    One whole, split at its true proportions: everything thrown away fills
    ONE giant clear soda bottle, bucket by bucket, in layers stacked from
    the biggest fate at the bottom to the smallest at the top. It reads as
    a bottle by its own tells: a tall slim body with a grip waist, the long
    shoulder narrowing to a neck ring and a small screw cap, and the
    petaloid feet it stands on. The landfill half fills the bottom,
    mismanaged and burned stack above it, and the thin recycled share — in
    the accent — is the sliver under the shoulder. Data pours from a stack
    of baled plastic beside it. Done by 0.56, then held while a bottle keeps
    rolling through the yard."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    n = len(rows)
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.14, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)

    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.8))

    BOT = BASE - 12
    SH = TOP + 320
    FH = BOT - SH
    MOUTH = TOP + 50
    LAYER = [(132, 120, 102), (104, 106, 114), (78, 72, 70), (150, 152, 158)]
    ACC = P["accent2"]

    def col(i):
        return ACC if i == n - 1 else LAYER[i % len(LAYER)]

    # the setting: a town's edge, the yard where the waste is collected
    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    # the stack of baled plastic Data pours from, and the ladder up it
    BX, BW, BH = 120, 230, 160
    contact_shadow(cr, BX + BW / 2, 1444, BW + 70, a=0.45)
    cast_shadow(cr, BX, BX + BW, 1440, length=260, a=0.25)
    for i in range(4):
        _bale(cr, BX + (6 if i % 2 else 0), 1440 - BH * i, BW, BH, i)
    btop = 1440 - 4 * BH
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 82)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    for lx in (72, 118):
        cr.move_to(lx, 1446)
        cr.line_to(lx + 18, btop - 10)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for r in range(10):
        y = 1420 - r * 64
        d = 18 * (1440 - y) / (1440 - btop)
        cr.move_to(72 + d, y)
        cr.line_to(118 + d, y)
    cr.stroke()

    # the bottle: shadow, the far side of the clear plastic
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - HW, CX + HW, BASE, length=360, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2 * HW + 40, a=0.45)
    _bottle_path(cr, CX, BASE, TOP, HW, NW)
    solid(cr, (206, 226, 238), a=0.45, edge=False)

    # the layers inside, each the true share of the whole
    cum = 0.0
    tops = []
    cr.save()
    _bottle_path(cr, CX, BASE, TOP, HW, NW)
    cr.clip()
    for i, (lab, v) in enumerate(rows):
        amt = 1.0 if (started and i < k) else (grow if (started and i == k) else 0.0)
        lo, hi = cum, cum + v * amt
        y_lo = BOT - FH * lo / tot
        y_hi = BOT - FH * hi / tot
        y_full = BOT - FH * (cum + v) / tot
        tops.append(((y_lo + y_full) / 2, amt, y_lo - y_full))
        cum += v
        if amt <= 0:
            continue
        c = col(i)
        y_bot = BASE + 4 if i == 0 else y_lo
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(CX - HW - 10, y_hi, 2 * HW + 20, y_bot - y_hi)
        cr.clip()
        cr.rectangle(CX - HW - 10, y_hi, 2 * HW + 20, y_bot - y_hi)
        solid(cr, c, rim=False)
        m = int(16 + 110 * v / tot)
        for j in range(m):
            bx = CX - HW + 22 + ((j * 0.6180339 + i * 0.3) % 1.0) * (2 * HW - 44)
            by = y_lo - 8 - ((j * 0.4142136) % 1.0) * max(4.0, y_lo - y_hi - 10)
            bc = c if i == n - 1 else _mix(PLASTIC[(j + i) % len(PLASTIC)], c, 0.55)
            bottle(cr, bx, by, j * 1.7 + i, 1.0 + 0.5 * ((j * 0.29) % 1.0), bc)
        cr.restore()
        # a clean seam where one fate meets the next
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 242, 246), 0.7))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(CX - HW, y_hi)
        cr.line_to(CX + HW, y_hi)
        cr.stroke()
    # the bucketful falling down the neck onto the level
    if started and 0 < fly < 1 and u < a1 + 0.02:
        lvl = BOT - FH * sum(v for _, v in rows[:k]) / tot
        for j in range(5):
            p = clamp(fly * 1.4 - j * 0.1)

    # the arc from his bucket into the mouth

        for j in range(5):
            p = clamp(fly * 1.4 - j * 0.1)

    _bottle_path(cr, CX, BASE, TOP, HW, NW)
    solid(cr, (232, 242, 250), finish="glass", a=0.22)
    ym = (SH + BASE) / 2
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 252, 255), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for ry in (ym - 30, ym, ym + 30):            # the grip rings at the waist
        cr.move_to(CX - HW + 26, ry)
        cr.curve_to(CX - 70, ry + 20, CX + 70, ry + 20, CX + HW - 26, ry)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(16)
    cr.move_to(CX + HW - 46, SH + 30)
    cr.line_to(CX + HW - 46, ym - 70)
    cr.move_to(CX + HW - 46, ym + 70)
    cr.line_to(CX + HW - 46, BASE - 90)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(10)                       # light down the shoulder
    cr.move_to(CX + NW - 14, TOP + 120)
    cr.curve_to(CX + NW - 10, TOP + 200, CX + HW - 70, TOP + 240, CX + HW - 46, SH)
    cr.stroke()
    # the neck ring, then the small ribbed screw cap
    cr.rectangle(CX - NW - 18, TOP + 66, 2 * (NW + 18), 14)
    solid(cr, (214, 230, 240), finish="glass")
    box(cr, CX - NW - 6, MOUTH, 2 * (NW + 6), 52, (52, 150, 84), depth=14,
        finish="gloss")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 90, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for gx in range(int(CX - NW + 4), int(CX + NW + 6), 13):
        cr.move_to(gx, MOUTH - 6)
        cr.line_to(gx, MOUTH - 46)
    cr.stroke()

    # each landed share named ON its own layer, inside the bottle
    for i, (lab, v) in enumerate(rows):
        lm, amt, hgt = tops[i]
        a = ease(seg(amt, 0.9, 1.0)) if started else 0.0
        if a <= 0:
            continue
        name = lab.split("/")[0].strip().lower()
        s = f"{int(round(100 * v / tot))}% {name}"
        size = min(40, max(28, hgt * 0.55))
        text(cr, s, CX, lm + size * 0.36, size, (248, 249, 252), face="bold",
             anchor="center", alpha=a)

    # right by the camera: bin bags, and a bottle rolling through the yard
    _bin_bag(cr, 110, 1760, 1.5)
    _bin_bag(cr, 980, 1800, 1.3, (52, 60, 54))
    for j in range(3):
        bottle(cr, 330 + j * 170, 1700 + (j % 2) * 90, j * 1.1 + 0.4, 3.2,
               PLASTIC[(j * 2) % len(PLASTIC)])
    rx = -220 + ((t * 170) % 1500)
    bottle(cr, rx, 1600, t * 2.6, 4.2, PLASTIC[1 % len(PLASTIC)])
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: climbs the ladder, pours bucket after bucket, holds up the last
    stand_x, stand_y = 255, btop
    if u < a0:
        p = ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
        cp = clamp(p / 0.85)
        hx = 95 + 18 * cp + (stand_x - 113) * seg(p, 0.85, 1.0)
        hy = 1440 - (1440 - stand_y) * cp
        host("climb", hx, hy, 230)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("pour", stand_x, stand_y, 230, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("hold_up", stand_x, stand_y, 230)
    else:
        host("shock", stand_x, stand_y, 230)

    # readout: the title, then the landfill half, then the recycled sliver
    first_done = started and (k > 0 or grow >= 0.999)
    last_done = started and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if last_done:
        lab, v = rows[-1]
        fit_readout(cr, f"Only {int(round(100 * v / tot))}%",
                    f"of plastic is {lab.lower()}", 80, 500, size=140, rgb=ACC)
    elif first_done:
        lab, v = rows[0]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(100 * v / tot))}%",
                    f"of plastic is {lab.lower()}", 80, 500, size=140)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Where it goes", "all the plastic we throw away", 80, 500,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=120)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a tower of recycled plastic bales
    SUBSTANCE: crushed plastic bottle bales
    CAUSE: Data places each new bale on top of the stack and the recycled tower rises
    Each bale is one percent of all the plastic thrown away. In 2019 the
    recycled tower is a short stack. Bale by bale, Data stacks it up to the
    2060 best case and it nearly doubles. The 2019 stack stays on the tower
    as a dashed ghost with its top marked. Behind it the landfill mountain
    of everything else still towers over it, even at its tallest. The tower
    is done by 0.56 and then holds. The conveyor keeps bringing bottles in,
    and Data holds up the next bale."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    n0 = max(1, int(round(v0)))
    N = max(n0, int(round(v1)))
    added = N - n0
    n_acts = 4 if added >= 4 else max(1, added)
    per = -(-added // n_acts) if added else 0

    cols = 3
    rows_max = -(-N // cols)
    BW = 200.0
    BH = min(110.0, 590.0 / rows_max)
    SX, BASE = 230.0, 1440.0

    def bale_xy(i):
        jx = ((i * 37) % 13) - 6          # bales are stacked by hand, not printed
        return SX + (i % cols) * BW + jx, BASE - (i // cols) * BH

    def spot(j):
        x, y = bale_xy(max(0, j - 1))
        return x + BW * 0.5, y - BH - 6

    def draw_bale(x, y, i, a=1.0):
        box(cr, x, y, BW - 6, BH, (84, 108, 124), depth=40, a=a)
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(x + 3, y - BH + 3, BW - 12, BH - 6)
        cr.clip()
        for j in range(16):
            bx = x + 8 + ((j * 0.618 + i * 0.37) % 1.0) * (BW - 20)
            by = y - BH + 8 + ((j * 0.414 + i * 0.29) % 1.0) * (BH - 14)
            bottle(cr, bx, by, j * 1.3 + i, 1.35, PLASTIC[(i + j) % len(PLASTIC)], a=a)
        cr.restore()
        # the baling wire, dark steel round the crushed block
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 36, 40), a))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        for sx in (x + BW * 0.27, x + BW * 0.70):
            cr.move_to(sx, y - BH + 1)
            cr.line_to(sx, y - 1)
            cr.line_to(sx + 26, y - 1 - 18)
        cr.stroke()

    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n_acts
    if u < a0:
        k, f = -1, 0.0
    else:
        k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n_acts - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    drop = seg(f, 0.35, 0.6)
    start_k = n0 + per * max(0, k)
    end_k = min(N, start_k + per)
    if u < a0:
        full, falling = n0, []
    elif drop >= 1:
        full, falling = end_k, []
    else:
        full = start_k
        falling = list(range(start_k, end_k)) if drop > 0 else []
    done = u >= a0 and k == n_acts - 1 and drop >= 1

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    # far back: the landfill mountain of everything that is NOT recycled —
    # it stands taller than the tower will ever get
    LCX, LB, LH, LHW = 700, 1270, 600, 620
    cast_shadow(cr, LCX - LHW, LCX + LHW, LB, length=200, a=0.2)
    heap_path(cr, LCX, LB, LH, LHW)
    solid(cr, (112, 104, 94))
    cr.save()
    heap_path(cr, LCX, LB, LH, LHW)
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(170):
        px = LCX + LHW * (((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) * 1.9 - 0.95)
        top_y = heap_top(LCX, LB, LH, LHW, px)
        py = LB - (LB - top_y) * ((i * 0.4142136) % 1.0) * 0.96 - 4
        bottle(cr, px, py, i * 1.7, 1.0, PLASTIC[i % len(PLASTIC)])
    cr.restore()
    heap_path(cr, LCX, LB, LH, LHW)
    edge(cr, (40, 36, 32))
    haze(cr, 640, 1280, (214, 210, 204), a=0.4)

    # the yard the bales stand in: packed gravel
    cr.move_to(0, 1380)
    cr.curve_to(300, 1360, 800, 1360, W, 1385)
    cr.line_to(W, 1520)
    cr.line_to(0, 1520)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 138, 120), edge=False, rim=False)

    # the recycled tower
    cast_shadow(cr, SX, SX + cols * BW + 40, BASE, length=340, a=0.34)
    contact_shadow(cr, SX + cols * BW / 2 + 20, BASE + 4, cols * BW + 80, a=0.45)
    for i in range(full):
        x, y = bale_xy(i)
        draw_bale(x, y, i)
    for i in falling:
        x, y = bale_xy(i)
        draw_bale(x, y - 140 + 140 * drop * drop, i, a=clamp(drop * 4))

    # THE SCALE on the tower: 2019's stack as a ghost, its top marked
    if full > n0:
        gy = BASE - (-(-n0 // cols)) * BH
        cr.rectangle(SX - 6, gy, cols * BW + 6, BASE - gy)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, SX - 30, SX + cols * BW + 60, gy, l0)

def _lw(hx, hy, ang, lx, ly):
    c, s = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    return hx + lx * c - ly * s, hy + lx * s + ly * c


def _arrows(cr, cx, cy, r, rgb):
    vs = [(cx + r * math.cos(-math.pi / 2 + j * 2 * math.pi / 3),
           cy + r * math.sin(-math.pi / 2 + j * 2 * math.pi / 3)) for j in range(3)]
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    for j in range(3):
        (x0, y0), (x1, y1) = vs[j], vs[(j + 1) % 3]
        sx, sy = x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.18, y0 + (y1 - y0) * 0.18
        ex, ey = x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.78, y0 + (y1 - y0) * 0.78
        cr.move_to(sx, sy)
        cr.line_to(ex, ey)
        cr.stroke()
        a = math.atan2(ey - sy, ex - sx)
        cr.move_to(ex + 14 * math.cos(a), ey + 14 * math.sin(a))
        cr.line_to(ex + 14 * math.cos(a + 2.4), ey + 14 * math.sin(a + 2.4))
        cr.line_to(ex + 14 * math.cos(a - 2.4), ey + 14 * math.sin(a - 2.4))
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()

stories.hook: 99 percent of the bananas you've eaten are identical clones.

stories.question: Ever eaten a non-Cavendish banana? Tell me.
stories.caption: 99% of bananas sold internationally are one single clone: the Cavendish. Over 1,000 other varieties exist, but almost none are exported. The last time one variety dominated like this — the Gros Michel — a fungus wiped it out. That fungus is spreading again. 👇

segments.say: 99 percent of internationally sold bananas are one variety, the Cavendish, grown from identical cuttings.

stories.title: Space Doesn't Just Float You. It Hollows You.

stories.question: Would you handle a Mars mission knowing the cost? Comment below.
stories.caption: Astronauts lose 1.5% of their bone density every single month in zero gravity — faster than a severe osteoporosis patient loses in a whole year. It's why NASA has them exercising 2.5 hours a day, and why a Mars mission might be the scariest part of getting there. Would you handle a Mars mission knowing the cost? 👇

stories.title: Everest Isn't the Highest Point on Earth

Highest, tallest and farthest are three different questions. Which one counts? 👇

stories.title: Every GPS Satellite Is Set to the Wrong Time on Purpose
stories.hook: Your GPS slides 10 kilometers off in one day, uncorrected.
stories.closing: Einstein's homework, running in your pocket, every day.
stories.question: Your phone runs on relativity. Surprised?
stories.caption: A GPS satellite clock gains 38 microseconds a day on yours - weaker gravity speeds it up 45, orbital speed drags 7 back. Ignore that and your position slides about 10 kilometers off in a single day, so every satellite is launched running deliberately slow. That correction is why your blue dot lands within 4.9 meters. Did you know your phone runs on relativity? 👇

segments.say: Weak gravity speeds satellite clocks 45 microseconds a day, and speed claws back 7, netting 38.

scene.concept: 45 real microsecond-cells light up one at a time under the satellite as gravity pulls its clock ahead, then orbital speed strikes out the last 7 - the 38 that survive ARE the net gain, counted, not asserted.
scene.code:
sat = subject_image('satellite orbiting earth')
grav = values[0]
net = values[1]
speed = values[2]
cols = 9
total = int(round(grav))
rows = math.ceil(total / cols)

gy0 = RTOP + 430

text('each cell = 1 microsecond / day', (RX0 + RX1) // 2, RTOP + 20, size=32, color=SUBTLE, center=True)
fill_phase = clamp(reveal / 0.5)
strike_phase = clamp((reveal - 0.5) / 0.35)
filled = int(round(total * fill_phase))
struck = int(round(speed * strike_phase))
cut_from = max(total - int(round(speed)), 0)
for i in range(total):
    r = i // cols
    c = i % cols
    x = gx0 + c * cell
    y = gy0 + r * cell
    on = i < filled
    removed = on and i >= cut_from and (i - cut_from) < struck
    if removed:
        d.rounded_rectangle([x + 3, y + 3, x + cell - 3, y + cell - 3], radius=8, fill=rgba(WARN, 90))
        d.line([x + 6, y + 6, x + cell - 6, y + cell - 6], fill=rgba(WARN, 235), width=4)
        d.line([x + cell - 6, y + 6, x + 6, y + cell - 6], fill=rgba(WARN, 235), width=4)
    elif on:
        d.rounded_rectangle([x + 3, y + 3, x + cell - 3, y + cell - 3], radius=8, fill=rgba(HIGHLIGHT, 225))
    else:
        d.rounded_rectangle([x + 3, y + 3, x + cell - 3, y + cell - 3], radius=8, outline=rgba(REST, 110), width=2)
kept = min(filled, cut_from) + max(0, min(filled, total) - cut_from - struck)
text(fmt(grav) + ' gravity', gx0, gy0 - 70, size=30, color=HIGHLIGHT)
text('-' + fmt(speed) + ' speed', gx0 + gw - 260, gy0 - 70, size=30, color=WARN)
text('net ' + fmt(kept) + ' / day', (RX0 + RX1) // 2, gy0 + rows * cell + 60, size=44, color=ACCENT, center=True)

stories.title: Why 6 In 10 US Pets Are Now Overweight
stories.hook: Your dog's not just chubby. It's the norm now.
stories.closing: That extra treat isn't love. It's two years, quietly gone.
stories.question: Is your pet a little overweight? Tell me below.
stories.caption: 59% of US dogs and 61% of cats are now overweight or obese, per the Association for Pet Obesity Prevention. It's not a few chubby pets anymore — it's most of them, and a landmark feeding study found the extra weight can cost a dog nearly two years of life. Is your pet a little overweight? Tell me below 🐶

segments.say: In 2012, 52.5% of US dogs were overweight. By 2022, that hit 59% — most dogs now, not a few chubby pups.

scene.concept: the same dog photo appears at three points on a rising timeline, growing rounder and wider at each stop as the overweight share climbs from 52.5% to 59%

    v = values[i]
    cx = RX0 + gw * i + gw // 2
    stage = clamp(reveal * n_pts - i)
    frac = clamp(v / vmax)

    d.ellipse([cx - 10, track_y - 10, cx + 10, track_y + 10], fill=rgba(HIGHLIGHT, 220) if stage > 0.5 else rgba(TEXT, 120))

        text(labels[i], cx, track_y + 24, size=20, color=TEXT, center=True)

             color=HIGHLIGHT if i == n_pts - 1 else TEXT, center=True)

stories.closing: Alaska: quietly winning at volcanoes since forever.
stories.question: Seen a volcano in person? Where?
stories.caption: The United States has more active volcanoes than any other country on Earth — 165, mostly hiding along Alaska's coastline. It's not a coincidence: the US, Japan, Russia, and Indonesia all sit on the same fault line, the Ring of Fire, which holds 75% of Earth's active volcanoes. Ever seen a volcano in person? Tell me where 🌋

stories.title: Why Password Length Beats Every Trick You Know
stories.hook: 132 years. Or two weeks. Same password.
stories.closing: Twelve boring characters beat eight clever ones.
stories.question: How long is your longest password, honestly? Tell me below.
stories.caption: A 'strong' 8-character password with symbols now falls in 132 years to a rented GPU rig -- down from 225 years just two editions ago. A plain 12-character password with zero symbols can already beat that. Length beats cleverness, every time. How long is your longest password, honestly? Tell me below 🔐

segments.say: In 2024, a strong eight-character password held up for 225 years against a rented GPU rig. Two editions later, that same password falls in 132 years.

scene.concept: a digital padlock's protective ring drains and cracks spread across its shell as crack-time collapses year over year

cy = RTOP + 360

    paste(lock, cx - lw // 2, cy - lw // 2, lw, lw)

    d.ellipse([cx - lw // 2, cy - lw // 2, cx + lw // 2, cy + lw // 2], fill=rgba('#334155', 230), outline=rgba(TEXT, 200), width=6)
raw = clamp(reveal) * (n - 1)
i = int(raw)
t = raw - i
i2 = min(i + 1, n - 1)

frac = clamp(cur / vmax)

d.arc([cx - radius, cy - radius, cx + radius, cy + radius], start_ang, end_ang, fill=rgba(HIGHLIGHT if frac > 0.5 else WARN, 240), width=16)
crack_n = int(8 * (1 - frac))
for k in range(crack_n):
    ang = (k / max(1, crack_n)) * 6.283 + reveal * 2
    x2 = cx + int((lw // 2 + 14) * math.cos(ang))
    y2 = cy + int((lw // 2 + 14) * math.sin(ang))

text(labels[i], cx, cy - lw // 2 - 70, size=40, color=HIGHLIGHT, center=True)

segments.say: But add four plain characters instead of symbols, and the math flips: a 12-letter lowercase password already beats that 8-character mix, combinations and all.

scene.concept: two combination-lock dials spin with tick marks orbiting them, the 12-char lowercase dial spinning bigger and denser than the shorter mixed-rule dial despite fewer rule types

col_w = (RX1 - RX0) // 2
cy = RTOP + 440

    count, val, lab = groups[gi]

        d.ellipse([gx - size // 2, cy - size // 2, gx + size // 2, cy + size // 2], fill=rgba(ACCENT, 200))
    spin = reveal * 480 * (1.3 if gi == 1 else 1.0)
    for k in range(count):
        ang = math.radians(spin + k * (360.0 / count))
        tx = gx + int((size // 2 + 18) * math.cos(ang))
        ty = cy + int((size // 2 + 18) * math.sin(ang))
        d.ellipse([tx - 5, ty - 5, tx + 5, ty + 5], fill=rgba(HIGHLIGHT, 220))

segments.say: In the 1950s, an F1 pit stop took about a minute, drivers sometimes swapping their own tires. By 2023, McLaren did the whole stop in 1.80 seconds.

def _f1_car(cr, x, y, s, blur):

        cr.move_to(wx + 22 * s * math.cos(ang), y + 22 * s * math.sin(ang))

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """How fast 1.8 seconds is: the start-light gantry over a night straight,
    one red light per human reaction time. The lights come on one blink at a
    time, and before the seventh is fully lit the car has already gone. Data
    runs down the gantry slapping at each light as it comes on — always one
    blink behind — and is left spinning in shock as the car blows past."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lr, rec), (lh, react) = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])[:2]
    ratio = rec / max(react, 1e-06)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (10, 12, 30)), (0.45, (28, 30, 62)), (0.62, (52, 44, 70)), (0.64, (40, 40, 48)), (1.0, (22, 22, 28))], 0, H)
    for i in range(4):
        fx = 90 + i * 300
        glow(cr, fx, 360, 220, P['sun_glow'], 0.35 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 3 + i))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 246, 230)))
        cr.rectangle(fx - 30, 350, 60, 20)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 30, 52)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1040, W, 150)
    cr.fill()
    for i in range(60):
        fx = (i * 197 + int(t * 7) * 53) % W
        fy = 1060 + i * 61 % 110
        fl = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 9 + i * 1.7)
        if fl > 0.85:
            glow(cr, fx, fy, 26, (255, 255, 240), fl)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P['curb']))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1190, W, 12)
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(12):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 200, 210), 0.6))
        dx = (k * 140 - t * 60) % (W + 140) - 70
        cr.rectangle(dx, 1470, 70, 8)
        cr.fill()
    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(ratio)))
    gx0, gx1 = (110, W - 110)
    sp = (gx1 - gx0) / max(1, n - 1)
    gy = 760
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 36)))
    cr.rectangle(40, gy - 70, W - 80, 30)
    cr.fill()
    for px in (60, W - 60):
        cr.rectangle(px - 12, gy - 70, 24, 1190 - gy + 70)
        cr.fill()
    lit = ratio * ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.78))
    for k in range(n):
        x = gx0 + k * sp
        on = clamp(lit - k)
        cap = clamp(ratio - k)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((16, 16, 20)))
        cr.rectangle(x - 48, gy - 44, 96, 190)
        cr.fill()
        for j in range(2):
            cy_ = gy + 6 + j * 90
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 20, 22)))
            cr.arc(x, cy_, 34, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
            if on > 0:
                b = min(on, cap) / max(cap, 1e-06)
                glow(cr, x, cy_, 90, P['redline'], 0.6 * b)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 60, 50), b))
                cr.move_to(x, cy_)
                cr.arc(x, cy_, 34, -math.pi / 2, -math.pi / 2 + 2 * math.pi * b)
                cr.close_path()
                cr.fill()
    cu = seg(u, 0.74, 0.9)
    if 0 < cu < 1:
        _f1_car(cr, -300 + (W + 600) * ease(cu), 1400, 1.1, 1.0)
    chase = clamp(lit / max(ratio, 1e-06))
    hx = gx0 + (gx1 - gx0) * chase
    if u < 0.12:
        role = 'think'
    elif u < 0.74:
        role = 'strain' if lit % 1.0 < 0.5 else 'point'
    elif u < 0.9:
        role = 'shock'
    else:
        role = 'hold_up'
    if role == 'shock':
        dx, dy = (0.0, 0.0)
        host(role, hx + dx, 1330 + dy, 210, pace=False)
    else:
        host(role, hx, 1330, 210)
    fit_readout(cr, f'{rec:g}s', f'{lr.lower()} · {ratio:.1f} human reactions', 80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.95))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f'1 light = {react:g}s', lh.lower(), W / 2, 1000, anchor='center', a=b, rgb=P['accent2'], size=64)

stories.title: Why NASA Waits Almost Two Days For One Reply
stories.hook: 22 hours, one-way. Every single message.
stories.closing: Somewhere out there, your 'hello' is still traveling.
stories.question: Could you wait two days for a text back? Tell me below.
stories.caption: Voyager 1 is so far away that a radio signal now takes over 22 hours just one-way to reach it -- and the same to get a reply back. It's also slowly running out of power, which is why NASA keeps switching its instruments off. Could you wait two days for a text back? Tell me below 🛰️

segments.say: Voyager 1 launched in 1977. By 1990, its last photo of Earth took five and a half hours to arrive. A message today takes more than twenty-two.

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a big desk globe of Earth
    SUBSTANCE: the spinning Earth
    CAUSE: Data shoves the globe with both hands and it spins faster each push
    Earth is spinning faster: a big desk globe in a study at dusk. Data climbs
    the library steps beside it and shoves it with both hands flat on its
    side. Each shove lands and the globe visibly speeds up: continents and
    meridians race round and smear. Then it holds at that speed until the
    next shove. The brass meridian ring is ONE whole, split once at the true
    share. The chance of a negative leap second is in the accent and the rest
    stays plain brass. The ring never moves; the Earth is what moves."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    neg = [r for r in rows if "negative" in r[0].lower()]
    (ls, vs) = neg[0] if neg else min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    rest_rows = [r for r in rows if r[0] != ls]
    (lr, vr) = rest_rows[0] if rest_rows else ("the rest", 100.0 - vs)
    tot = (vs + vr) or 1.0
    share = vs / tot

    # the study: a dusk wall, a window of stars, a wooden floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (24, 30, 58)), (0.6, (46, 44, 78)), (1.0, (70, 56, 70))], 0, 1240)
    cr.rectangle(760, 140, 240, 330)
    solid(cr, (16, 22, 48), rim=False)
    for i in range(12):
        sx = 780 + (i * 89) % 200
        sy = 170 + (i * 53) % 280
        glow(cr, sx, sy, 6, (230, 235, 255), 0.7)
    haze(cr, 100, 520, (46, 44, 78), a=0.4)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, P["counter_top"]), (0.4, P["counter"]), (1.0, (60, 40, 30))], 1220, H)
    for i in range(7):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 32, 24), 0.5))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(0, 1260 + i * 95)
        cr.line_to(W, 1260 + i * 95)
        cr.stroke()

    # the shoves: each strike spins the globe up, then it holds that speed
    D = clamp(t / u if u > 0.02 else 9.0, 4.0, 20.0)
    strikes = [0.32, 0.50, 0.68]
    omega = 0.5 + sum(1.1 * ease(seg(u, a + 0.04, a + 0.10)) for a in strikes)
    phase = 0.5 * t + sum(1.1 * max(0.0, t - (a + 0.07) * D) for a in strikes)
    fast = clamp((omega - 0.5) / 3.3)

    cx, cy, R = 560, 900, 290

    # the stand
    contact_shadow(cr, cx, 1400, 440, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, cx - 200, 1400, 400, 46, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal")
    cylinder(cr, cx - 22, 1356, 44, 170, P["brass"], finish="metal")

    # the library steps Data climbs
    contact_shadow(cr, 210, 1480, 220, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 110, 1480, 190, 190, P["log"], depth=30)
    box(cr, 140, 1290, 140, 180, P["log"], depth=26)

    # the globe: ocean, meridians and continents that race round as it spins
    disc(cr, cx, cy, R, (40, 96, 170), finish="gloss")
    cr.save()
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R - 3, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.clip()
    for k in range(12):  # meridians sweep with the spin
        a_ = phase + k * math.pi / 6
        s = math.sin(a_)
        if math.cos(a_) < 0:
            continue
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx + R * s * 0.0, cy)
        cr.scale(max(0.01, abs(R * s)), R)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, -math.pi / 2, math.pi / 2) if s > 0 else \
            cr.arc_negative(0, 0, 1, -math.pi / 2, math.pi / 2 + math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 225, 255), 0.22))
        cr.set_line_width(2.5)
        cr.stroke()
    for la in (-0.6, -0.3, 0.0, 0.3, 0.6):  # latitude lines
        y = cy + R * math.sin(la)
        rx = R * math.cos(la)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx, y)
        cr.scale(rx, rx * 0.12)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 225, 255), 0.22))
        cr.set_line_width(2.5)
        cr.stroke()
    conts = [(0.0, -0.40, 0.30, 0.28), (0.9, 0.25, 0.22, 0.42), (2.1, -0.20, 0.40, 0.26),
             (3.0, 0.45, 0.18, 0.20), (4.2, -0.35, 0.30, 0.22), (5.2, 0.15, 0.24, 0.36)]

    def land(off, alpha):
        for lon, lat, w, h in conts:
            a_ = lon + phase - off
            c = math.cos(a_)
            if c < 0.08:
                continue
            x = cx + R * math.sin(a_) * math.cos(lat)
            y = cy + R * math.sin(lat)
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(x, y)
            cr.scale(max(0.05, w * R * c), h * R)
            cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.restore()
            if alpha >= 1.0:
                solid(cr, (72, 140, 76), rim=False)
            else:
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((72, 140, 76), alpha))
                cr.fill()

    if fast > 0.05:  # motion smear trailing the land as it speeds up
        for j in (3, 2, 1):
            land(0.09 * j * fast, 0.18 * fast)
    land(0.0, 1.0)
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, cx - R * 0.4, cy - R * 0.45, 90, (255, 255, 255), 0.25)

    # the meridian ring: ONE whole, split once at the true share — it holds still
    rr = R + 40
    a0 = -math.pi / 2
    cr.set_line_width(28)
    cr.arc(cx, cy, rr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(20)
    cr.arc(cx, cy, rr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.stroke()
    ra0 = ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.14))
    if ra0 > 0:
        cr.set_line_width(22)
        cr.arc(cx, cy, rr, a0, a0 + 2 * math.pi * share)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], ra0))
        cr.stroke()
        for a_ in (a0, a0 + 2 * math.pi * share):
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK, ra0))
            cr.set_line_width(4)
            cr.move_to(cx + (rr - 16) * math.cos(a_), cy + (rr - 16) * math.sin(a_))
            cr.line_to(cx + (rr + 16) * math.cos(a_), cy + (rr + 16) * math.sin(a_))
            cr.stroke()

    # his bit: points at the globe, climbs the steps, shoves it three times, cheers
    up = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.28))
    dx = 70 + 150 * up
    fy = 1500 - 390 * up
    shoves = sum(1 for a in strikes if u >= a)
    if u < 0.12:
        role, beat = "point", 0
    elif u < strikes[0]:
        role, beat = "climb", 0
    elif u < 0.86:
        role, beat = "shove", shoves
    else:
        role, beat = "cheer", 0
    host(role, dx, fy, 220, beat=beat)

    vignette(cr, 0.3)

    # readouts
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%", ls.lower(), 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), size=140, max_w=600)
    ra = ease(seg(u, 0.80, 0.90))
    if ra > 0:
        text(cr, f"{int(round((1 - share) * 100))}%", W - 80, 1460, 80, look.INK,
             face="display", anchor="right", alpha=ra)
        text(cr, lr, W - 80, 1500, fit_size(cr, lr, 32, 520), look.INK,
             anchor="right", alpha=ra)

def _fir(cr, x, base, s, rgb, lean=0.0, a=1.0):
    """An oyamel fir: a trunk and four drooping tiers of boughs, lit."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, base)
    cr.rotate(lean * 1.45)
    cr.rectangle(-8 * s, -34 * s, 16 * s, 34 * s)
    solid(cr, P["trunk"], rim=False, a=a)
    for j in range(4):
        w = 74 * s * (1 - 0.2 * j)
        y0 = -26 * s - j * 40 * s
        top = y0 - 82 * s
        hh = y0 - top
        cr.move_to(-w, y0)
        cr.curve_to(-w * 0.55, y0 - 0.35 * hh, -w * 0.2, top + 0.3 * hh, 0, top)
        cr.curve_to(w * 0.2, top + 0.3 * hh, w * 0.55, y0 - 0.35 * hh, w, y0)
        cr.curve_to(w * 0.5, y0 - 12 * s, -w * 0.5, y0 - 12 * s, -w, y0)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, rgb, a=a)
    cr.restore()


def _mon(cr, x, y, s, open_, rgb, ang=0.0, a=1.0):
    """One monarch: two forewings and two hindwings, orange with black veins."""
    if a <= 0.01:
        return
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    for sd in (-1, 1):
        cr.save()
        cr.scale(sd * open_, 1)
        cr.move_to(0, 0)
        cr.curve_to(4 * s, -9 * s, 13 * s, -11 * s, 12 * s, -2 * s)
        cr.curve_to(11 * s, 2 * s, 5 * s, 2 * s, 0, 0)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.move_to(0, 0)
        cr.curve_to(7 * s, 1 * s, 9 * s, 7 * s, 4 * s, 9 * s)
        cr.curve_to(1 * s, 9 * s, 0, 4 * s, 0, 0)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb, a))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 18, 14), a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(1.2, 1.4 * s))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 18, 14), a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, 2.0 * s))
    cr.move_to(0, -3 * s)
    cr.line_to(0, 7 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()


def _cloak(cr, x, base, s, t, seed, a=1.0, lean=0.0):
    """The colony hanging on a fir's boughs: monarchs packed along every tier."""
    if a <= 0.01:
        return
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, base)
    cr.rotate(lean * 1.45)
    for j in range(4):
        w = 74 * s * (1 - 0.2 * j)
        y0 = -26 * s - j * 40 * s
        for m in range(5 - (j // 2)):
            fr = ((seed * 0.618 + m * 0.37 + j * 0.21) % 1.0) * 1.5 - 0.75
            mx = w * fr
            my = y0 - 10 * s - abs(fr) * 6 * s - ((seed + m) % 3) * 9 * s
            op = 0.45 + 0.55 * abs(math.sin(t * 1.4 + seed * 1.7 + m * 2.3 + j))
            jit = ((seed * 7 + m * 3 + j * 5) % 9) - 4
            rgb = (232 + jit, 118 + 3 * jit, 28 + jit)
            _mon(cr, mx, my, 1.15 * s, op, rgb, ang=0.25 * fr, a=a)
    cr.restore()


def _log(cr, x, y, s, side, a=1.0):
    """A felled fir trunk lying on the ground, lit, its cut end showing."""
    if a <= 0.01:
        return
    L, R = 92 * s, 12 * s
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(side * 0.1)
    x0 = 0 if side > 0 else -L
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x0 + R, 0, R, math.pi / 2, 3 * math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x0 + L - R, 0, R, -math.pi / 2, math.pi / 2)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, P["log"], a=a)
    cr.restore()
    ex = x + (0 if side > 0 else -L) * math.cos(0.1)
    disc(cr, ex, y + side * 0.1 * (0 if side > 0 else -L), R, P["stump_top"], a=a)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a fir forest cloaked in monarchs
    SUBSTANCE: orange monarch-covered fir trees
    CAUSE: Data chops the fir trees at the edge and the orange monarch forest shrinks with every felled tree
    The 1996 colony covered the whole stand of oyamel firs on the mountain;
    chop by chop the firs at its edge fall and their butterflies go, and the
    orange forest closes in to the few trees that held them in 2024. The
    colony's AREA is the hectares: the 1996 stand sits on a patch of brown
    forest floor ringed by a dashed ghost labelled as the 1996 forest, and as
    the firs fall that floor is left bare with stumps, so one look says about
    twenty times less. The open meadow around it stays sunlit green, and the
    near-camera stump and monarch log sit above the caption band."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v0 / (v1 or 1.0)
    n = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.75))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step
    rn = math.sqrt(max(val, 0.0) / v0)

    CX, CY = 560, 1185
    RX0, RY0 = 470.0, 265.0
    rx = RX0 * rn

    # the setting: the mountain the colony winters on, hills kept ABOVE the
    # horizon so the sunlit meadow of the landscape shows in front
    landscape(cr, t, "field", horizon=1000)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, 1006)
    cr.clip()
    ridge(cr, 1000, 300, seed=1.3, n=4)
    solid(cr, (96, 112, 122), edge=False)
    haze(cr, 640, 1000, (226, 206, 184), a=0.5)
    ridge(cr, 1000, 130, seed=4.1, n=6)
    solid(cr, (70, 98, 82), edge=False)
    treeline(cr, 1000, (52, 84, 66), n=18, seed=3)
    haze(cr, 760, 1010, (226, 206, 184), a=0.3)
    cr.restore()

    # the forest floor of the 1996 stand: needle litter, bare once cleared
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(CX, CY + 20)
    cr.scale(1, (RY0 + 30) / (RX0 + 30))
    cr.arc(0, 0, RX0 + 30, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (128, 100, 70), rim=False, edge=False)

    # the stand of firs: the colony's area is how many still stand
    N = 30
    stand = []
    for i in range(N):
        ang = i * 2.399963
        r = math.sqrt((i + 0.5) / N)
        px = CX + RX0 * r * math.cos(ang)
        py = CY + RY0 * r * math.sin(ang)
        stand.append((r, px, py, i))
    m = N * val / v0                      # trees the colony still covers
    trees = []
    for j, (r, px, py, i) in enumerate(stand):
        fall = 0.0 if u < a0 else clamp(2 * (j - m) + 1)
        trees.append((py, px, r, i, fall * fall))
    trees.sort()

    cast_shadow(cr, CX - RX0 * 0.7, CX + RX0 * 0.7, CY + RY0 * 0.5, length=280, a=0.22)
    for py, px, r, i, fall in trees:
        s = 0.95 + 0.45 * (py - (CY - RY0)) / (2 * RY0) + 0.35 * (1 - r)
        side = 1.0 if px >= CX else -1.0
        contact_shadow(cr, px, py + 4, 90 * s, a=0.3)
        if fall <= 0.0:
            _fir(cr, px, py, s, (40, 88, 66), lean=0.012 * math.sin(t * 1.1 + i))
            _cloak(cr, px, py, s, t, i, lean=0.012 * math.sin(t * 1.1 + i))
            continue
        stump(cr, px, py, 0.7 * s)
        gone = seg(fall, 0.6, 1.0)
        if gone > 0 and i % 3 == 0:       # a few felled trunks lie where they fell
            _log(cr, px + side * 10 * s, py - 6 * s, s, side, a=gone)
        if gone < 1:
            _fir(cr, px + side * 10 * s * fall, py, s * 0.95, (40, 88, 66),
                 lean=side * 0.9 * fall, a=1 - gone)
            _cloak(cr, px + side * 10 * s * fall, py, s * 0.95, t, i,
                   a=(1 - fall) * (1 - gone), lean=side * 0.9 * fall)

    # right by the camera, ABOVE the caption band: a fresh stump on the left
    # and a cut log on the right where a few monarchs rest
    contact_shadow(cr, 120, 1528, 170, a=0.4)
    stump(cr, 120, 1528, 1.8)
    contact_shadow(cr, 860, 1522, 240, a=0.4)
    _log(cr, 760, 1496, 2.3, 1.0)
    for j in range(3):
        op = 0.45 + 0.55 * abs(math.sin(t * 1.2 + j * 1.9))
        _mon(cr, 800 + j * 60, 1470 - 4 * j - (j % 2) * 6, 1.9, op,
             (234 - 3 * j, 120 + 2 * j, 30), ang=0.2 * (j - 1))

    # THE SCALE on the ground: where the 1996 colony reached, named as such
    if step > 0.02:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(CX, CY + 30)
        cr.scale(1, (RY0 + 40) / (RX0 + 40))
        cr.arc(0, 0, RX0 + 40, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        text(cr, f"the forest in {l0}", CX, CY + 30 - (RY0 + 40) - 16, 36,
             look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    hx = max(100.0, CX - rx - 70)
    hy = CY + 70
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("chop", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, 220)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 220)

    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1:g} hectares", f"of forest held monarchs · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}x less", W - 80, 690, 80, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v0:g} hectares", f"of forest held monarchs · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _soy_pt(a, b):
    FL, FR, NR, NL = (220, 930), (860, 930), (1160, 1490), (-80, 1490)
    fx = FL[0] + (FR[0] - FL[0]) * a
    fy = FL[1] + (FR[1] - FL[1]) * a
    nx = NL[0] + (NR[0] - NL[0]) * a
    ny = NL[1] + (NR[1] - NL[1]) * a
    return fx + (nx - fx) * b, fy + (ny - fy) * b


def _soy_region(cr, a0, a1):
    cr.move_to(*_soy_pt(a0, 0.0))
    cr.line_to(*_soy_pt(a1, 0.0))
    cr.line_to(*_soy_pt(a1, 1.0))
    cr.line_to(*_soy_pt(a0, 1.0))
    cr.close_path()


def _leaflet(cr, x, y, r, ang, rgb):
    # a soybean leaflet: a pointed oval, wider near its base
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.move_to(-r, 0)
    cr.curve_to(-r * 0.6, -r * 0.62, r * 0.5, -r * 0.5, r * 1.15, 0)
    cr.curve_to(r * 0.5, r * 0.5, -r * 0.6, r * 0.62, -r, 0)
    cr.close_path()

    for (lx, ly, base) in ((-1, 0.62, -2.5), (1, 0.78, -0.65), (0, 1.0, -1.57)):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a big soybean field
    SUBSTANCE: rows of soybean plants
    CAUSE: Data pours soybean seed from a bucket down each furrow and a row of soybean plants comes up behind it
    One field, the whole of US soybean land, cut at the true share: the
    rows planted with herbicide-resistant seed stand tall with trifoliate
    leaves and hanging fuzzy pods; the rest is still bare tilled furrow.
    Row by row Data pours seed from a bucket and the planted share spreads
    from 1997's to 2014's. 1997's patch stays on the field as a dashed
    ghost, so a strip becomes nearly the whole field. By the camera, a
    podded plant and a split pod of beans name the crop. Lands by 0.56,
    then holds while cloud shadows cross and Data keeps pouring."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    n = 6
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.7))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step
    split = clamp(val / 100.0)
    s0 = clamp(v0 / 100.0)

    landscape(cr, t, "field", horizon=925)
    treeline(cr, 929, P["leaf_far"], n=16, seed=3)
    haze(cr, 740, 935, (206, 214, 222), a=0.35)
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    # the whole field: bare tilled soil, its furrows running away from us
    _soy_region(cr, 0.0, 1.0)
    solid(cr, (150, 112, 74))
    R, D = 10, 7
    for i in range(R + 1):
        a = i / R
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((104, 76, 50)))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(*_soy_pt(a, 0.0))
        cr.line_to(*_soy_pt(a, 1.0))
        cr.stroke()

    # the planted share: rows of soybean plants, far first so near overlaps
    fill = split * R
    for j in range(D):
        b = (j + 0.5) / D
        s = 0.55 + 1.15 * b
        for i in range(R):
            rf = clamp(fill - i)
            if rf <= 0:
                continue
            g = ease(clamp(rf * D - (D - 1 - j)))
            x, y = _soy_pt((i + 0.5) / R, b)
            _soy_plant(cr, x, y, s, g, sway=3 * math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 0.7 + j))

    # a cloud's shadow drifts across the field — the world keeps moving
    cx = -700 + ((t / 4.2) % 1.0) * 2400
    cr.save()
    _soy_region(cr, 0.0, 1.0)
    cr.clip()
    cr.move_to(cx, 930)
    cr.line_to(cx + 520, 930)
    cr.line_to(cx + 760, 1490)
    cr.line_to(cx + 180, 1490)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(0.08, 0.1, 0.06, 0.38)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()

    # the frontier of the planted share, in the accent
    if u >= a0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(*_soy_pt(split, 0.0))
        cr.line_to(*_soy_pt(split, 1.0))
        cr.stroke()
    # THE SCALE on the field: 1997's planted strip, dashed where it stood
    if step > 0.02:
        _soy_region(cr, 0.0, s0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        gx, gy = _soy_pt(s0 / 2, 0.0)
        text(cr, l0, gx, gy - 14, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # right by the camera: a tall podded soybean plant and a split pod of beans
    for fx_, fy_, fs in ((120, 1900, 5.2), (960, 1880, 4.6)):
        _soy_plant(cr, fx_, fy_, fs, 1.0, sway=3 * math.sin(t * 1.2 + fx_))
    contact_shadow(cr, 560, 1790, 380, a=0.35)
    _open_pod(cr, 560, 1770, 2.6, -0.12)
    for m in range(5):                          # loose beans spilled beside it
        disc(cr, 380 + m * 46 + (m % 2) * 10, 1840 + (m % 2) * 18, 15,
             (234, 204, 120), finish="gloss")
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks the near end, pouring seed into the next furrow
    hx, hy = _soy_pt(clamp(split + 0.02), 0.97)
    hx = clamp(hx, 110, 960)
    hy = min(1495.0, hy)
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    else:
        bt = k if u < a1 else n + int((u - a1) / 0.1)
        host("pour", hx, hy, 220, beat=bt)
        for m in range(6):                     # the seed pouring from the bucket
            p = (t * 2.2 + m / 6.0) % 1.0
            disc(cr, hx + 58 + 26 * p, hy - 120 + 115 * p * p, 6, (234, 204, 120))

    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))}%", f"of US soybeans herbicide-resistant · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))}%", f"of US soybeans herbicide-resistant · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a milkweed meadow covered in monarchs
    SUBSTANCE: orange monarch butterflies
    CAUSE: Data digs up the milkweed with a shovel and the monarchs on each plant fly away
    One meadow split by a fence: the western route on the left, the eastern
    on the right, twenty milkweeds each with monarchs on the flowers. Data
    works across each half with the shovel; on every strike the plants in
    his patch come up by the roots and their butterflies lift off into the
    sky, leaving bare holes in the rows — 95% of the west, 80% of the east.
    The holes stay in the field beside the plants still standing, so what
    is left reads as a share of the whole meadow at a glance."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    west = next((r for r in rows if "west" in r[0].lower()), rows[0])
    east = next((r for r in rows if r is not west), rows[-1])
    sides = [west, east]
    N = 20
    lost = [int(round(N * clamp(v / 100.0))) for _, v in sides]
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / 6
    STRIKE = 0.3

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=3, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    plants = []
    for sd in (0, 1):
        x_left = 70 if sd == 0 else 570
        for r in range(4):
            for c in range(5):
                i = r * 5 + c
                px = x_left + 40 + c * 92 + (r % 2) * 22 + ((i * 37) % 21 - 10)
                base = 1215 + r * 72
                h = 190 + r * 36
                rank = (i * 7 + 3) % N
                tr = None
                if rank < lost[sd]:
                    bucket = min(2, c // 2)
                    tr = a0 + (sd * 3 + bucket) * span + STRIKE * span
                plants.append((base, px, h, tr, i, sd))
    plants.sort(key=lambda p: p[0])

    # the fence between the two routes
    for r in range(5):
        fy = 1200 + r * 70
        contact_shadow(cr, 540, fy, 30, a=0.3)
        box(cr, 532, fy, 16, 70 + r * 14, (150, 116, 80))

    flyers = []
    for base, px, h, tr, i, sd in plants:
        up = 0.0 if tr is None else clamp((u - tr) / (0.35 * span))
        sway = 0.02 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + i)
        if up > 0:
            _hole(cr, px, base)
        if up < 1:
            if up <= 0:
                contact_shadow(cr, px, base, 50, a=0.3)
            lift = 160 * ease(up)
            tip = (-1 if sd == 0 else 1) * 0.5 * up
            _milkweed(cr, px, base, h, lean=sway + tip, a=1 - up * up, lift=lift)
        for m in range(2):
            mx = px + (m * 2 - 1) * h * 0.13
            my = base - h - 22 - m * 14
            q = 0.0 if tr is None else clamp((u - tr) / 0.2)
            flap = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 3 + i + m * 1.7)
            if q > 0:
                if q < 1:
                    d = -1 if sd == 0 else 1
                    flyers.append((mx + d * 320 * q + 30 * math.sin(q * 6 + m),
                                   my - 520 * q, 0.38 + 0.25 * q,
                                   0.3 + 0.7 * abs(math.sin(t * 5 + m)), 1 - q * q))
            else:
                _monarch(cr, mx, my, 0.3 + 0.05 * (base - 1215) / 72, flap,
                         ang=0.2 * math.sin(i + m))
    for fx, fy, fs, ff, fa in flyers:
        _monarch(cr, fx, fy, fs, ff, a=fa)

    # route names over each half, the share each lost once it has landed
    for sd, (lab, v) in enumerate(sides):
        cx = 300 if sd == 0 else 790
        short = lab.split("(")[0].strip()
        sub = lab[lab.find("(") + 1:lab.rfind(")")] if "(" in lab else ""
        text(cr, short, cx, 1135, fit_size(cr, short, 34, 440), look.INK, anchor="center")
        landed_at = a0 + (sd * 3 + 2) * span + 0.7 * span
        al = ease(seg(u, landed_at, landed_at + 0.04))
        if al > 0:
            text(cr, f"{int(round(v))}% gone", cx, 930, 92, look.INK, face="display",
                 anchor="center", alpha=al)
            if sub:
                text(cr, sub, cx, 985, 32, look.INK, anchor="center", alpha=al)

    # right by the camera: a big milkweed with a monarch, one more flying past
    _milkweed(cr, 90, 1960, 430, lean=0.03 * math.sin(t * 0.9))
    _monarch(cr, 120, 1505, 1.1, 0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * 2.4), ang=-0.2)
    if u > 0.5:
        q = (u - 0.5) / 0.5
        _monarch(cr, -120 + 1100 * q, 1680 - 120 * q + 40 * math.sin(q * 9), 1.4,
                 0.3 + 0.7 * abs(math.sin(t * 4)), ang=0.15)
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data works patch by patch: west half left to right, over the fence,
    # then the east half; he stands at the patch each strike digs up
    spots = []
    for sd in (0, 1):
        x_left = 70 if sd == 0 else 570
        for colc in (0.5, 2.5, 4.0):
            spots.append(min(930.0, x_left + 51 + 92 * colc))
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, 5.999))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    if u < a0:
        hx = spots[0]
    elif k < 5:
        hx = spots[k] + (spots[k + 1] - spots[k]) * ease(seg(f, 0.7, 1.0))
    else:
        hx = spots[5]
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, 1500, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("dig", hx, 1500, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("dig", hx, 1500, 220, beat=6 + int((u - a1) / 0.13))

    fit_readout(cr, "Monarchs", "the milkweed they breed on, dug up", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

    return tuple(int(a + (b - a) * w) for a, b in zip(c0, c1))


def _bez(p, p0, p1, p2, p3):
    q = 1 - p
    return (q ** 3 * p0[0] + 3 * q * q * p * p1[0] + 3 * q * p * p * p2[0] + p ** 3 * p3[0],
            q ** 3 * p0[1] + 3 * q * q * p * p1[1] + 3 * q * p * p * p2[1] + p ** 3 * p3[1])


def _stem(cr, cx, base, Hh, dx, hk, side, w, t):
    """One milkweed stalk: broad opposite oval leaves, a pink flower umbel."""
    leaf_c = _mix((86, 146, 64), (156, 128, 66), w)
    stem_c = _mix((70, 112, 50), (124, 102, 58), w)
    pink = _mix((224, 118, 158), (150, 112, 108), w)
    pink_lit = _mix((244, 168, 196), (176, 140, 128), w)
    h = Hh * hk * (1 - 0.35 * w)
    x0 = cx + dx * 0.35
    sway = 4 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + dx)
    tipx = cx + dx + side * w * 110 + (w * 50 if side == 0 else 0) + sway
    tipy = base - h + w * h * 0.15
    p0 = (x0, base)
    p1 = (x0, base - h * 0.5)
    p2 = (tipx - side * 40, tipy + h * 0.25)
    p3 = (tipx, tipy)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(stem_c))
    cr.set_line_width(13)
    cr.move_to(*p0)
    cr.curve_to(p1[0], p1[1], p2[0], p2[1], p3[0], p3[1])
    cr.stroke()
    leaves = []
    for kk in range(5):
        lx, ly = _bez(0.22 + 0.14 * kk, p0, p1, p2, p3)
        L = 80 * (1 - 0.3 * w) * (1 - 0.06 * kk)
        for sgn in (-1, 1):
            th = sgn * (-0.25 + 1.1 * w)
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(lx, ly)
            cr.rotate(th)
            cr.translate(sgn * L * 0.85, 0)
            cr.scale(L, L * 0.36)
            cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.restore()
            solid(cr, leaf_c)
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(lx, ly)
            cr.rotate(th)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_mix((200, 220, 160), (190, 170, 120), w), 0.8))
            cr.set_line_width(3)
            cr.move_to(sgn * 8, 0)
            cr.line_to(sgn * L * 1.6, 0)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.restore()
            leaves.append((lx + sgn * L * 0.85 * math.cos(th),
                           ly + sgn * L * 0.85 * math.sin(th) - L * 0.3))
    # the flower umbel: a round head of small pink florets
    disc(cr, tipx, tipy - 10, 30, pink)
    for j in range(8):
        an = j * 0.785 + 0.2
        disc(cr, tipx + 30 * math.cos(an), tipy - 10 + 22 * math.sin(an), 12, pink_lit)
    disc(cr, tipx, tipy - 18, 14, pink_lit)
    return (tipx, tipy - 40), leaves


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a milkweed plant covered in monarchs
    SUBSTANCE: monarch butterflies
    CAUSE: Data opens the valve on a weedkiller sprayer and the milkweed wilts as its monarchs fly off
    The hook, one picture: a big flowering milkweed in a garden, every
    leaf carrying a monarch, one butterfly per hectare of the 1996
    colony. Three valve turns, three bursts of weedkiller: the plant
    wilts brown and droops, and its monarchs lift away until only the
    2024 count is left on the last flower. The full plant stays as a
    dashed ghost with its 1996 height marked, so the loss reads at a glance."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    N = max(2, int(round(v0)))
    R = max(1, int(round(v1)))
    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.0, 0.52
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    if u >= a1:
        w = 1.0
    else:
        w = clamp((k + ease(seg(f, 0.1, 0.7))) / n)
    spray = 0.0 if u >= a1 else clamp(min(f / 0.08 + 0.3, (0.75 - f) / 0.1))

    CX, BASE, HH = 640, 1440, 760

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    # a picket fence at the back of the garden
    for i in range(20):
        box(cr, 10 + i * 56, 1230, 30, 92, (236, 230, 216), depth=8)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((210, 202, 186)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1166, W, 12)
    cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 900, 1240, (226, 214, 196), a=0.3)

    # the plant's shadow and its bed of soil
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - 200, CX + 200, BASE, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 6, 520, a=0.45)
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE + 10, 46, 260)
    solid(cr, (96, 70, 48))

    # the sprayer cart Data wheels in, a pole and nozzle over the plant
    cartx = 160 + 60 * (k + ease(seg(f, 0.75, 1.0))) if u < a1 else 160 + 60 * n
    cartx = min(cartx, 340)
    box(cr, 430, BASE + 4, 16, 790, (150, 154, 162), depth=6, finish="metal")
    NX, NY = 452, 660
    disc(cr, NX, NY, 14, (90, 92, 100), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 120, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(cartx + 45, BASE - 150)
    cr.curve_to(cartx + 80, BASE - 260, 400, BASE - 120, 436, BASE - 60)
    cr.stroke()

    s_umbel_c, lv_l = None, []
    um_l, lv_l = _stem(cr, CX, BASE, HH, -150, 0.82, -1, w, t)
    um_r, lv_r = _stem(cr, CX, BASE, HH, 150, 0.78, 1, w, t)
    um_c, lv_c = _stem(cr, CX, BASE, HH, 0, 1.0, 0, w, t)
    slots = [um_c, um_l, um_r] + lv_l + lv_c + lv_r

    # the weedkiller mist, from the nozzle down over the plant
    if spray > 0:
        cr.move_to(NX + 8, NY)
        cr.line_to(860, 1020)
        cr.line_to(560, 1200)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 232, 160), 0.34 * spray))
        cr.fill()
        for j in range(5):
            ph = (t * 2.5 + j / 5) % 1.0
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 246, 200), 0.5 * spray))
            cr.set_line_width(5)
            ex = 560 + 300 * j / 4
            ey = 1200 - 180 * j / 4
            cr.move_to(NX + (ex - NX) * ph, NY + (ey - NY) * ph)
            cr.line_to(NX + (ex - NX) * (ph + 0.12), NY + (ey - NY) * (ph + 0.12))
            cr.stroke()

    # THE SCALE: the 1996 plant, dashed where it stood, its height marked
    if w > 0.05:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(CX, BASE - HH * 0.55)
        cr.scale(330, HH * 0.55 + 40)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        ghost(cr, a=0.85)
        then_mark(cr, 470, 820, BASE - HH - 40, l0)

    # one monarch per hectare: the survivors stay, the rest lift away
    D = N - R
    per = max(1, (D + n - 1) // n)
    for j in range(N):
        sx, sy = slots[0] if j == 0 else slots[(j * 7) % len(slots)]
        if j < R:
            _monarch(cr, sx, sy, 1.1, 0.6 * math.sin(t * 2 + j))
            continue
        q = j - R
        step, within = q % n, q // n
        ul = a0 + step * span + span * (0.15 + 0.55 * within / per)
        dt = u - ul
        if dt < 0:
            _monarch(cr, sx, sy, 1.1, 0.6 * math.sin(t * 2 + j))
            continue
        side = 1 if j % 2 else -1
        fy = sy - 2400 * dt * (0.8 + 0.4 * ((j * 0.37) % 1.0))
        if fy < -100:
            continue
        fx = sx + side * 700 * dt + 20 * math.sin(t * 3 + j)
        _monarch(cr, fx, fy, 1.1 + 0.4 * clamp(dt / 0.3), t * 14 + j)

    # the sprayer tank on its cart, Data at the valve
    contact_shadow(cr, cartx + 45, BASE + 8, 130, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, cartx, BASE, 90, 150, (214, 186, 60), finish="gloss")
    for wx in (cartx + 12, cartx + 78):
        disc(cr, wx, BASE + 2, 16, (44, 44, 48), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, cartx + 66, BASE - 158, 13, (196, 50, 40), finish="gloss")

    # right by the camera: fallen, browned milkweed leaves
    for lx, ly, an in ((170, 1700, 0.3), (930, 1680, -0.4)):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(lx, ly)
        cr.rotate(an)
        cr.scale(120, 40)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (150, 124, 66))
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    hx = cartx - 60
    if u < 0.88:
        host("tap", hx, 1452, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, 1452, 220)

    fit_readout(cr, f"{v1:.1f} hectares", f"of monarchs left in {l1} · {v0:.1f} in {l0}",
                80, 520, size=130)
