def _ellipse(cr, x, y, rx, ry, ang=0.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.scale(rx, ry)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()


def _wing_path(cr):
    # a monarch's right wing pair, body at (0, 0): the long forewing, the round hindwing
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.move_to(0, -24)
    cr.curve_to(80, -210, 300, -310, 425, -268)
    cr.curve_to(448, -186, 406, -60, 332, 8)
    cr.curve_to(222, 30, 100, 22, 0, 12)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.move_to(0, 12)
    cr.curve_to(122, 10, 302, 40, 334, 124)
    cr.curve_to(322, 244, 200, 302, 100, 282)
    cr.curve_to(40, 242, 10, 122, 0, 32)
    cr.close_path()


def _monarch(cr, x, y, s, flap, ang=0.0):
    """A monarch: orange wings in a heavy black border, white-spotted, a dark body."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        cr.save()
        cr.scale(side * s * flap, s)
        _wing_path(cr)
        solid(cr, (236, 122, 28), finish="gloss")
        cr.save()
        _wing_path(cr)
        cr.clip()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 20, 18)))
        cr.set_line_width(56)
        _wing_path(cr)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_line_width(22)
        for vx, vy in ((380, -150), (320, -40), (320, 120), (250, 240)):
            cr.move_to(0, 0)
            cr.curve_to(vx * 0.4, vy * 0.2, vx * 0.7, vy * 0.6, vx, vy)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 248, 240)))
        for dx, dy in ((404, -236), (412, -170), (300, 214), (200, 270)):
            cr.new_sub_path()
            cr.arc(dx, dy, 16, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        cr.restore()
    _ellipse(cr, 0, 6 * s / 0.11, 4.5 * s / 0.11, 17 * s / 0.11)
    solid(cr, (36, 28, 26), rim=False)
    cr.restore()


def _leaf(cr, x, y, ang, L, wd):
    # a broad milkweed leaf: an oval with a pointed tip and a pale midrib
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.curve_to(L * 0.2, -wd, L * 0.75, -wd * 1.05, L, 0)
    cr.curve_to(L * 0.75, wd * 1.05, L * 0.2, wd, 0, 0)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (86, 132, 74))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 214, 168), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(6, 0)
    cr.curve_to(L * 0.4, -3, L * 0.7, -2, L * 0.92, 0)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()


def _milkweed(cr, h):
    """Common milkweed in local coords (base at 0,0, growing up): a stout stem,
    broad paired leaves with pale midribs, a seed pod, a dome of pink florets."""
    cr.move_to(-13, 0)
    cr.curve_to(-12, -h * 0.5, -7, -h * 0.8, -6, -h)
    cr.line_to(6, -h)
    cr.curve_to(7, -h * 0.8, 12, -h * 0.5, 13, 0)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (112, 146, 82))
    for i in range(5):
        y = -h * (0.16 + 0.16 * i)
        L = 170 - 18 * i
        for sd in (-1, 1):
            a = (-0.35 - 0.05 * i) if sd > 0 else (math.pi + 0.35 + 0.05 * i)
            _leaf(cr, sd * 6, y, a, L, 0.34 * L)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(12, -h * 0.58)
    cr.rotate(0.5)
    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.curve_to(34, 12, 38, 80, 4, 124)
    cr.curve_to(-16, 80, -16, 22, 0, 0)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (138, 160, 92), finish="gloss")
    top = -h - 10
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((132, 150, 90)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    flowers = []
    for j in range(17):
        a = -math.pi * (0.1 + 0.8 * j / 16)
        rr = 72 if j % 2 else 56
        fx, fy = rr * math.cos(a), top - 10 + 52 * math.sin(a)
        flowers.append((fx, fy))
        cr.move_to(0, -h + 6)
        cr.line_to(fx, fy)
    cr.stroke()
    for fx, fy in flowers:
        disc(cr, fx, fy, 14, (212, 112, 152))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 214, 226)))
        cr.arc(fx - 2, fy - 3, 5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()


def _fence(cr, y0):
    # a garden picket fence across the middle distance
    for ry in (y0 - 90, y0 - 40):
        cr.rectangle(0, ry, W, 12)
        solid(cr, (226, 216, 196), rim=False)
    for i in range(16):
        x = -10 + i * 72
        cr.move_to(x, y0)
        cr.line_to(x, y0 - 110)
        cr.line_to(x + 13, y0 - 128)
        cr.line_to(x + 26, y0 - 110)
        cr.line_to(x + 26, y0)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (236, 228, 212))


_NM = 20          # monarchs on each plant, spread evenly up its height


def _perch(i, hp):
    f = (i + 0.5) / _NM
    side = -1 if i % 2 else 1
    reach = 24 + 120 * min(1.0, f * 2.2) * (0.7 + 0.3 * ((i * 7) % 3) / 2)
    if f > 0.88:
        reach = 30 + 40 * ((i * 3) % 3)
    return side * reach, -hp * f * 0.98 - 12, f


def _xf(px, py, x0, base, keep, ang, shake, above):
    """Local plant point -> frame: the top piece turns about the cut, the whole
    plant shudders about its base."""
    if above:
        cy = -keep
        dx, dy = px, py - cy
        ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
        px, py = dx * ca - dy * sa, cy + dx * sa + dy * ca
    cs, ss = math.cos(shake), math.sin(shake)
    return x0 + px * cs - py * ss, base + px * ss + py * cs


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: two milkweed plants covered in monarchs
    SUBSTANCE: monarch butterflies
    CAUSE: Data saws each route's milkweed down to a stump and the monarchs on the cut part fly away
    The closing, both halves of the line happening in the garden: no
    milkweed — Data saws through the stalk of each route's plant — no
    monarchs — the butterflies on the part that falls lift off and leave.
    Each plant is one whole route and twenty monarchs sit evenly up its
    height, so the saw cuts it at the true share: the west plant is sawn
    down to its lowest 5% (one monarch left), the east to its lowest 20%
    (four left), the plant that stood drawn as a dashed ghost. The east
    top falls on Data and he bears it to the end while the last butterflies
    fly off over the fence."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    west = next((r for r in rows if "west" in r[0].lower()), rows[0])
    east = next((r for r in rows if "east" in r[0].lower()), rows[-1])
    sw, se = clamp(west[1] / 100.0), clamp(east[1] / 100.0)

    BASE, HP = 1440, 680
    stroke_w, stroke_e = 0.075, 0.0675
    plants = [
        # x, kept share, first stroke, stroke length, fall window, fall angle
        dict(x=290, keep=HP * (1 - sw), u0=0.08, st=stroke_w, f0=0.256, f1=0.30, rest=-1.4),
        dict(x=800, keep=HP * (1 - se), u0=0.36, st=stroke_e, f0=0.519, f1=0.55, rest=-1.15),
    ]

    # the clock for Data's saw: three strokes west, a walk, three strokes east
    if u < 0.08:
        k = 0
    elif u < 0.305:
        k = int(clamp((u - 0.08) / stroke_w, 0, 2.999))
    elif u < 0.36:
        k = 3
    else:
        k = 3 + int(clamp((u - 0.36) / stroke_e, 0, 2.999))

    def pose(p, uu):
        fall = seg(uu, p["f0"], p["f1"])
        ang = p["rest"] * fall * fall              # it FALLS — gravity, not a glide
        if p is plants[1] and uu > 0.56:           # Data bears it: it rocks on him
            ang += 0.03 * math.sin(t * 2.2) * seg(uu, 0.56, 0.62)
        shake = 0.0
        for j in range(3):
            d = uu - (p["u0"] + j * p["st"] + 0.35 * p["st"])
            if 0 < d < 0.05 and uu < p["f0"]:
                shake += 0.035 * math.sin(d * 120) * (1 - d / 0.05)
        return ang, shake

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=3, rgb=(60, 60, 70))
    _fence(cr, 1250)
    haze(cr, 1100, 1260, (236, 222, 200), a=0.2)

    flights = []
    for p in plants:
        x0, keep = p["x"], p["keep"]
        ang, shake = pose(p, u)
        cut = seg(u, p["u0"], p["f0"])
        cast_shadow(cr, x0 - 60, x0 + 60, BASE, length=260, a=0.28)
        contact_shadow(cr, x0, BASE + 4, 220, a=0.4)
        if ang != 0.0:                       # the plant that stood, as a ghost
            cr.rectangle(x0 - 12, BASE - HP, 24, HP - keep)
            cr.new_sub_path()
            cr.arc(x0, BASE - HP - 50, 80, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            ghost(cr, a=0.8)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x0, BASE)
        cr.rotate(shake)
        # the piece left standing
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(-500, -keep, 1000, keep + 60)
        cr.clip()
        _milkweed(cr, HP)
        cr.restore()
        # the piece above the cut, toppling about it
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(0, -keep)
        cr.rotate(ang)
        cr.translate(0, keep)
        cr.rectangle(-500, -1400, 1000, 1400 - keep)
        cr.clip()
        _milkweed(cr, HP)
        cr.restore()
        if cut > 0:                          # the saw's kerf, deepening per stroke
            cr.rectangle(-14, -keep - 3, 28 * min(1.0, cut * 1.15), 6)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 52, 30)))
            cr.fill()
        cr.restore()

        # its monarchs: the ones below the cut stay, the rest lift off
        above = [i for i in range(_NM) if (i + 0.5) / _NM > 1 - (p["keep"] / HP) + 1e-6
                 or False]
        above = [i for i in range(_NM) if -_perch(i, HP)[1] > keep]
        above.sort(key=lambda i: -i)
        na = max(1, len(above))
        per = int(math.ceil(na / 3.0))
        launch = {}
        for r, i in enumerate(above):
            j = min(2, r * 3 // na)
            launch[i] = p["u0"] + j * p["st"] + 0.35 * p["st"] + (r % per) * 0.007
        for i in range(_NM):
            px, py, _ = _perch(i, HP)
            flap = 0.62 + 0.38 * abs(math.cos(t * 3.1 + i * 1.3))
            if i not in launch or u < launch[i]:
                wx, wy = _xf(px, py, x0, BASE, keep, ang, shake, i in launch)
                _monarch(cr, wx, wy, 0.11, flap, ang if i in launch else 0.0)
            else:
                pf = clamp((u - launch[i]) / 0.26)
                if pf < 1:
                    a2, s2 = pose(p, launch[i])
                    sx, sy = _xf(px, py, x0, BASE, keep, a2, s2, True)
                    flights.append((sx, sy, pf, i, -1 if x0 < 540 else 1))

    for sx, sy, pf, i, side in flights:      # the ones leaving, up over the fence
        e = pf ** 1.6
        fx = sx + side * (180 + (i % 4) * 70) * e + 34 * math.sin(pf * 7 + i)
        fy = sy + (-160 - sy) * e
        _monarch(cr, fx, fy, 0.11 + 0.08 * pf, 0.55 + 0.45 * abs(math.cos(t * 9 + i)),
                 0.3 * side * math.sin(pf * 5 + i))

    # right by the camera: a sawn milkweed stump and its dropped leaves
    contact_shadow(cr, 130, 1770, 160, a=0.4)
    for lx, la in ((40, -0.2), (220, 0.25)):
        _leaf(cr, lx, 1790, la, 170, 56)
    cylinder(cr, 104, 1770, 52, 90, (112, 146, 82))
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points, saws the west stalk, walks east, saws it, bears its top as it falls
    if u < 0.08:
        hx = 460 - 80 * ease(seg(u, 0.03, 0.08))
        host("point", hx, BASE, 220)
    elif u < 0.36:
        hx = 380 + 310 * ease(seg(u, 0.305, 0.36))
        host("cut", hx, BASE, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.56:
        host("cut", 690, BASE, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("strain", 690, BASE, 220)

    if u >= plants[0]["f1"]:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(west[1]))}%", "of western monarchs gone",
                    60, 560, a=ease(seg(u, 0.29, 0.31)), size=120, max_w=470)
    else:
        text(cr, "Western route", 60, 600, 42, look.INK, alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)))
    if u >= 0.53:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(east[1]))}%", "of eastern monarchs gone",
                    W - 60, 560, anchor="right", a=ease(seg(u, 0.53, 0.55)),
                    size=120, max_w=470)
    else:
        text(cr, "Eastern route", W - 60, 600, 42, look.INK, anchor="right",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)))

stories.title: Why 100th Birthdays Are About To Get Normal (3 Charts)
stories.hook: Turning 100 is about to stop being rare.
stories.closing: Cake's about to need a lot more birthdays to cover.
stories.question: How old do you actually want to live to? Drop it below.
stories.caption: Only 37,306 Americans had hit 100 in 1990. Now it's 101,000 -- and the Census Bureau says 422,000 is coming by 2054. Japan already has more than double the US rate per capita. Why do some countries produce so many more centenarians? 👇

segments.say: In 1990, there were just 37,306 Americans who'd hit 100. By 2024, that number had nearly tripled to 101,000. This is now the fastest-growing age group in the country.
Japan has about 77 centenarians for every 100,000 people. The US has 30. Same modern medicine, same wealth -- Japan's diet and healthcare system just keep people alive longer.

segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a wooden baby cradle
    SUBSTANCE: swaddled twin babies
    CAUSE: Data places each new pair of swaddled twins into the cradle, so the pile rises
    Twin births per 1,000 as a pile of swaddled pairs in one big nursery
    cradle: each year that arrives, Data lifts in the extra pairs, so the heap
    rises from 1980 to 2014 and holds while the readout lands."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in by_time(pts)]
    rise = []
    for l, v in rows:
        try:
            if int(str(l)[:4]) <= 2014:
                rise.append((l, v))
        except ValueError:
            pass
    if len(rise) >= 2:
        rows = rise
    n = max(1, len(rows))
    k, f = step_through(u, n)
    k = min(k, n - 1)
    cnts = [max(1, int(round(v / 2.5))) for _, v in rows]
    prev = cnts[k - 1] if k > 0 else max(0, cnts[0] - 3)
    drop = seg(f, 0.25, 0.75)
    shown = prev + (cnts[k] - prev) * drop

def _age(label):
    d = ""
    for ch in str(label):
        if ch.isdigit():
            d += ch
        elif d:
            break
    return int(d) if d else 0


def _bottle(cr, cx, y0, y1, hw):
    nw = hw * 0.62
    mid = (y0 + 170 + y1) / 2

    cr.curve_to(cx - hw * 0.86, mid + 30, cx - hw, mid + 60, cx - hw, mid + 120)

    cr.line_to(cx + hw, mid + 120)
    cr.curve_to(cx + hw, mid + 60, cx + hw * 0.86, mid + 30, cx + hw * 0.86, mid)
    cr.curve_to(cx + hw * 0.86, mid - 30, cx + hw, mid - 60, cx + hw, y0 + 170)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant glass baby bottle
    SUBSTANCE: milk
    CAUSE: Data climbs a step-ladder and pours milk from a bucket into the bottle, one pour per age group
    Twin rate by the mother's age, poured as milk: a huge baby bottle on
    the nursery table, its nipple set aside, and Data on a step-ladder
    pouring it fuller for each older age band, youngest to oldest. Each
    pour lands, the level holds, and a mark goes on the glass. It ends on
    the oldest band, mothers over 40, beside the youngest."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: _age(r[0]))
    n = len(rows)
    if n == 0:
        return
    vmax = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    cx, y0, y1, hw = 610, 760, 1430, 190
    top_fill, bot_fill = y0 + 200, y1 - 12

    def lvl(v):
        return bot_fill - (v / vmax) * (bot_fill - top_fill)

    # the nursery at dusk
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (28, 40, 66)), (0.6, (52, 70, 104)), (1.0, (70, 88, 120))], 0, 1430)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (92, 70, 58)), (1.0, (60, 44, 38))], 1430, H)

    cr.rectangle(864, 130, 12, 290)

    cr.rectangle(720, 268, 300, 12)
    solid(cr, (236, 228, 214))

    # the table

    cr.rectangle(90, 1430, 900, 30)

    # the nipple, set aside so the bottle can be filled
    contact_shadow(cr, 900, 1432, 130, a=0.35)
    cylinder(cr, 845, 1432, 110, 42, P["accent2"], finish="gloss")
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(900, 1390, 46, math.pi, 0)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (226, 182, 122), finish="gloss")
    cr.new_path()

    solid(cr, (226, 182, 122), finish="gloss")

    # the step-ladder Data climbs
    contact_shadow(cr, 370, 1432, 170, a=0.35)
    for (xa, xb) in ((290, 330), (450, 410)):
        cr.new_path()
        cr.move_to(xa - 9, 1430)

        cr.line_to(xb + 9, 905)
        cr.line_to(xa + 9, 1430)

        solid(cr, P["log"])
    for r_ in range(5):
        ry = 1340 - r_ * 105

        xr = 450 - 40 * fr
        cr.rectangle(xl, ry - 8, xr - xl, 16)
        solid(cr, P["trunk"])
    cr.rectangle(318, 898, 112, 18)
    solid(cr, P["trunk"])

    # pours: band k arrives with progress f
    k, f = step_through(u, n, hold_first=0.24, hold_last=0.12)
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
    rise = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.75))
    cur = prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * rise
    level = lvl(cur)
    pouring = u > 0.22 and 0.08 < f < 0.8

    contact_shadow(cr, cx, y1 + 4, 2 * hw + 40, a=0.45)
    cr.save()
    _bottle(cr, cx, y0, y1, hw)
    cr.clip()
    cr.rectangle(cx - hw - 6, level, 2 * hw + 12, y1 - level + 6)
    solid(cr, (246, 242, 230), rim=False, edge=False)
    wob = 4 * math.sin(t * 6) if pouring else 0.0
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, level)
    cr.scale(hw, 16 + wob)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 253, 246)))
    cr.fill()
    if pouring:   # the stream from his bucket to the surface
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((248, 244, 232)))
        cr.set_line_width(18)
        cr.move_to(cx - 40, y0 - 10)
        cr.line_to(cx - 30, level)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    if pouring:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((248, 244, 232)))
        cr.set_line_width(18)
        cr.move_to(470, 790)
        cr.curve_to(530, 760, cx - 50, 730, cx - 40, y0 + 10)
        cr.stroke()

    # the glass over the milk, and its threads
    _bottle(cr, cx, y0, y1, hw)
    solid(cr, (205, 225, 240), finish="glass" if "glass" in FINISHES else "gloss", a=0.32)
    for i in range(3):
        ty = y0 + 12 + i * 14
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 236, 248), 0.7))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(cx - hw * 0.62, ty + 6)
        cr.line_to(cx + hw * 0.62, ty)
        cr.stroke()
    for i in range(1, 6):   # graduation marks on the glass
        gy = bot_fill - i * (bot_fill - top_fill) / 5.0
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((235, 244, 252), 0.6))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(cx - hw + 18, gy)
        cr.line_to(cx - hw + 58, gy)
        cr.stroke()

    # a mark on the glass for each band that has landed (unlabelled)
    for j in range(n):
        if j < k or (j == k and f >= 0.6):
            yj = lvl(rows[j][1])
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
            cr.set_line_width(6)
            cr.move_to(cx + hw - 30, yj)
            cr.line_to(cx + hw + 30, yj)
            cr.stroke()

    # Data's bit: point at the bottle, climb the ladder, pour, then cheer
    c = ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.22))
    fx, fy = 220 + 150 * c, 1430 - 530 * c
    if u < 0.1:
        host("point", fx, fy, 220)
    elif u < 0.22:
        host("climb", fx, fy, 220)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("pour", fx, fy, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("cheer", fx, fy, 220)

    vignette(cr, 0.3)

    hi_l, hi_v = rows[-1]
    done = k == n - 1 and f >= 0.6
    if not done:
        fit_readout(cr, "Twin rate", "rises with the mother's age",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=120)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{hi_v:g}", f"twin rate · mothers {hi_l}",
                    80, 520, a=1.0, rgb=P["accent2"], size=140)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: an IVF petri dish
    SUBSTANCE: embryos in culture medium
    CAUSE: Data shoves the glass divider across the dish, shrinking the twin-embryo side
    One IVF lab dish stands for every IVF birth in that year. A glass divider
    splits it at the twin share: on the left (accent) the embryos sit in
    PAIRS, on the right they sit alone. For each year that arrives, Data puts
    both hands flat on the divider and shoves it left, and the pairs it passes
    become single embryos. The share falls from 28% in 1997 to 2% today."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    k, f = step_through(u, n)
    move = ease(seg(f, 0.35, 0.85)) if k > 0 else 0.0
    v0 = rows[max(0, k - 1)][1]
    v1 = rows[k][1]
    share = clamp((v0 + (v1 - v0) * move) / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)

    def frac(a):
        return (a * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - a * a)) + math.asin(a) + math.pi / 2) / math.pi

    lo, hi = -1.0, 1.0
    for _ in range(32):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        if frac(mid) < share:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    a_ = (lo + hi) / 2

    def ell(cx_, cy_, rx_, ry_):
        cr.new_path()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx_, cy_)
        cr.scale(rx_, ry_)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()

    # the lab: a cool wall, a back shelf of glassware, a steel bench
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (206, 220, 232)), (1.0, (150, 168, 186))], 0, 1180)
    box(cr, 40, 1000, 1000, 22, (170, 178, 190), finish="metal")
    for i, (sx, sh) in enumerate([(90, 150), (230, 110), (720, 170), (880, 120)]):
        contact_shadow(cr, sx + 35, 1000, 80, a=0.25)
        cylinder(cr, sx, 1000, 70, sh, P["glass"], finish="glass", a=0.8)
    haze(cr, 760, 1060, (206, 220, 232), a=0.45)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (196, 204, 214)), (1.0, (96, 106, 120))], 1100, H)

    cx, cy, rx, ry = 540, 1010, 430, 250
    mrx, mry = rx - 26, ry - 18
    split = cx + mrx * a_

    # the dish: a glass base wall, then the medium
    contact_shadow(cr, cx, cy + ry + 34, 2 * rx + 40, a=0.4)
    ell(cx, cy + 34, rx, ry)
    solid(cr, P["glass"], finish="glass", a=0.9)
    ell(cx, cy, rx, ry)
    solid(cr, (226, 236, 244), finish="glass", a=0.85)
    ell(cx, cy, mrx, mry)
    solid(cr, (238, 178, 186), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    # the twin share, cut at its true proportion of the one dish
    cr.save()
    ell(cx, cy, mrx, mry)
    cr.clip()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, split, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.5))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()

    # embryos: pairs on the twin side, singles on the rest
    cr.save()
    ell(cx, cy, mrx, mry)
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(46):
        ex = cx - mrx + 40 + ((i * 197) % int(2 * mrx - 80))
        ey = cy - mry + 40 + ((i * 113 + (i // 7) * 29) % int(2 * mry - 80))
        nx, ny = (ex - cx) / mrx, (ey - cy) / mry
        if nx * nx + ny * ny > 0.82:
            continue
        if ex < split - 22:
            disc(cr, ex - 13, ey, 15, (250, 236, 226), finish="gloss")
            disc(cr, ex + 13, ey + 2, 15, (250, 236, 226), finish="gloss")
        else:
            disc(cr, ex, ey, 17, (250, 240, 232), finish="gloss")
    cr.restore()

    # the glass divider he pushes
    half = mry * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - a_ * a_))
    box(cr, split - 12, cy + half + 8, 24, 2 * half + 50, P["glass"], depth=10,
        finish="glass", a=0.92)
    # the dish's rim catches the key light
    ell(cx, cy, rx, ry)
    edge(cr, (250, 252, 255), width=6, a=0.8)

    # a pipette hanging over the dish: this is an IVF lab
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(880, 330)
    cr.line_to(910, 330)
    cr.line_to(902, 760)
    cr.line_to(894, 800)
    cr.line_to(888, 760)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, P["glass"], finish="glass", a=0.85)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.rectangle(870, 250, 50, 90)
    solid(cr, (200, 70, 80), finish="gloss")

    vignette(cr, 0.3)

    # his bit: walk up and point, shove the divider once per year, cheer
    fy = cy + 70
    if u < 0.22:
        w = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.2))
        host("point", split + 320 - 250 * w, fy, 220)
    elif u < 0.86:
        host("shove", split + 70, fy, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("cheer", split + 70, fy, 220)

    lab, val = landed(rows, k, f)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val:.0f}%", f"of IVF births were twins · {lab}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=150)
    ta = ease(seg(u, 0.05, 0.15))
    if split - (cx - mrx) > 120:
        text(cr, "twins", (cx - mrx + split) / 2, cy - mry - 20, 40,
             P["accent2"], anchor="center", alpha=ta)
    text(cr, "singles", (split + cx + mrx) / 2, cy - mry - 20, 40, look.INK,
         anchor="center", alpha=ta)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.94))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{rows[0][1]:.0f}% → {rows[-1][1]:.0f}%",
                    f"{rows[0][0]} to {rows[-1][0]}", W / 2, 1380, anchor="center",
                    a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=80)

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 26, 40), a))

    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _tub_path(cr, inset=0.0):
    # The baby bath: a straight rim, sides that slope and round into a
    # flat bottom.
    x0, x1, top, bot = 150 + inset, 930 - inset, 820 + inset, 1220 - inset
    cr.move_to(x0, top)
    cr.line_to(x1, top)
    cr.curve_to(x1 - 20, top + 250, x1 - 60, bot, x1 - 180, bot)
    cr.line_to(x0 + 180, bot)
    cr.curve_to(x0 + 60, bot, x0 + 20, top + 250, x0, top)
    cr.close_path()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a baby bath full of water
    SUBSTANCE: blue bathwater
    CAUSE: Data turns the drain valve under the bath and the water runs out to each year's lower level
    The closing: one clear baby bath on its stand is every IVF birth of a
    year. The water in it is the twin share, two rubber ducks riding on
    it. For each year that arrives Data turns the drain valve once, water
    pours out of the spout into the floor drain, and the level settles at
    that year's share, from 28% down to 2%. He ends looking at what is
    left: the ducks resting on the bottom."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]) or [("now", 0.0)]
    n = len(rows)
    k, f = step_through(u, n, hold_first=0.28, hold_last=0.16)
    k = int(clamp(k, 0, n - 1))
    drain = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.75)) if k > 0 else 0.0   # after the turn lands
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else rows[0][1]
    share = clamp((prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * drain) / 100.0)
    flow = math.sin(math.pi * drain) if k > 0 else 0.0

    # the nursery bathroom at dawn: painted wall, a window, a wooden floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (236, 214, 190)), (0.6, (214, 186, 160)), (1, (186, 156, 132))],
          0, 1190)
    cr.rectangle(620, 160, 360, 420)
    solid(cr, (250, 246, 236), rim=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (255, 196, 150)), (0.6, (250, 222, 180)), (1, (200, 220, 236))],
          190, 550, 650, 950)
    cr.rectangle(796, 190, 8, 360)
    cr.rectangle(650, 366, 300, 8)
    solid(cr, (250, 246, 236), rim=False, edge=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 132, 96)), (1, (122, 88, 62))], 1180, H)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1170, W, 18)
    solid(cr, (240, 232, 220))
    # a towel rail with a towel on the left wall
    cylinder(cr, 40, 690, 14, 8, (190, 194, 204), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(20, 600, 100, 14)
    solid(cr, (190, 194, 204), finish="metal")
    cr.move_to(28, 612)
    cr.line_to(112, 612)
    cr.line_to(116, 860)
    cr.line_to(24, 860)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (232, 160, 170))
    for yy in (800, 820):
        cr.rectangle(26, yy, 88, 8)
        solid(cr, (250, 238, 240), rim=False, edge=False)
    haze(cr, 0, 1190, (240, 220, 200), a=0.15)

    # the folding stand, under its shadow
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1478, 760, a=0.4)
    for (a0, b0) in (((280, 1200), (780, 1476)), ((800, 1200), (300, 1476))):
        cr.move_to(*a0)
        cr.line_to(*b0)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 124, 134)))
        cr.set_line_width(24)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.move_to(a0[0] - 4, a0[1] - 4)
        cr.line_to(b0[0] - 4, b0[1] - 4)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 218, 226), 0.8))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.stroke()
    for fx in (300, 780):
        box(cr, fx - 30, 1484, 60, 16, (90, 92, 100), finish="metal")

    # the drain: pipe down, the valve, the spout over the floor drain
    VX, VY, OX = 870, 1330, 990
    cr.move_to(790, 1210)
    cr.line_to(790, VY)
    cr.line_to(OX, VY)
    cr.line_to(OX, 1392)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 156, 168)))
    cr.set_line_width(26)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(784, 1210)
    cr.line_to(784, VY - 6)
    cr.line_to(OX - 6, VY - 6)
    cr.line_to(OX - 6, 1392)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((226, 230, 238), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.35)
    cr.arc(OX, 1484 / 0.35, 52, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (60, 52, 50), finish="metal")
    rot = (max(0, k - 1) + drain) * math.pi * 0.9     # the wheel turns as it drains
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 56, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    cr.arc(VX, VY, 32, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    for j in range(4):
        aj = rot + j * math.pi / 2
        cr.move_to(VX, VY)
        cr.line_to(VX + 32 * math.cos(aj), VY + 32 * math.sin(aj))
        cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, VX, VY, 10, (210, 70, 60), finish="gloss")
    if flow > 0.02:                                   # the water running out
        g = cairo.LinearGradient(OX - 10, 0, OX + 10, 0)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, *_c((70, 140, 210), 0.9))
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0.5, *_c((150, 205, 245), 0.95))
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, *_c((50, 110, 190), 0.9))
        cr.set_source(g)
        wd = 18 * flow
        cr.rectangle(OX - wd / 2, 1392, wd, 88)
        cr.fill()
        cr.save()
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.3)
        cr.arc(OX, 1482 / 0.3, 30 * flow + 6 * math.sin(t * 9), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 215, 245), 0.7 * flow))
        cr.fill()

    # the water inside the clear bath, at the share; two ducks ride on it
    TOP_IN, BOT_IN = 840.0, 1206.0
    lvl = BOT_IN - share * (BOT_IN - TOP_IN)
    cr.save()
    _tub_path(cr, 14)
    cr.clip()
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, lvl, 0, BOT_IN)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, *_c((96, 176, 232), 0.95))
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, *_c((38, 104, 186), 0.95))
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.rectangle(0, lvl, W, H - lvl)
    cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(0, lvl)
    for i in range(1, 41):
        x = W * i / 40
        cr.line_to(x, lvl + 3 * math.sin(t * 2.2 + i * 0.7) * (0.4 + flow))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 242, 255), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    for j, dx_ in enumerate((440, 590)):
        bob = 5 * math.sin(t * 1.6 + j * 1.9) * (1.0 if share > 0.04 else 0.0)
        _duck(cr, dx_, min(lvl, BOT_IN - 22) + bob, 0.85)

    # the bath itself: clear plastic, a rolled rim, a highlight
    _tub_path(cr)
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(150, 0, 930, 0)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, *_c((214, 236, 250), 0.30))
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, *_c((150, 186, 214), 0.42))
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.fill_preserve()
    edge(cr, (40, 64, 96), width=5)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(196, 870)
    cr.curve_to(206, 1010, 236, 1120, 300, 1180)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(128, 804)
    cr.line_to(952, 804)
    cr.curve_to(966, 804, 966, 836, 952, 836)
    cr.line_to(128, 836)
    cr.curve_to(114, 836, 114, 804, 128, 804)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (226, 234, 244), finish="gloss")
    # the share, marked in the accent beside the water it measures
    cr.move_to(118, BOT_IN)
    cr.line_to(104, BOT_IN)
    cr.line_to(104 - 0.0 * share, lvl)
    cr.line_to(118, lvl)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    cr.stroke()

    # Data: walks over to the valve, turns it once per year, then looks
    # at the ducks sitting on the bottom
    walking = u < 0.24
    dx = 240 + 560 * ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.24))
    if walking:
        role, bk = "point", 0
    elif u < 0.9:
        role, bk = "tap", k
    else:
        role, bk = "think", 0
    contact_shadow(cr, dx, 1490, 130, a=0.4)
    host(role, dx, 1490, 220, pace=walking, beat=bk)

    vignette(cr, 0.3)

    lab, val = landed(rows, k, f)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val:.0f}%", f"of IVF births were twins · {lab}", 80, 640,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), size=120)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.96))
    if b > 0:
        text(cr, f"{rows[0][1]:.0f}% \u2192 {rows[-1][1]:.0f}%", 80, 760, 64,
             P["accent2"], face="display", anchor="left", alpha=b)

def _ship(cr, x0, L, deck, wl, a=1.0, ghost=False):
    cr.move_to(x0, deck)
    cr.line_to(x0 + L - 70, deck)
    cr.line_to(x0 + L, deck - 14)
    cr.line_to(x0 + L - 46, wl + 40)
    cr.line_to(x0 + 36, wl + 40)
    cr.line_to(x0 - 6, wl + 6)
    cr.close_path()
    if ghost:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 240, 250), 0.35 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.set_dash([14, 10])
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])
    else:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 44, 62), a))
        cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The biggest box ship of each year, afloat: the hull stretches and the
    container stack climbs row by row as capacity grows from the first year
    to the last. Data hauls each new tier of boxes up onto the stack and
    rides it higher, the old ship's outline left behind as a ghost."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in by_time(list(pts))]
    n = len(rows)
    vmax = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    k, f = step_through(u, n)
    grow = ease(clamp(f / 0.55))
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else rows[0][1]
    val = rows[k][1] if k == 0 else prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * grow
    frac = val / vmax

    # sky and harbour water, full height
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (22, 38, 70)), (0.45, (88, 128, 170)), (0.58, (196, 206, 214)),
               (0.60, (40, 78, 110)), (1.0, (12, 30, 50))], 0, H)
    glow(cr, 830, 620, 320, P["sun_glow"], 0.5)
    wl = 1230
    # distant cranes on the far shore
    for i, cx in enumerate((110, 250, 930)):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 64, 86)))
        cr.rectangle(cx, 1000 + 20 * (i % 2), 14, 150)
        cr.fill()
        cr.rectangle(cx - 60, 1000 + 20 * (i % 2), 150, 12)
        cr.fill()
    # slow swells
    for j in range(6):
        y = wl + 60 + j * 44
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 190, 220), 0.25))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        for x in range(0, W + 40, 40):
            cr.line_to(x, y + 6 * math.sin(x * 0.02 + t * 0.8 + j))
        cr.stroke()
    # the quay he starts on
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 78)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1500, 300, H - 1500)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["curb"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1492, 300, 14)
    cr.fill()

    bob = 4 * math.sin(t * 0.9)
    # ghost of the first year's ship, once the ship has outgrown it
    r0 = rows[0][1] / vmax
    L0 = 340 + 600 * r0
    if val > rows[0][1] + 1:
        gh = 60 + 60 * r0
        _ship(cr, 540 - L0 / 2, L0, wl - gh + bob, wl + bob, a=clamp((frac - r0) * 4),
              ghost=True)

    L = 340 + 600 * frac
    x0 = 540 - L / 2
    hull_h = 60 + 60 * frac
    deck = wl - hull_h + bob
    # container stack: towers of boxes along the deck, tapering at the ends
    box_w, box_h = 42, 34
    stack_h = 60 + 300 * frac
    ncol = max(1, int((L - 170) / (box_w + 4)))
    cols = [P["brick"], P["cool"], P["brass"], (70, 110, 90), (150, 60, 50), (90, 96, 110)]
    for c in range(ncol):
        cx = x0 + 120 + c * (box_w + 4)
        edge = min(c, ncol - 1 - c)
        h = stack_h * (0.7 + 0.3 * clamp(edge / 3))
        nr = int(h / box_h)
        part = (h / box_h) - nr
        for r in range(nr + 1):
            a = 1.0 if r < nr else part
            if a <= 0.02:
                continue
            y = deck - (r + 1) * box_h - (1 - a) * 40
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(cols[(c * 7 + r * 3) % len(cols)], a))
            cr.rectangle(cx, y, box_w, box_h - 3)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((0, 0, 0), 0.25 * a))
            cr.set_line_width(2)
            for s in range(1, 4):
                cr.move_to(cx + s * box_w / 4, y + 4)
                cr.line_to(cx + s * box_w / 4, y + box_h - 7)
            cr.stroke()
    # bridge tower at the stern
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 234, 238)))
    cr.rectangle(x0 + 30, deck - stack_h - 70, 70, stack_h + 70)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 196, 130)))
    cr.rectangle(x0 + 36, deck - stack_h - 60, 58, 16)
    cr.fill()
    _ship(cr, x0, L, deck, wl + bob)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["redline"]))
    cr.rectangle(x0 + 20, wl + bob + 8, L - 70, 10)
    cr.fill()

    # his bit: points at the ship from the quay, climbs aboard, hauls each
    # new tier of boxes up and holds it as it lands, cheers the giant
    stand_y = deck - stack_h * 0.7
    stand_x = x0 + L * (0.3 + 0.45 * seg(u, 0.28, 0.86))
    cl = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.28))
    hx = 170 + (stand_x - 170) * cl
    hy = 1490 + (stand_y - 1490) * cl
    if u < 0.12:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.28:
        role = "climb"
    elif u > 0.88:
        role = "cheer"
    elif k > 0 and f < 0.55:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "hold_up"
    host(role, hx, hy, 210)

    ll, lv = landed(rows, k, f)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(lv)):,} TEU", f"biggest container ship · {ll}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=140)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.94))
    if b > 0 and rows[0][1] > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{rows[-1][1] / rows[0][1]:.1f}x", f"the {rows[0][0]} ship",
                    W / 2, 1360, anchor="center", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=90)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in by_time(pts)]
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    ratio = max(1.0, v1 / (v0 or 1.0))

    # the fleet grows in five heaves: the crane lowers a tier, the pile swells,
    # the hook swings back up for the next one, a brief hold, again
    n_steps = 5
    a0, b0 = 0.08, 0.84
    xs = clamp((u - a0) / (b0 - a0)) * n_steps
    i_step = min(int(xs), n_steps - 1)
    fr = xs - i_step if xs < n_steps else 1.0
    active = a0 < u < b0
    grow_fr = clamp(fr / 0.55)
    back_fr = clamp((fr - 0.55) / 0.3)
    p = clamp((i_step + ease(grow_fr)) / n_steps)
    growing = active and 0.0 < fr < 0.55

    # sky, sea, quay: the whole frame
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (22, 30, 58)), (0.45, (70, 78, 118)), (0.62, (196, 132, 104)),
               (1.0, (40, 44, 58))], 0, H)
    glow(cr, 250, 1080, 300, P["sun_glow"], 0.55)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (34, 62, 92)), (1.0, (18, 34, 56))], 1090, 1400)
    for k in range(9):                        # swell rolling into the harbour
        y = 1110 + k * 32
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 160, 196), 0.18))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        for x in range(0, W + 40, 40):
            cr.line_to(x, y + 5 * math.sin(x * 0.02 + t * 1.2 + k))
        cr.stroke()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, P["curb"]), (1.0, (54, 56, 62))], 1400, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 200, 60), 0.8))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1400, W, 8)
    cr.fill()

    # the container mountain: its AREA is the fleet's capacity
    cx, base = 540, 1400
    w_big, h_big = 900.0, 760.0
    f = 1.0 + (ratio - 1.0) * p
    sc = math.sqrt(f / ratio)
    w, h = w_big * sc, h_big * sc
    nl = 7
    lh = h / nl
    cols = [P["brick"], P["brick_cool"], P["brass"], (74, 108, 140), P["brick_shade"],
            (150, 156, 164)]

    def layer_w(j):
        return w * (1.0 - j * 0.11)

    g_sc = math.sqrt(1.0 / ratio)
    gw, gh = w_big * g_sc, h_big * g_sc
    for j in range(nl):
        ww = layer_w(j)
        bw = max(18.0, lh * 2.3)
        nb = max(1, int(ww / bw))
        bw = ww / nb
        y = base - (j + 1) * lh
        for b in range(nb):
            x = cx - ww / 2 + b * bw
            col = cols[(b * 3 + j * 5) % len(cols)]
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
            cr.rectangle(x + 1, y + 1, bw - 2, lh - 2)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)   # corrugation ribs
            cr.set_line_width(1.5)
            for r_ in range(1, 4):
                rx = x + bw * r_ / 4
                cr.move_to(rx, y + 3)
                cr.line_to(rx, y + lh - 3)
            cr.stroke()
    # the 1990 fleet's outline left on the quay, dashed
    ga = 0.9 * ease(seg(u, 0.14, 0.26))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK, ga))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.set_dash([14, 10])
    for j in range(nl):
        ww = gw * (1.0 - j * 0.11)
        cr.rectangle(cx - ww / 2, base - (j + 1) * gh / nl, ww, gh / nl)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])
    if ga > 0:
        text(cr, l0, cx, base - gh - 14, 34, look.INK, anchor="center", alpha=ga)

    # the gantry crane: lowers each tier onto the peak, then swings back up
    top_y = base - h
    boom_out = 1.0 - ease(seg(u, 0.88, 0.97))      # boom retracts once it's done
    tx, ty = 990, 600
    bx0 = tx - (tx - (cx - 60)) * boom_out
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 180, 60)))
    cr.rectangle(tx - 14, ty, 28, base - ty)
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(bx0, ty - 16, tx - bx0 + 30, 22)
    cr.fill()
    rest_y = ty + 60
    low_y = top_y - 40
    if not active:
        hook_y = rest_y
        hx = cx + (tx - 60 - cx) * (1.0 - boom_out)
        box_a = 0.0
    elif fr < 0.55:
        hook_y = rest_y + (low_y - rest_y) * ease(grow_fr)
        hx = cx + 160 * (1.0 - ease(clamp(grow_fr * 2)))   # swings in from the sea side
        box_a = 1.0 - clamp((grow_fr - 0.85) / 0.15)
    else:
        hook_y = low_y + (rest_y - low_y) * ease(back_fr)
        hx = cx + 160 * ease(back_fr)
        box_a = 0.0
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.move_to(hx, ty)
    cr.line_to(hx, hook_y)
    cr.stroke()
    if box_a > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], box_a))
        cr.rectangle(hx - 70, hook_y, 140, 46)
        cr.fill()

    # Data: points from the quay, climbs the mountain, heaves each new tier
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1))
    lvl = min(p * nl, nl - 0.001)
    jw = layer_w(min(int(lvl), nl - 1))
    hx_d = cx - jw / 2 + 50
    hy_d = base - lvl * lh
    summit = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.95))            # finally strides onto the peak
    hx_d = hx_d + (cx - 40 - hx_d) * summit
    hy_d = hy_d + (top_y - hy_d) * summit
    dx = 150 + (hx_d - 150) * walk_in
    dy = base + (hy_d - base) * walk_in
    if u < 0.08:
        role = "point"
    elif u > 0.9:
        role = "cheer"
    elif growing:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "climb"
    host(role, dx, dy, 220)

    # the readout: only the two sourced values, each held long enough to read
    if p < 1.0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v0:.1f}M boxes", f"whole world fleet · {l0}", 80, 480,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.06)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1:.1f}M boxes", f"whole world fleet · {l1}", 80, 480,
                    a=1.0, size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.8, 0.88))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}× the {l0} fleet", "capacity in TEU", W - 80, 1470,
                    anchor="right", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=64)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """World trade, by volume, as one heap of the world's goods on a quay.
    The heap drops in bundle by bundle, then Data climbs it and heaves the sea
    share over the quay edge, one netted bundle at a time, into a barge that
    settles lower with every load. When the sea's share is aboard, the barge
    steams off to sea, and the small remainder is left on the quay."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    (ls, vs) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    others = [r for r in rows if r[0] != ls]
    lr = others[0][0] if others else "everything else"
    share = vs / tot
    n = 5
    nsea = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(share * n))))

    # sky and sea, full height
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (92, 140, 196)), (0.55, (236, 190, 150)), (1.0, (250, 214, 170))], 0, H)
    glow(cr, 820, 700, 320, P["sun_glow"], 0.7)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun"]))
    cr.arc(820, 700, 80, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (70, 120, 160)), (1.0, (22, 48, 82))], 860, H)
    for r_ in range(10):                          # the swell rolls in
        wy = 890 + r_ * 66
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 225, 240), 0.26 + 0.02 * r_))
        cr.set_line_width(3 + r_ * 0.4)
        for i in range(28):
            x = i * 40
            y = wy + 10 * math.sin(x * 0.02 + t * 1.4 + r_)
            if i == 0:
                cr.move_to(x, y)
            else:
                cr.line_to(x, y)
        cr.stroke()

    # the quay
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((118, 110, 104)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1200, 800, H - 1200)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((160, 150, 140)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1200, 800, 18)
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(8):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((88, 80, 76)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(k * 100 + (50 if k % 2 else 0), 1240)
        cr.line_to(k * 100 + (50 if k % 2 else 0), H)
        cr.stroke()

    def bundle(x, y, k, s=1.0, a=1.0):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x, y)
        cr.scale(s if k % 2 == 0 else -s, s)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((176, 120, 70), a))          # crate
        cr.rectangle(-104, -92, 96, 92)
        cr.fill_preserve()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 60, 36), a))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.move_to(-104, -92)
        cr.line_to(-8, 0)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 104, 140), a))          # barrel
        cr.rectangle(4, -112, 78, 112)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 56, 80), a))
        for by in (-92, -56, -20):
            cr.rectangle(4, by, 78, 8)
            cr.fill()
        cr.restore()
        sack(cr, x - 50 * (1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1) * s, y - 90 * s, 0.7 * s, a=a, label=False)
        sack(cr, x + 40 * (1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1) * s, y - 110 * s, 0.55 * s, a=a, label=False)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 52, 36), a))            # the cargo net
        cr.set_line_width(4 * s)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x, y - 88 * s)
        cr.scale(122 * s, 96 * s)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, math.pi * 0.95, math.pi * 2.05)
        cr.restore()
        cr.stroke()
        for q in (-0.5, 0.0, 0.5):
            cr.move_to(x + q * 200 * s, y)
            cr.line_to(x + q * 60 * s, y - 180 * s)
            cr.stroke()

    slots = [(230, 1200), (450, 1200), (670, 1200), (340, 1040), (560, 1040)]
    order = [4, 2, 3, 1, 0]
    sea = order[:nsea]
    t0, t1 = 0.26, 0.78
    span = (t1 - t0) / nsea
    win = {k: (t0 + j * span, t0 + j * span + 0.85 * span) for j, k in enumerate(sea)}
    # the barge settles as each load lands, then steams off and keeps going
    nland = sum(ease(seg(u, win[k][1] - 0.01, win[k][1] + 0.05)) for k in sea)
    go = seg(u, 0.80, 1.0)
    off = 260 * go * go
    sink = 10 * nland + 4 * math.sin(t * 1.6)
    bx = 800 + off

    deck = 1250 + sink

    cr.move_to(bx, deck)
    cr.line_to(bx + 270, deck)
    cr.line_to(bx + 240, deck + 80)
    cr.line_to(bx + 30, deck + 80)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 236, 226)))
    cr.rectangle(bx, deck, 270, 10)
    cr.fill()
    if off > 2:                                   # wake as she steams off
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 240, 248), 0.6))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(bx + 20, deck + 70)
        cr.line_to(bx + 20 - 0.8 * off, deck + 78)
        cr.stroke()
    la = ease(seg(u, t1, t1 + 0.04))
    if la > 0:
        text(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%", bx + 135, deck + 62, 48,
             look.INK, face="display", anchor="center", alpha=la)

    moving = None
    for i, k in enumerate([0, 1, 2, 3, 4]):
        sx, sy = slots[k]
        dp = seg(u, 0.01 + i * 0.035, 0.07 + i * 0.035)   # the heap drops in
        drop_y = -420 * (1 - dp * dp)
        if k not in win:
            bundle(sx, sy + drop_y, k, a=clamp(dp * 4))
            continue
        a0, a1 = win[k]
        p = ease(seg(u, a0, a1))
        j = sea.index(k)
        tx = bx + 70 + (j % 2) * 130
        ty = deck - (j // 2) * 100
        x = sx + (tx - sx) * p
        y = sy + drop_y + (ty - sy) * p - 200 * math.sin(math.pi * p)
        bundle(x, y, k, 1.0 - 0.52 * p, a=clamp(dp * 4))
        if a0 <= u < a1:
            moving = (k, x, y)

    # water laps over the barge's waterline
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 64, 100), 0.55))
    cr.rectangle(bx, deck + 58, 280, 40)
    cr.fill()

    # Data: walks up pointing as the heap lands, climbs it, heaves bundle
    # after bundle off it (stepping to each one), then hops down to cheer
    def spot(k):
        sx, sy = slots[k]
        return sx - 130, (900 if sy < 1100 else 1060)

    if u < 0.18:
        w = ease(seg(u, 0.02, 0.18))
        role, hx, fy = "point", 60 + 60 * w, 1200
    elif u < t0:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.18, t0))
        role, hx, fy = "climb", 120 + 220 * c, 1200 - 300 * c
    elif u < 0.80:
        role = "strain"
        px, py = 340, 900
        hx, fy = px, py
        for k in sea:
            a0, _ = win[k]
            nx, ny = spot(k)
            m = ease(seg(u, a0 - 0.12 * span, a0))
            hx = px + (nx - px) * m
            fy = py + (ny - py) * m
            if u < a0:
                break
            px, py = nx, ny
        if moving:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 52, 36)))
            cr.set_line_width(5)
            cr.move_to(hx + 40, fy - 120)
            cr.line_to(moving[1], moving[2] - 90)
            cr.stroke()
    else:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.80, 0.88))
        lx, ly = spot(sea[-1])
        role = "cheer"
        hx = lx + (700 - lx) * c
        fy = ly + (1200 - ly) * c - 140 * math.sin(math.pi * c)
    host(role, hx, fy, 210)

    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%",
                f"of world trade, by volume, goes {ls.lower()}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), size=150)
    ra = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.88))
    if ra > 0:
        text(cr, f"{int(round((1 - share) * 100))}%", 230, 960, 80, look.INK,
             face="display", anchor="center", alpha=ra)
        text(cr, lr, 230, 1000, fit_size(cr, lr, 34, 300), look.INK,
             anchor="center", alpha=ra)

stories.closing_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The closing, out at sea at dusk: one ship steams in alone carrying the
    biggest year's load. Data climbs the stack, finds ONE box (yours) and
    lifts it overhead. Then the rest of the stack lights up column by column,
    a floating city of other people's orders, and the ship steams on."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in by_time(pts)]
    (l1, v1) = rows[-1]
    lamp = P["window"][0][1]                  # the window token is a gradient
    # full-height ground: dusk sky over open sea
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (22, 26, 70)), (0.55, (96, 70, 150)), (1.0, (240, 150, 120))], 0, 1010)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (40, 60, 110)), (0.4, (22, 36, 78)), (1.0, (10, 16, 40))], 1000, H)
    glow(cr, 200, 1000, 260, P["sun_glow"], 0.55)
    for i in range(9):                       # long swells rolling under the hull
        wy = 1040 + i * 58
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 180, 230), 0.22 + 0.04 * (i % 3)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(0, wy)
        for x in range(0, W + 40, 40):
            cr.line_to(x, wy + 10 * math.sin(x * 0.012 + t * 1.6 + i))
        cr.stroke()
    # the ship steams in, holds while the story plays out, then steams on
    dx = 320 * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.14))) - 240 * ease(seg(u, 0.88, 1.0))
    bob = 6 * math.sin(t * 1.1)
    deck = 1180 + bob
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(dx, 0)
    # wake behind the stern
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 230, 250), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for k in range(3):
        cr.move_to(1040, deck + 190 + k * 16)
        cr.line_to(1040 + 160 + 40 * k + 20 * math.sin(t * 2 + k), deck + 200 + k * 26)
        cr.stroke()
    # the hull, HERO of the frame
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 40, 58)))
    cr.move_to(40, deck)
    cr.line_to(1050, deck - 30)
    cr.line_to(1000, deck + 210)
    cr.line_to(110, deck + 210)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["redline"]))
    cr.rectangle(100, deck + 170, 905, 40)
    cr.fill()
    # bridge tower
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 224, 232)))
    cr.rectangle(60, deck - 300, 70, 300)
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(4):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(lamp, 0.9))
        cr.rectangle(70, deck - 285 + k * 60, 50, 18)
        cr.fill()
    # the stack: 12 columns x 6 tiers of mixed-colour boxes
    cols, tiers, bw, bh, x0 = 12, 6, 70, 62, 150
    colours = [P["brick"], P["brick_cool"], P["brass"], (60, 110, 150),
               (90, 130, 80), P["brick_shade"], (70, 80, 120)]
    mine_c, mine_r = 8, tiers - 1
    wave = seg(u, 0.55, 0.86) * cols      # the city lights up, column by column
    for c in range(cols):
        lit = clamp(wave - c)
        for r in range(tiers):
            bx = x0 + c * bw
            by = deck - (r + 1) * bh - c * 2.5
            if (c, r) == (mine_c, mine_r):
                continue
            col = colours[(c * 3 + r * 5) % len(colours)]
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
            cr.rectangle(bx + 2, by + 2, bw - 4, bh - 4)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((0, 0, 0), 0.25))
            cr.set_line_width(2)
            for k in range(1, 5):
                cr.move_to(bx + k * bw / 5, by + 6)
                cr.line_to(bx + k * bw / 5, by + bh - 6)
            cr.stroke()
            if lit > 0:                     # someone's order in there, lit
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(lamp, 0.75 * lit))
                cr.rectangle(bx + 14, by + 18, bw - 28, bh - 36)
                cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    # his bit: point at the stack, climb it to YOUR box, lift it, cheer
    sx = x0 + mine_c * bw + bw / 2
    top = deck - tiers * bh - mine_c * 2.5
    cl = ease(seg(u, 0.14, 0.5))
    hx = 230 + (sx - 230) * cl
    fy = deck - (deck - top) * clamp(cl * 1.6)
    lift = ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.6))
    role = ("point" if u < 0.14 else "climb" if u < 0.5 else
            "hold_up" if u < 0.88 else "cheer")
    host(role, hx + dx, fy, 210)
    # your box: glowing, lifted over his head — drawn after him, he holds it
    by = top - lift * 250
    bxc = sx + dx
    glow(cr, bxc, by + bh / 2, 120, P["readout"],
         0.35 + 0.4 * ease(seg(u, 0.14, 0.3)))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["readout"]))
    cr.rectangle(bxc - bw / 2 + 2, by + 2, bw - 4, bh - 4)
    cr.fill()
    text(cr, "YOURS", bxc, by + bh / 2 + 8, 20, (40, 30, 20), anchor="center",
         shadow=False)
    a1 = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1))
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1)):,} TEU", f"one ship · {l1}", 80, 560,
                a=a1, size=110, max_w=440)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.6, 0.72))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, "yours + everyone's", "all on one hull",
                    W / 2, deck + 110, anchor="center", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"],
                    size=64, max_w=860)
stories.hook_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The hook: one ship swallowing a highway. Trucks run down the quay and
    vanish up the stern ramp, one after another. Every truck that goes in adds
    a box, so the ship's skyline rises and the hull settles lower in the water.
    Data drags one more box along the quay, climbs the ramp and heaves it onto
    the stack. The whole line of trucks ends up inside one hull."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in by_time(pts)]
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    ratio = max(1.0, v1 / (v0 or 1.0))

    # sky and sea, full height
    vgrad(cr, P["dawn"], 0, 1060)
    glow(cr, 820, 420, 360, P["sun_glow"], 0.7)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun"]))
    cr.arc(820, 420, 80, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (40, 72, 104)), (1.0, (22, 44, 70))], 1040, 1340)

    # the hull settles as the trucks pour in
    load = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.8))
    sink = 28 * load
    deck = 1000 + sink
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 40, 56)))
    cr.move_to(-60, deck)
    cr.line_to(1140, deck)
    cr.line_to(1100, 1270 + sink)
    cr.line_to(-20, 1270 + sink)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brick_shade"]))
    cr.rectangle(-40, 1200 + sink, 1160, 70)
    cr.fill()

    # the bridge tower
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper"]))
    cr.rectangle(870, deck - 250, 110, 250)
    cr.fill()
    for r_ in range(4):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 196, 130)))
        cr.rectangle(882, deck - 236 + r_ * 56, 86, 22)
        cr.fill()

    # the skyline of boxes: each column rises as the trucks go aboard
    tones = [(78, 96, 124), (128, 76, 64), (92, 112, 94), (150, 140, 118),
             (104, 88, 120)]
    fill = 0.45 + 0.55 * load
    lift_col = 4
    col_tops = {}
    for i in range(20):
        x = 18 + i * 42
        hi = 4 + (i * 5 + 3) % 5
        f = hi * fill
        n = int(f)
        part = f - n
        for r_ in range(n + 1):
            a = 1.0 if r_ < n else part
            if a <= 0.02:
                continue
            y = deck - (r_ + 1) * 36 + (1 - a) * -40
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(tones[(i * 3 + r_) % len(tones)], a))
            cr.rectangle(x, y, 38, 33)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 22, 30), 0.35 * a))
            cr.set_line_width(2)
            for k in range(1, 4):
                cr.move_to(x + k * 9.5, y + 4)
                cr.line_to(x + k * 9.5, y + 29)
            cr.stroke()
        col_tops[i] = deck - (n + (1 if part > 0.5 else 0)) * 36

    # waterline sits over the hull's belly
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 52, 80), 0.9))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1236, W, 100)
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(6):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["mist"], 0.35))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        wx = (k * 190 + 40 * math.sin(t * 0.8 + k)) % W
        cr.move_to(wx, 1250 + (k % 3) * 18)
        cr.line_to(wx + 70, 1250 + (k % 3) * 18)
        cr.stroke()

    # the quay
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (118, 116, 110)), (1.0, (84, 82, 78))], 1320, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["curb"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1320, W, 14)
    cr.fill()

    # the stern ramp
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 84)))
    cr.move_to(300, 1470)
    cr.line_to(420, 1470)
    cr.line_to(230, deck)
    cr.line_to(130, deck)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()

    # the line of trucks, each vanishing up the ramp
    for k in range(7):
        s_ = (t * 0.85 + k / 7.0) % 1.0
        tx = 1200 - s_ * 860
        ty = 1430 - 380 * clamp((380 - tx) / 120.0) if tx < 380 else 1430
        a = 1.0 - clamp((420 - tx) / 90.0)
        if a > 0:
            truck(cr, tx, ty, 0.8, a=a)

    # Data's bit: he points, drags a box down the quay, climbs the ramp,
    # then heaves it up onto the stack
    walk_a = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.45))
    climb = ease(seg(u, 0.45, 0.72))
    hx = 820 - 460 * walk_a - 170 * climb
    fy = 1500 - (1500 - deck) * climb
    if u < 0.12:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.45:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.72:
        role = "climb"
    elif u < 0.88:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"

    # the box he carries, in the story's accent
    up = ease(seg(u, 0.72, 0.86))
    bx0, by0 = hx - 24, fy - 250
    bx1 = 18 + lift_col * 42
    by1 = col_tops.get(lift_col, deck) - 36
    bx = bx0 + (bx1 - bx0) * up
    by = by0 + (by1 - by0) * up
    if u < 0.12:
        bx, by = 720, 1440
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.rectangle(bx, by, 46, 36)
    cr.fill()
    host(role, hx, fy, 210)

    # the number, stated from frame one
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1)):,}", f"truckloads on one ship · {l1}",
                80, 520, a=1.0, size=150)
    text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}× the {l0} record", W - 80, 690, 44, look.INK,
         anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.65)))

stories.closing: Eighty years without a single wild wolf. It didn't take long to fix.
stories.question: Would you want wolves reintroduced near you? Tell me below.

stories.title: The Third Visitor From Outside Our Solar System
stories.hook: Something from deep space just blasted past your planet at 246,000 kilometers an hour.
stories.closing: Three visitors, ever. Each one bigger.
stories.question: Will we ever catch one? Tell me.
stories.caption: Only 3 objects have ever been confirmed passing through our solar system from interstellar space -- 'Oumuamua in 2017, Borisov in 2019, and 3I/ATLAS in 2025. Each one found has been bigger and faster than the last, and this one is the biggest yet: up to 5.6 km wide, moving at 246,000 km/h. Do you think we'll ever catch up to one? 👇

segments.say: In 2006, a cold-loving fungus showed up in one New York cave. By 2018 it had reached 32 states. Today it's confirmed in 35.
That fungus is called white-nose syndrome, and it's brutal -- it's killed off 97 percent of northern long-eared bats and 90 percent of little brown bats in under a decade.

def _urn_bucket(cr, bx, by, ang, ash):
    """A small ash scoop-pail held at its handle, tipped by ang (radians)."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(bx, by)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.move_to(-36, -30)
    cr.line_to(36, -30)
    cr.line_to(27, 30)
    cr.line_to(-27, 30)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 156, 170)))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 88)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ash))
    cr.rectangle(-32, -30, 64, 9)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    return bx + 36 * ca + 30 * sa, by + 36 * sa - 30 * ca


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One urn is every American funeral. Data climbs a ladder and pours ash
    into it, three pours in time order: the ash line rises to each decade's
    true cremation share. The rest of the urn stays empty: everyone else."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])[:3]
    n = len(rows)
    ASH = P["accent2"]
    # --- the setting: dusk over a memorial lawn
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (22, 24, 58)), (0.55, (84, 66, 128)), (1.0, (196, 132, 120))], 0, 1160)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (46, 70, 58)), (1.0, (18, 28, 26))], 1150, H)
    glow(cr, 880, 1120, 360, P["sun_glow"], 0.35)
    for i, (x, d, s_) in enumerate(_TREES[:14]):
        tree(cr, x, 1160 + 20 * d, 0.35 * s_, P["leaf_far"], P["leaf_far_shade"],
             P["trunk_far"])
    # --- the urn: the WHOLE
    L, R, TOP, BOT = 378, 842, 905, 1455
    IH = BOT - TOP
    cr.move_to(330, 872)
    cr.line_to(890, 872)
    cr.line_to(866, 896)
    cr.line_to(860, 1460)
    cr.line_to(830, 1492)
    cr.line_to(390, 1492)
    cr.line_to(360, 1460)
    cr.line_to(354, 896)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((62, 66, 88)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 32, 46)))
    cr.rectangle(L, TOP, R - L, IH)
    cr.fill()
    # pour windows: (start, end) in u, one per data point
    wins = [(0.24, 0.38), (0.46, 0.62), (0.70, 0.84)][:n]
    level, k_on, pouring, pf = 0.0, -1, False, 0.0
    prev = 0.0
    for k, (a, b) in enumerate(wins):
        v = rows[k][1]
        f = seg(u, a, b)
        if u >= a:
            k_on = k
            level = prev + (v - prev) * ease(f)
            if f < 1.0:
                pouring, pf = True, f
        prev = v
    ly = BOT - IH * clamp(level / 100.0)
    if level > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ASH))
        cr.rectangle(L, ly, R - L, BOT - ly)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 252, 255), 0.8))
        cr.save()
        cr.translate((L + R) / 2, ly)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.08)
        cr.arc(0, 0, (R - L) / 2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.fill()
    # brass bands
    for by_ in (930, 1430):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.rectangle(354, by_, 512, 10)
        cr.fill()
    # rim
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((86, 92, 116)))
    cr.rectangle(330, 866, 560, 22)
    cr.fill()
    # landed decade notches on the urn's right wall
    for k, (a, b) in enumerate(wins):
        if u >= b:
            yk = BOT - IH * clamp(rows[k][1] / 100.0)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
            cr.set_line_width(5)
            cr.move_to(846, yk)
            cr.line_to(884, yk)
            cr.stroke()
            text(cr, rows[k][0], 892, yk + 14, 38, look.INK)
    # the rest of the urn: everyone else (named, not numbered)
    if k_on >= 0:
        my = (TOP + ly) / 2
        ra = ease(seg(u, wins[k_on][0] + 0.06, wins[k_on][0] + 0.14))
        if ly - TOP > 120:
            text(cr, "buried or other", 610, my + 16, 48, INK_2, anchor="center",
                 alpha=ra)
    else:
        text(cr, "every US funeral", 610, 1190, 52, INK_2, anchor="center",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.02, 0.12)))
    # --- the ash stream (only while a pour is running)
    climb = ease(seg(u, 0.10, 0.22))
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.03, 0.10))
    fx = 130 + 105 * walk_in + 75 * climb
    fy = 1490 - 610 * climb
    tip = 0.0
    if pouring:
        tip = 1.7 * ease(seg(pf, 0.0, 0.18)) * (1 - ease(seg(pf, 0.85, 1.0)))
    # the ladder, leaning on the urn
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 112, 72)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for x0_, x1_ in ((200, 300), (270, 352)):
        cr.move_to(x0_, 1495)
        cr.line_to(x1_, 885)
        cr.stroke()
    for r in range(10):
        q = (r + 0.5) / 10
        y = 1495 - 610 * q
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(200 + 100 * q, y)
        cr.line_to(270 + 82 * q, y)
        cr.stroke()
    # his bit: point at the empty urn, climb, pour each decade, hoist the next
    # pail between pours, cheer at the top
    if u < 0.10:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.22:
        role = "climb"
    elif pouring:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.88:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    host(role, fx, fy, 220)
    if u >= 0.10 and u < 0.88:
        lx, lyy = _urn_bucket(cr, fx + 75, fy - 130, tip, ASH)
        if pouring and tip > 0.9:
            sw = 3 * math.sin(t * 5)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ASH))
            cr.set_line_width(16)
            cr.move_to(lx, lyy)
            cr.curve_to(lx + 40, lyy + 30, lx + 50 + sw, (lyy + ly) / 2, lx + 52, ly)
            cr.stroke()
    # --- readout: the share in the landed / landing decade
    if k_on >= 0:
        lab, v = rows[k_on]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))}%", f"of Americans cremated · {lab}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, wins[0][0], wins[0][0] + 0.06)), size=140)
    if n >= 2 and u >= 0.86:
        gain = rows[-1][1] - rows[0][1]
        fit_readout(cr, f"+{int(round(gain))} points", f"since the {rows[0][0]}",
                    W - 80, 760, anchor="right", a=ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.94)),
                    rgb=P["readout"], size=60, max_w=420)

def _col(v):
    """A palette entry may be one colour or a gradient's stops; take one colour."""
    if isinstance(v, (tuple, list)) and len(v) and isinstance(v[0], (tuple, list)):
        return tuple(v[0])
    return tuple(v)


def _stone(cr, x, base, s, h=1.0, a=1.0):
    if h <= 0.02 or a <= 0.02:
        return
    w = 44 * s
    hh = 72 * s * h
    r = min(w / 2, hh)
    cr.move_to(x - w / 2, base)
    cr.line_to(x - w / 2, base - hh + r)
    cr.arc(x, base - hh + r, w / 2, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.line_to(x + w / 2, base)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((158, 160, 166), a))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((104, 106, 114), a))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 70, 50), 0.35 * a))
    cr.rectangle(x - w / 2 - 4, base - 3, w + 8, 6)
    cr.fill()


def _garden(cr, x, base, s, k, kind):
    """What the plot becomes once cremation takes it: rose beds and a few
    small urns on plinths in a memorial garden."""
    if k <= 0.02:
        return
    if kind == 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["brass_shade"]), k))
        cr.rectangle(x - 18 * s, base - 16 * s, 36 * s, 16 * s)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["brass"]), k))
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x, base - 16 * s - 26 * s * k)
        cr.scale(1.0, 1.25)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 18 * s * k, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.fill()
        cr.rectangle(x - 9 * s * k, base - 16 * s - 62 * s * k, 18 * s * k, 16 * s * k)
        cr.fill()
    else:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["leaf_shade"]), k))
        cr.arc(x, base - 10 * s, 26 * s * k, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        for j in range(3):
            fx = x + (j - 1) * 16 * s
            fy = base - 22 * s - 10 * s * (j % 2)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["accent2"]), k))
            cr.arc(fx, fy, 11 * s * k, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One field holds every American farewell. It rises as all headstones,
    the way your grandparents chose. Data walks in, drags a hedge across it in
    two hauls, and every grave the hedge passes turns into a memorial garden.
    The garden stops at cremation's true share of the field and the headstones
    keep burial's share. Data hauls, holds up the hedge post, then strolls
    into the garden he made and cheers."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lc, vc), (lb, vb) = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])[:2]
    whole = max(100.0, vc + vb)
    FX0, FX1 = 60.0, 1020.0
    FW = FX1 - FX0
    FY0, FY1 = 780.0, 1450.0
    bur_end = FX0 + FW * vb / whole
    split = FX1 - FW * vc / whole
    accent = _col(P["accent2"])

    # sky, distant tree line, the hillside field
    vgrad(cr, P["cleared"], 0, H)
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=790)
    birds(cr, t, y0=560, n=4)
    for x, d, s_ in _TREES[:30]:
        tree(cr, x, 770 + 18 * d, 0.42 * s_, P["leaf_far"], P["leaf_far_shade"],
             P["trunk_far"], lean=0.02 * math.sin(t * 0.8 + x))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["pasture"])))
    cr.rectangle(0, FY0 - 20, W, H - FY0 + 20)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((92, 72, 52)))
    cr.rectangle(0, FY1 + 10, W, H - FY1 - 10)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 146, 138)))
    cr.rectangle(0, FY1, W, 14)
    cr.fill()

    # the hedge moves in two decisive hauls, with a short hold between them
    prog = 0.5 * ease(seg(u, 0.18, 0.42)) + 0.5 * ease(seg(u, 0.48, 0.7))
    fx = FX1 - (FX1 - split) * prog
    fa = ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.18))
    land = ease(seg(u, 0.7, 0.8))

    # ground tint: the garden share in the accent, burial in a neutral
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(accent, 0.18 * fa))
    cr.rectangle(fx, FY0, FX1 - fx, FY1 - FY0)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 124, 130), 0.22 * land))
    cr.rectangle(FX0, FY0, bur_end - FX0, FY1 - FY0)
    cr.fill()

    # rows of graves rise back to front, set irregularly like a real cemetery
    other_fade = ease(seg(u, 0.7, 0.78))
    for r in range(7):
        base = 830 + r * 95
        s = 0.62 + 0.075 * r
        rise = ease(seg(u, 0.01 + r * 0.016, 0.07 + r * 0.016))
        n = int(FW / (74 * s))
        for i in range(n):
            if (i * 7 + r * 3) % 5 == 0:
                continue
            x = FX0 + 30 * s + i * (FW - 60 * s) / max(1, n - 1) \
                + ((i * 37 + r * 53) % 21 - 10)
            k = clamp((x - fx) / 50.0)
            h = (1.0 - k) * rise
            if bur_end < x < split:
                h *= 1.0 - other_fade
                k = 0.0
            _stone(cr, x, base, s, h=h)
            _garden(cr, x, base, s, pop(k), 0 if (i + r) % 4 == 0 else 1)

    # the hedge line Data drags
    if fa > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["leaf_shade"]), fa))
        cr.set_line_width(16)
        cr.move_to(fx, FY0)
        cr.line_to(fx, FY1)
        cr.stroke()
        for j in range(9):
            py = FY0 + j * (FY1 - FY0) / 8
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["log"]), fa))
            cr.rectangle(fx - 7, py - 22, 14, 30)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["leaf"]), fa))
            cr.arc(fx, py - 8, 14, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()

    # Data's bit: walks in sizing up the field, hauls the hedge, holds its
    # post, then strolls into the garden and cheers
    if u < 0.16:
        role = "think"
    elif u < 0.7:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.82:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    hx = fx - 90
    hx = 640 + (hx - 640) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.14))
    hx += 190 * ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.96))
    foot = 1500
    if 0.16 <= u < 0.82:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 52, 36)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(hx + 20, foot - 140)
        cr.line_to(fx, 1400)
        cr.stroke()
    host(role, hx, foot, 220,
         pace=(u < 0.14) or (0.82 <= u < 0.96))

    # readouts — the intro line is fully gone before the numbers arrive
    intro = fa * (1.0 - ease(seg(u, 0.6, 0.67)))
    if intro > 0.01:
        text(cr, "every American goodbye, one field", 80, 600, 48, look.INK,
             alpha=intro)
    if land > 0.01:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vc:.1f}%", f"{lc.lower()} · {vc / vb:.1f}× {lb.lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=land, size=150)
        text(cr, f"{vb:.1f}% {lb.lower()}", FX0 + 6, 752, 44, look.INK, alpha=land)
        text(cr, lc.lower(), FX1 - 6, 752, 44, accent, anchor="right", alpha=land)
