stories.title: Quantum Computers Went From 5 Qubits To 1,121
stories.hook: This number just broke every chart.
stories.closing: Data's still waiting for his quantum laptop.
stories.question: Would you trust a quantum computer with your passwords? Tell me below.
stories.caption: IBM's first public quantum computer had 5 qubits. Its newest has 1,121. Here's why that number matters more than it sounds 👇

segments.topic: the jump in qubits IBM's quantum computers can hold
segments.say: IBM's first public quantum computer in 2016 had just 5 qubits. By 2023 its Condor chip hit 1,121 qubits -- over 200 times more.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a quantum processor chip
    SUBSTANCE: glowing qubits on the die
    CAUSE: Data places each new block of qubits onto the chip and the die grows with it
    IBM's chips, one per year: Data sets the next block of qubits onto the
    package, the die grows to hold them and the new qubits light up. Then he
    walks along the chip edge to place the next one. The count is the number
    of dots, and the die's area is in proportion to it."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    vmax = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    vmin = rows[0][1] or 1.0

    # the lab: a dark cryostat room, a cold glow behind the chip
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (8, 12, 30)), (0.5, (14, 22, 48)), (1.0, (6, 9, 22))], 0, H)
    cx, cy = 540, 1010
    glow(cr, cx, cy, 620, (60, 110, 200), 0.35 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 1.2))

    # step timing: each data year lands, holds, and then Data walks on
    q = clamp((u - 0.08) / 0.84) * (n - 1)
    k = min(n - 1, int(q))
    f = q - k if k < n - 1 else 1.0
    if u >= 0.92:
        k, f = n - 1, 1.0
    if k < n - 1:
        nxt = k + 1
        grow = ease(seg(f, 0.18, 0.5))
        prev_v, cur_v = rows[k][1], rows[nxt][1]
        shown_v = prev_v + (cur_v - prev_v) * grow
        lab_row = rows[nxt] if grow >= 1.0 else rows[k]
    else:
        nxt = k
        grow = 1.0
        prev_v = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else rows[k][1]
        cur_v = rows[k][1]
        shown_v = cur_v
        lab_row = rows[k]
    if u < 0.08:
        prev_v = cur_v = shown_v = rows[0][1]
        lab_row = rows[0]

    # the package: green substrate, gold pins on all four sides, silver lid frame
    S = 780
    px0, py0 = cx - S / 2, cy - S / 2
    pin_n = 18
    for side in range(4):
        for i in range(pin_n):
            o = -S / 2 + 40 + i * (S - 80) / (pin_n - 1)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
            if side == 0:
                cr.rectangle(cx + o - 9, py0 - 26, 18, 30)
            elif side == 1:
                cr.rectangle(cx + o - 9, py0 + S - 4, 18, 30)
            elif side == 2:
                cr.rectangle(px0 - 26, cy + o - 9, 30, 18)
            else:
                cr.rectangle(px0 + S - 4, cy + o - 9, 30, 18)
            cr.fill()
    r = 34
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(px0 + r, py0 + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.arc(px0 + S - r, py0 + r, r, 1.5 * math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.arc(px0 + S - r, py0 + S - r, r, 0, 0.5 * math.pi)
    cr.arc(px0 + r, py0 + S - r, r, 0.5 * math.pi, math.pi)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((22, 74, 52)))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 120, 84)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.stroke()
    # gold traces from the pins toward the die
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"], 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(0, pin_n, 2):
        o = -S / 2 + 40 + i * (S - 80) / (pin_n - 1)
        cr.move_to(cx + o, py0 + 6)
        cr.line_to(cx + o * 0.45, cy - 300)
        cr.move_to(cx + o, py0 + S - 6)
        cr.line_to(cx + o * 0.45, cy + 300)
        cr.move_to(px0 + 6, cy + o)
        cr.line_to(cx - 300, cy + o * 0.45)
        cr.move_to(px0 + S - 6, cy + o)
        cr.line_to(cx + 300, cy + o * 0.45)
    cr.stroke()
    # the lid frame
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 178, 192)))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 310, cy - 310, 620, 620)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 128, 144)))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 296, cy - 296, 592, 592)
    cr.fill()

    # the die, its area proportional to the qubit count
    def side_of(v):
        return max(70.0, 560.0 * math.sqrt(max(v, 1.0) / vmax))
    side = side_of(prev_v) + (side_of(cur_v) - side_of(prev_v)) * grow
    if u < 0.08:
        side = side_of(rows[0][1]) * max(0.05, ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.06)))
    d0x, d0y = cx - side / 2, cy - side / 2
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 28, 70)))
    cr.rectangle(d0x, d0y, side, side)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.rectangle(d0x, d0y, side, side)
    cr.stroke()

    # the qubits: one dot each, the new ones in the accent
    count = int(round(shown_v))
    old = int(round(prev_v)) if grow > 0 else count
    c = max(2, int(math.ceil(math.sqrt(max(count, 1)))))
    sp = side / c
    rad = max(3.0, min(11.0, sp * 0.3))
    for i in range(count):
        gx = d0x + sp * (i % c + 0.5)
        gy = d0y + sp * (i // c + 0.5)
        is_new = i >= old
        col = P["accent2"] if is_new else (120, 190, 255)
        if is_new and count < 60:
            glow(cr, gx, gy, rad * 3, col, 0.5)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.arc(gx, gy, rad, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    # Data: points at the tiny first chip, then places each block, walking
    # along the chip's bottom edge, and cheers at Condor
    spots = [190 + i * (700 / max(1, n - 1)) for i in range(n)]
    if u < 0.08:
        role, bk, hx = "point", 0, spots[0]
    elif u >= 0.92:
        role, bk, hx = "cheer", n, spots[min(n - 1, k)]
    else:
        role, bk = "place", k + 1
        a_ = spots[min(n - 1, k)]
        b_ = spots[min(n - 1, k + 1)]
        hx = a_ + (b_ - a_) * ease(seg(f, 0.72, 0.98))
        if seg(f, 0.72, 0.98) > 0 and f < 0.98:
            role = "hold_up"
    host(role, hx, 1500, 220, beat=bk)

    # readouts: only ever a data point that has landed
    lab, val = lab_row
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(val)):,} qubits", f"IBM · {lab}", 80, 500,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.06)), size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.9, 0.98))
    if b > 0:
        ratio = vmax / vmin
        fit_readout(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}× more", f"than {rows[0][0]}",
                    cx, cy - 60, anchor="center", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"],
                    size=120, max_w=520)

segments.topic: why each qubit doubles a quantum computer's power
segments.say: Here's why that number matters so much: every extra qubit doubles what's representable. Just 20 of them already pass 1,048,576 possible states at once.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _coin(cr, x, y, r, a=1.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y + 4)
    cr.scale(r, r * 0.42)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["coin_edge"], a))
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(r, r * 0.42)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["coin"], a))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["coin_edge"], a))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(r * 0.6, r * 0.25)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"], 0.8 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    cr.stroke()


def _heap_y(x, cx, base, h, w):
    q = clamp(abs(x - cx) / max(1.0, w))
    return base - h * (1 - q * q)


def _heap(cr, cx, base, h, w):
    # the mound body: gold under the surface coins
    cr.move_to(cx - w, base)
    steps = 40
    for i in range(steps + 1):
        x = cx - w + 2 * w * i / steps
        cr.line_to(x, _heap_y(x, cx, base, h, w))
    cr.line_to(cx + w, base)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.fill()
    # coins: fixed seeds, so the heap grows smoothly and never shimmers
    nc = int(60 + h * 0.35)
    pile = []
    for i in range(nc):
        a = (i * 0.618034) % 1.0
        b = (i * 0.754878) % 1.0
        x = cx + (2 * a - 1) * w * 0.96
        ys = _heap_y(x, cx, base, h, w)
        y = ys + 10 + b * b * (base - ys - 10) * 0.92
        pile.append((y, x, i))
    for y, x, i in sorted(pile):
        _coin(cr, x, y, 20 + (i % 3) * 3)
    # a rim of coins along the crest so the silhouette is coins, not a hill
    for i in range(int(w / 22) + 1):
        x = cx - w * 0.97 + i * (w * 1.94) / max(1, int(w / 22))
        _coin(cr, x, _heap_y(x, cx, base, h, w) + 6, 22)
    # a few coins spilled on the floor at the foot
    for k in range(6):
        sx = cx + (-1 if k % 2 else 1) * (w + 20 + (k * 37) % 70)
        _coin(cr, sx, base + 8 + (k % 3) * 6, 20)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a heap of gold coins
    SUBSTANCE: gold coins
    CAUSE: Data pours a bucket of gold coins onto the heap and the heap doubles
    Each qubit is a coin that can land two ways, so every extra qubit doubles
    the possible states. Each step Data tips a bucket of coins onto the
    treasure heap and it swells to the next count's size — 1, 5, 10, 20
    qubits — while the readout shows the states, 2^n, and how many times
    bigger that step made it."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: r[1])[:4]
    N = len(rows)
    ns = [max(1, int(round(math.log(max(v, 2.0), 2)))) for _, v in rows]
    k = min(N - 1, int(u * N))
    f = clamp(u * N - k)

    # the vault: warm dark stone, full height
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (18, 14, 22)), (0.55, (40, 30, 34)), (1.0, (24, 18, 22))], 0, H)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (58, 44, 40)), (1.0, (30, 22, 22))], 1480, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((86, 66, 56)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1476, W, 6)
    cr.fill()
    for i in range(6):                         # stone courses on the back wall
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 46, 48), 0.5))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(0, 760 + i * 120)
        cr.line_to(W, 760 + i * 120)
        cr.stroke()

    cx, base = 540, 1480

    def height(n):
        return 140 + 520 * math.log(n + 1) / math.log(21)

    h_prev = height(ns[k - 1]) if k > 0 else 90.0
    h_new = height(ns[k])
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.12, 0.6))
    h = h_prev + (h_new - h_prev) * grow
    w = min(1.0 * h, 470)

    glow(cr, cx, base - h * 0.5, h * 0.9, P["sun_glow"], 0.22 + 0.04 * math.sin(t * 1.5))
    _heap(cr, cx, base, h, w)

    # Data stands on the heap's left slope; he rises with it as it grows
    dx = cx - w * 0.78
    foot = min(1490, _heap_y(dx, cx, base, h, w) + 6)

    pouring = f < 0.62
    if pouring:
        flow = clamp(seg(f, 0.08, 0.18)) * (1 - seg(f, 0.52, 0.62))
        hx, hy = dx + 70, foot - 165
        tx, ty = cx + 10, base - h - 6
        for j in range(9):                     # the coins tipping out of his bucket
            p = (t * 1.1 + j / 9.0) % 1.0
            x = hx + (tx - hx) * p
            y = hy + (ty - hy) * p * p - 60 * math.sin(math.pi * p) * (1 - p)
            _coin(cr, x, y, 14, a=flow)
        role = "pour"
    elif k == N - 1:
        role = "shock"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    host(role, dx, foot, 220, beat=k)

    # readouts: the state count, 2^n, and the jump this step made
    show = k if f >= 0.35 else k - 1
    if show >= 0:
        lab, val = rows[show]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(val):,}", f"possible states · {lab}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)) if show == 0 else 1.0, size=130)
        if show > 0:
            ratio = val / rows[show - 1][1]
            dn = ns[show] - ns[show - 1]
            text(cr, f"+{dn} qubits = ×{ratio:,.0f}", W - 80, 700, 56, P["accent2"],
                 face="display", anchor="right",
                 alpha=ease(seg(f, 0.35, 0.5)) if show == k else 1.0)
    else:
        text(cr, "every qubit doubles the states", 80, 560, 54, look.INK,
             alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.06)))

segments.topic: which company's quantum chip has the most qubits
segments.say: IBM's Condor chip has 1,121 qubits. Google's newest chip, Willow, has 105 -- by that one measure, IBM is the current leader.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a big brass balance scale
    SUBSTANCE: glowing blue qubit beads
    CAUSE: Data shovels beads into each pan and IBM's heavy pan sinks the scale
    Who has the most qubits: a balance scale with Google's Willow pan on
    one side and IBM's Condor pan on the other. Data shovels Google's 105
    qubits into its pan in one scoop and the scale tips that way. Then he
    walks over and shovels IBM's 1,121 in, scoop after scoop, until the pan
    holds a heap about ten times bigger and drags the beam down hard. Each
    heap's area is in proportion to its count. Only the two sourced counts
    and their ratio are ever printed, never a running tally."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    (li, vi), (lg, vg) = rows if rows[0][1] >= rows[1][1] else rows[::-1]
    ratio = vi / max(vg, 1.0)

    # the lab: dark room, a lit floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (10, 14, 34)), (0.6, (18, 26, 58)), (1, (28, 36, 70))], 0, 1460)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (44, 50, 78)), (1, (20, 22, 40))], 1460, H)
    glow(cr, 540, 900, 620, (60, 110, 190), 0.35)

    # the scoops: one for Google, six for IBM, each landing on a strike
    g_s, g_e = 0.10, 0.26
    g_land = g_s + 0.6 * (g_e - g_s)
    n_i = 6
    i_s, i_e = 0.36, 0.80
    step = (i_e - i_s) / n_i
    i_lands = [i_s + k * step + 0.6 * step for k in range(n_i)]
    G = vg * ease(seg(u, g_land, g_land + 0.02))
    Iw = sum((vi / n_i) * ease(seg(u, L, L + 0.02)) for L in i_lands)

    # the beam tips toward the heavier pan (a > 0: IBM's left pan goes down)
    tot = G + Iw
    a = 0.0 if tot <= 0 else 0.22 * (Iw - G) / tot
    cx, py, arm, chain = 540, 860, 290, 430
    ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
    lx, ly = cx - arm * ca, py + arm * sa
    rx, ry = cx + arm * ca, py - arm * sa

    # the bead heap Data shovels from, at the foot of the post
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 150, 230)))
    cr.move_to(470, 1500)
    cr.curve_to(490, 1440, 590, 1440, 610, 1500)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(14):
        bx = 482 + (k * 37) % 120
        by = 1494 - (k * 13) % 38
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 220, 255)))
        cr.arc(bx, by, 7, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    # the stand: foot, post, pivot
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.move_to(410, 1500)
    cr.line_to(670, 1500)
    cr.line_to(600, 1450)
    cr.line_to(480, 1450)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.rectangle(522, py + 10, 36, 1450 - py - 10)
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(cx, py - 40, 26, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(cx, py - 14)
    cr.line_to(cx - 30, py + 30)
    cr.line_to(cx + 30, py + 30)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()

    # the beam
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, py)
    cr.rotate(-a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.rectangle(-arm - 14, -12, 2 * arm + 28, 24)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.rectangle(-arm - 14, 4, 2 * arm + 28, 8)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()

    def pan(ex, ey, count, label, hot):
        rim = ey + chain
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["mercury"], 0.9))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        for dx in (-140, 0, 140):
            cr.move_to(ex, ey + 14)
            cr.line_to(ex + dx, rim)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.arc(ex, ey + 10, 12, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        # the heap of beads: its area is in proportion to the count
        if count > 0.5:
            A = 280 * 230 * count / max(vi, 1.0)
            w = min(290.0, math.sqrt(A * 1.6))
            h = A / w
            glow(cr, ex, rim - h * 0.5, w * 0.9, (90, 180, 255), 0.4)
            cr.save()
            cr.move_to(ex - w / 2, rim + 4)
            cr.curve_to(ex - w * 0.42, rim - h * 1.25, ex + w * 0.42, rim - h * 1.25,
                        ex + w / 2, rim + 4)
            cr.close_path()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 140, 225)))
            cr.fill_preserve()
            cr.clip()
            for j in range(int(h / 16) + 2):
                yy = rim - j * 16
                off = 9 if j % 2 else 0
                for i in range(int(w / 18) + 2):
                    xx = ex - w / 2 + off + i * 18
                    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((160, 225, 255)))
                    cr.arc(xx, yy, 7, 0, 2 * math.pi)
                    cr.fill()
            cr.restore()
        # the dish
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"] if not hot else P["coin"]))
        cr.move_to(ex - 150, rim)
        cr.curve_to(ex - 120, rim + 70, ex + 120, rim + 70, ex + 150, rim)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
        cr.rectangle(ex - 152, rim - 4, 304, 9)
        cr.fill()
        text(cr, label, ex, ey - 34, fit_size(cr, label, 36, 300), look.INK,
             anchor="center")

    pan(lx, ly, Iw, li, u > i_e)
    pan(rx, ry, G, lg, False)

    # a scoop in flight: from the shovel to the pan, landing on the strike
    def scoop(L, x0, tx, ty):
        f = seg(u, L - 0.03, L)
        if 0 < f < 1:
            bx = x0 + (tx - x0) * f
            by = 1300 + (ty - 1300) * f - 160 * math.sin(math.pi * f)
            for k in range(7):
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((160, 225, 255)))
                cr.arc(bx + (k % 3 - 1) * 14, by + (k // 3 - 1) * 12, 8, 0, 2 * math.pi)
                cr.fill()

    scoop(g_land, 640, rx, ry + chain - 30)
    for L in i_lands:
        scoop(L, 440, lx, ly + chain - 60)

    # his bit: point at Google's pan, shovel its scoop, walk over, shovel
    # IBM's in scoop by scoop, cheer as the beam slams down
    if u < g_s:
        host("point", 640, 1500, 220)
    elif u < g_e:
        host("dig", 640, 1500, 220, beat=1)
    elif u < i_s:
        f = ease(seg(u, g_e, i_s))
        host("point", 640 - 200 * f, 1500, 220, pace=True)
    elif u < i_e + 0.04:
        k = min(n_i - 1, int((u - i_s) / step))
        host("dig", 440, 1500, 220, beat=2 + k)
    else:
        host("cheer", 440, 1500, 220)

    # readouts: only the two sourced counts and their ratio, each held
    # for well over a second — never a running tally of the heap
    if u < i_s:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vg)):,} qubits", lg, 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, g_land, g_land + 0.04)), size=130)
    elif u < i_e + 0.02:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vi)):,} qubits", li, 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, i_s, i_s + 0.04)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x the qubits", f"{li} vs {lg}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, i_e + 0.02, i_e + 0.08)), rgb=P["accent2"], size=130)

stories.closing_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a gold quantum computer chandelier
    SUBSTANCE: white frost
    CAUSE: Data pours bucket after bucket of liquid helium into its feed pipe and white frost creeps down the gold plates
    The closing: IBM's 1,121 qubits hang in a gold dilution-fridge chandelier
    as tall as the room: stacked gold discs on gold rods, threaded with
    coiled silver and copper cables, a chip glowing at the bottom. Data
    pours liquid helium into its feed pipe, one bucket at a time, and with
    each pour the frost creeps another plate down the gold until the chip
    lights. Then he walks over and holds his tiny laptop up beside it: a
    bracket runs the machine's full height, a tiny one beside the laptop,
    and the laptop's spinner keeps turning. He is still waiting."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lb, vb) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    cx = 600

    # the lab: dark walls, a polished floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (14, 18, 32)), (0.55, (26, 32, 52)), (1, (36, 40, 56))], 0, H)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (60, 64, 80)), (1, (32, 34, 46))], 1500, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 96, 116), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.move_to(0, 1500)
    cr.line_to(W, 1500)
    cr.stroke()

    # three pours: the frost steps forward on each one, as the helium lands
    q0, q1, pours = 0.04, 0.58, 3
    cu = seg(u, q0, q1) * pours
    k = int(min(pours - 1, cu))
    local = cu - k if u < q1 else 1.0
    step = ease(seg(local, 0.3, 0.85))
    frost = clamp((k + step) / pours) if u >= q0 else 0.0
    if u >= q1:
        frost = 1.0
    stream = q0 <= u < q1 and 0.22 < local < 0.9

    gold, gold_sh, gold_lit = (214, 168, 74), (150, 108, 44), (250, 214, 130)
    steel, steel_sh = (150, 154, 170), (96, 100, 116)

    # the ceiling beam and the steel top flange it hangs from — all below
    # the readouts, so the words sit on clear wall
    top = 750
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((66, 70, 88)))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 420, 700, 840, 22)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(steel))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for dx in (-240, 0, 240):
        cr.move_to(cx + dx, 722)
        cr.line_to(cx + dx, top)
        cr.stroke()

    # the levels: steel flange, then gold plates — a near-cylinder, not a cone
    levels = [(top, 620), (850, 580), (950, 550), (1045, 515),
              (1135, 480), (1220, 445)]

    # behind the plates: gold support rods and the coiled coax cable bundle
    for i in range(len(levels) - 1):
        (ya, wa), (yb, wb) = levels[i], levels[i + 1]
        wm = min(wa, wb)
        for f in (-0.9, -0.5, 0.5, 0.9):
            xr = cx + f * wm / 2
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(gold_sh))
            cr.set_line_width(12)
            cr.move_to(xr, ya + 18)
            cr.line_to(xr, yb)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(gold_lit, 0.7))
            cr.set_line_width(3)
            cr.move_to(xr - 3, ya + 18)
            cr.line_to(xr - 3, yb)
            cr.stroke()
        for j in range(9):
            f = -0.7 + j * (1.4 / 8)
            xa, xb = cx + f * wa * 0.42, cx + f * wb * 0.42
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((198, 124, 72) if j % 3 == 1 else (200, 205, 216)))
            cr.set_line_width(4)
            n_s = 28
            for s in range(n_s + 1):
                g = s / n_s
                yy = ya + 22 + (yb - ya - 22) * g
                xx = xa + (xb - xa) * g
                if j % 2 == 0 and 0.3 < g < 0.75:   # the signature pigtail coils
                    xx += 9 * math.sin((g - 0.3) * math.pi * 14)
                if s == 0:
                    cr.move_to(xx, yy)
                else:
                    cr.line_to(xx, yy)
            cr.stroke()

    # the cold finger down to the chip
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(gold_sh))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 14, 1236, 28, 76)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(gold_lit, 0.7))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 8, 1236, 4, 76)
    cr.fill()

    # the plates themselves, and the frost that coats them top-down
    n = len(levels)
    for i, (y, w) in enumerate(levels):
        body, side, lit = (steel, steel_sh, (210, 214, 226)) if i == 0 else \
            (gold, gold_sh, gold_lit)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx, y + 18)
        cr.scale(w / 2, 16)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(side))
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(side))
        cr.rectangle(cx - w / 2, y, w, 18)
        cr.fill()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx, y)
        cr.scale(w / 2, 16)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(body))
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(lit, 0.65))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(cx - w * 0.38, y - 5)
        cr.line_to(cx + w * 0.12, y - 9)
        cr.stroke()
        if i > 0:   # attenuator blocks hanging under each gold plate
            for f in (-0.55, -0.2, 0.2, 0.55):
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(gold_sh))
                cr.rectangle(cx + f * w * 0.42 - 9, y + 26, 18, 22)
                cr.fill()
        else:       # bolts round the steel flange
            for j in range(9):
                bxx = cx - w * 0.44 + j * (w * 0.88 / 8)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 90)))
                cr.arc(bxx, y + 9, 5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
                cr.fill()
        if i == 0:
            continue
        fi = clamp(frost * (n - 1) - (i - 1))
        if fi <= 0:
            continue
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx, y + 2)
        cr.scale(w / 2 * (0.3 + 0.72 * fi), 20)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 244, 252), 0.85 * fi))
        cr.fill()
        for j in range(14):
            f = -1 + j * (2 / 13)
            if abs(f) > 0.3 + 0.7 * fi:
                continue
            ix = cx + f * w * 0.47
            ln = (16 + (j * 37) % 22) * fi
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 252, 255), 0.95))
            cr.move_to(ix - 6, y + 32)
            cr.line_to(ix + 6, y + 32)
            cr.line_to(ix, y + 32 + ln)
            cr.close_path()
            cr.fill()

    # the Condor chip at the bottom: it lights up once the frost reaches it
    chip = clamp(frost * (n - 1) - (n - 2))
    flare = math.sin(math.pi * seg(u, q1, q1 + 0.1))
    glow(cr, cx, 1336, 140 + 80 * flare, (120, 190, 255),
         0.15 + 0.6 * chip * (0.88 + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 3)) + 0.25 * flare)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 46, 64)))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 46, 1310, 92, 52)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 210, 255), 0.3 + 0.7 * chip))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 30, 1320, 60, 32)
    cr.fill()

    # the helium feed: a funnel on the floor, a pipe up to the flange
    fx, fy = 380, 1410
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 156, 172)))
    cr.set_line_width(22)
    cr.move_to(fx, fy + 40)
    cr.line_to(fx, 1474)
    cr.line_to(110, 1474)
    cr.line_to(110, top + 9)
    cr.line_to(cx - 310, top + 9)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 244, 252), 0.8 * frost))
    cr.set_line_width(28)
    cr.move_to(110, 1474 - (1474 - top) * frost)
    cr.line_to(110, top + 9)
    cr.line_to(cx - 310, top + 9)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((176, 182, 198)))
    cr.move_to(fx - 46, fy - 30)
    cr.line_to(fx + 46, fy - 30)
    cr.line_to(fx + 12, fy + 40)
    cr.line_to(fx - 12, fy + 40)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()

    # the room-sized bracket: the machine's full height, beside where he stops
    ba = ease(seg(u, 0.74, 0.84))
    if ba > 0:
        bx = 1035
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK, 0.9 * ba))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(bx - 18, 700)
        cr.line_to(bx + 18, 700)
        cr.move_to(bx, 700)
        cr.line_to(bx, 1500)
        cr.move_to(bx - 18, 1500)
        cr.line_to(bx + 18, 1500)
        cr.stroke()

    # Data: pours three buckets, walks over with his laptop, holds it up
    # against the machine, then is left waiting
    w0, w1 = q1, 0.78
    if u < q0:
        role, x, b = "point", 250, 0
    elif u < q1:
        role, x, b = "pour", 250, k + 1
    elif u < w1:
        role, x, b = "hold_up", 250 + 680 * ease(seg(u, w0, w1)), 0
    elif u < 0.9:
        role, x, b = "hold_up", 930, 0
    else:
        role, x, b = "think", 930, 0
    host(role, x, 1500, 220, pace=(w0 <= u < w1), beat=b)

    if stream:   # pale liquid helium falling from his bucket into the funnel
        sa = math.sin(math.pi * seg(local, 0.22, 0.9))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 226, 250), 0.9 * sa))
        cr.set_line_width(14)
        cr.move_to(x + 70, 1330)
        cr.curve_to(x + 100, 1320, fx - 10, 1340, fx, fy - 20)
        cr.stroke()

    if u >= q1:   # the tiny laptop, its spinner still going
        lx, ly = x, 1240
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 86)))
        cr.rectangle(lx - 44, ly + 24, 88, 10)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((54, 58, 70)))
        cr.rectangle(lx - 40, ly - 30, 80, 54)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 190, 255), 0.8))
        cr.rectangle(lx - 34, ly - 24, 68, 42)
        cr.fill()
        sp = t * 4
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 244, 250)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.arc(lx, ly - 3, 10, sp, sp + 4.2)
        cr.stroke()
        if ba > 0:   # the laptop's own tiny bracket, for scale
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK, 0.9 * ba))
            cr.set_line_width(4)
            for yy in (ly - 30, ly + 34):
                cr.move_to(lx - 68, yy)
                cr.line_to(lx - 52, yy)
            cr.move_to(lx - 60, ly - 30)
            cr.line_to(lx - 60, ly + 34)
            cr.stroke()

    # the readouts sit on clear wall between the closing line and the beam
    ra = ease(seg(u, 0.56, 0.68))
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(vb):,} qubits", lb, 80, 520, a=ra, size=100,
                max_w=920)
    sa_ = ease(seg(u, 0.74, 0.84))
    if sa_ > 0:
        text(cr, "still room-sized", 80, 660, 58, look.INK, face="bold",
             alpha=sa_)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a glass jar bursting with marbles
    SUBSTANCE: glowing qubit marbles
    CAUSE: Data opens the valve and qubit marbles pour into the jar until it cracks and overflows
    The hook in one picture: a big glass mason jar, with screw threads on its
    neck and a shine down the glass, holds IBM's first 5 qubits as glowing
    marbles. Data is already turning the valve on the pipe above it. The
    marbles pour in until there are Condor's 1,121, which is more than the
    jar holds. The glass cracks and the extra marbles spill over the rim
    into a heap in front of it. He climbs down off his platform and steps
    back in shock. Only the two sourced counts are printed, and each stays
    up long enough to read."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    ratio = v1 / v0 if v0 else 0.0
    N0, N = int(round(v0)), max(1, int(round(v1)))
    # the lab
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (12, 16, 30)), (0.6, (24, 30, 52)), (1.0, (16, 18, 28))], 0, H)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (40, 44, 60)), (1.0, (20, 22, 32))], 1480, H)
    # jar geometry
    L, R, L2, R2 = 330, 830, 400, 760
    TOP, NECK, SH, BASE = 850, 900, 990, 1475
    def jar_path():
        cr.move_to(L2, TOP)
        cr.line_to(L2, NECK)
        cr.curve_to(L2, 935, L, 945, L, SH)
        cr.line_to(L, BASE - 55)
        cr.curve_to(L, BASE, L + 30, BASE, L + 60, BASE)
        cr.line_to(R - 60, BASE)
        cr.curve_to(R - 30, BASE, R, BASE, R, BASE - 55)
        cr.line_to(R, SH)
        cr.curve_to(R, 945, R2, 935, R2, NECK)
        cr.line_to(R2, TOP)
        cr.close_path()
    # marble slots in the jar body, bottom row first
    r = 9.0
    dy = r * 1.73
    grid = []
    row = 0
    y = BASE - r - 6
    while y > SH + r:
        off = r if row % 2 else 0.0
        x = L + r + 6 + off
        while x < R - r - 6:
            grid.append((x, y))
            x += 2 * r
        y -= dy
        row += 1
    cap = len(grid)
    fill = seg(u, 0.06, 0.6)
    n = int(round(N0 + (N - N0) * fill * fill * (3 - 2 * fill)))
    inside = min(n, cap)
    spill = max(0, n - cap)
    crack = clamp(spill / max(1, N - cap))
    # the light of the qubits behind the glass
    glow(cr, 580, 1220, 380 + 200 * crack, (110, 185, 255), 0.12 + 0.5 * inside / max(1, cap))
    # glass body
    jar_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 210, 240), 0.13))
    cr.fill()
    # marbles inside
    cr.save()
    jar_path()
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 180, 250)))
    for x, y in grid[:inside]:
        cr.move_to(x + r, y)
        cr.arc(x, y, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((225, 242, 255)))
    for x, y in grid[:inside]:
        cr.move_to(x - 2, y - 3)
        cr.arc(x - 3, y - 3, 3, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    if inside < 60:                       # a handful: each glows on its own
        for k, (x, y) in enumerate(grid[:inside]):
            glow(cr, x, y, 30, (140, 210, 255), 0.8)
    cr.restore()
    # glass outline, shine and screw threads: a mason jar
    jar_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 236, 250), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.28))
    cr.rectangle(L + 30, SH + 30, 22, 380)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.16))
    cr.rectangle(L + 64, SH + 60, 10, 300)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 236, 250), 0.8))
    for k in range(3):
        yy = TOP + 12 + k * 15
        cr.move_to(L2 - 6, yy)
        cr.curve_to(L2 + 120, yy + 10, R2 - 120, yy + 10, R2 + 6, yy - 4)
        cr.stroke()
    # cracks run as the overflow pushes on the glass
    cracks = [[(R - 20, 1060), (R - 70, 1120), (R - 50, 1190), (R - 120, 1260), (R - 100, 1340)],
              [(L + 40, 1120), (L + 100, 1180), (L + 80, 1240), (L + 150, 1300)],
              [(R - 70, 1120), (R - 160, 1140), (R - 210, 1100)]]
    if crack > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.95))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        for line in cracks:
            m = 1 + int((len(line) - 1) * min(1.0, crack * 1.6))
            cr.move_to(*line[0])
            for p in line[1:m]:
                cr.line_to(*p)
            cr.stroke()
    # the pipe, spout and valve wheel
    pipe = (110, 118, 136)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(pipe))
    cr.rectangle(985, 0, 34, 776)
    cr.rectangle(564, 744, 455, 34)
    cr.rectangle(564, 744, 34, 76)
    cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(548, 820)
    cr.line_to(614, 820)
    cr.line_to(604, 838)
    cr.line_to(558, 838)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    turn = 5.0 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.3))
    vx, vy = 880, 761
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 50, 50)))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    cr.arc(vx, vy - 34, 30, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    for k in range(3):
        a = turn + k * math.pi / 1.5
        cr.move_to(vx, vy - 34)
        cr.line_to(vx + 30 * math.cos(a), vy - 34 + 30 * math.sin(a))
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(pipe))
    cr.rectangle(vx - 6, vy - 34, 12, 20)
    cr.fill()
    # the stream: marbles falling from the spout to the surface
    if n < N:
        surf = grid[inside - 1][1] if 0 < inside <= cap else BASE
        if inside >= cap:
            surf = TOP
        top_y, span = 840, max(10, surf - 840)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((130, 195, 255)))
        for k in range(9):
            s = (t * 2.2 + k / 9.0) % 1.0
            cr.move_to(581 + r + 4 * math.sin(k * 2.1), top_y + span * s * s)
            cr.arc(581 + 4 * math.sin(k * 2.1), top_y + span * s * s, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    # the overflow: over the rim, down the glass, into a heap in front
    if spill > 0:
        if n < N:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((130, 195, 255)))
            for k in range(6):
                s = (t * 1.4 + k / 6.0) % 1.0
                x = L2 + 10 - 140 * s
                y = TOP + 620 * s * s
                cr.move_to(x + r, y)
                cr.arc(x, y, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
        heap = []
        j = 0
        while len(heap) < spill:
            cols = 42 - j
            for c in range(cols):
                heap.append((150 + j * r + c * 2 * r, 1471 - j * dy))
            j += 1
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 180, 250)))
        for x, y in heap[:spill]:
            cr.move_to(x + r, y)
            cr.arc(x, y, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((225, 242, 255)))
        for x, y in heap[:spill]:
            cr.move_to(x - 1, y - 3)
            cr.arc(x - 3, y - 3, 3, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    # his platform and ladder
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((72, 78, 96)))
    cr.rectangle(860, 920, 200, 22)
    cr.rectangle(870, 942, 12, 538)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 120, 80)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for x in (1030, 1066):
        cr.move_to(x, 920)
        cr.line_to(x, 1480)
        cr.stroke()
    for k in range(9):
        cr.move_to(1030, 960 + k * 60)
        cr.line_to(1066, 960 + k * 60)
        cr.stroke()
    # Data: opens the valve, climbs down as the jar cracks, steps back in shock
    down = ease(seg(u, 0.42, 0.72))
    back = ease(seg(u, 0.74, 0.88))
    if u < 0.42:
        role, bt = "tap", 0
        hx, fy = 930, 920
    elif u < 0.74:
        role, bt = "climb", 1
        hx, fy = 930 + 90 * down, 920 + 560 * down
    else:
        role, bt = "shock", 2
        hx, fy = 1020 - 40 * back, 1480
    host(role, hx, fy, 220, beat=bt)
    # readout: only the two sourced counts, each held to read
    if u < 0.42:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{N0:,} qubits", l0, 80, 520, size=140)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{N:,} qubits", f"{l1} · {ratio:.0f}× more", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.42, 0.48)), size=140)

def _rr(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, r):
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x1 - r, y0 + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
    cr.arc(x1 - r, y1 - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x0 + r, y1 - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
    cr.arc(x0 + r, y0 + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a steel cultivated-meat bioreactor
    SUBSTANCE: pink cultivated meat
    CAUSE: Data climbs the tank and pours bucket after bucket of meat in, filling it eightfold
    Today's plant is the eighth of the tank already full; the next plant is
    the whole tank. Each pour lands one more of today's plants in it."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    (lb, big), (ls, small) = rows[0], rows[1]
    small = small or 1.0
    ratio = big / small
    frac0 = clamp(small / (big or 1.0))
    n = int(max(1, min(12, round(ratio) - 1)))

    # the plant floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (58, 66, 80)), (0.5, (84, 94, 110)), (1.0, (70, 78, 92))], 0, H)
    for i in range(6):                         # wall panels
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((48, 55, 68), 0.6))
        cr.rectangle(i * 190 + 20, 0, 6, 1440)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 128, 140)))     # overhead pipe
    cr.rectangle(0, 300, W, 26)
    cr.fill()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (96, 102, 112)), (1.0, (60, 64, 72))], 1440, H)

    # pour timing — the meat arrives on the tip of the bucket
    u0, u1 = 0.30, 0.86
    per = (u1 - u0) / n
    if u < u0:
        k, ph, done = 0, 0.0, 0.0
    elif u >= u1:
        k, ph, done = n - 1, 1.0, float(n)
    else:
        q = (u - u0) / per
        k, ph = int(q), q - int(q)
        done = k + ease(clamp((ph - 0.45) / 0.25))
    level = frac0 + (1 - frac0) * done / n

    # the bioreactor: legs, body, dome, hatch
    tl, tr, ty0, ty1 = 280, 800, 800, 1390
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 76, 86)))
    for lx in (310, 520, 750):
        cr.rectangle(lx, ty1, 26, 60)
    cr.fill()
    body = cairo.LinearGradient(tl, 0, tr, 0)
    body.add_color_stop_rgb(0.0, 110 / 255, 118 / 255, 130 / 255)
    body.add_color_stop_rgb(0.5, 178 / 255, 186 / 255, 198 / 255)
    body.add_color_stop_rgb(1.0, 120 / 255, 128 / 255, 140 / 255)
    cr.set_source(body)
    cr.rectangle(tl, ty0, tr - tl, ty1 - ty0)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 208, 218), 0.5))
    cr.rectangle(tl + 30, ty0, 22, ty1 - ty0)
    cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(tl, ty0)
    cr.curve_to(tl, 690, tr, 690, tr, ty0)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 158, 170)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 96, 108)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for yy in (ty0, ty0 + 200, ty0 + 400, ty1):  # weld seams
        cr.move_to(tl, yy)
        cr.line_to(tr, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(715, 712, 54, 34)                # feed hatch
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((80, 86, 96)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 128, 140)))      # side pipe + valve wheel
    cr.rectangle(tr, 1250, 70, 22)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.arc(tr + 80, 1261, 26, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()

    # the window and the meat inside
    wx0, wx1, wy0, wy1 = 360, 720, 830, 1360
    _rr(cr, wx0, wy0, wx1, wy1, 60)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 46, 56)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    _rr(cr, wx0, wy0, wx1, wy1, 60)
    cr.clip()
    surf = wy1 - (wy1 - wy0) * level
    wob = 6 * math.sin(t * 1.6) * (1 if 0 < ph < 1 else 0.3)
    cr.move_to(wx0, surf + wob)
    cr.curve_to(500, surf - 10 - wob, 600, surf + 10 + wob, wx1, surf - wob)
    cr.line_to(wx1, wy1)
    cr.line_to(wx0, wy1)
    cr.close_path()
    meat = cairo.LinearGradient(0, surf, 0, wy1)
    meat.add_color_stop_rgb(0, 222 / 255, 110 / 255, 118 / 255)
    meat.add_color_stop_rgb(1, 168 / 255, 58 / 255, 70 / 255)
    cr.set_source(meat)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_line_width(5)                          # marbling in the meat
    for i in range(9):
        my = wy1 - 30 - i * 52
        if my < surf + 18:
            break
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 196, 192), 0.55))
        cr.move_to(wx0 + 20, my)
        cr.curve_to(470, my - 18, 590, my + 18, wx1 - 20, my - 6)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((210, 220, 232), 0.35))  # glass glint
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(wx0 + 40, wy0 + 80)
    cr.line_to(wx0 + 40, wy0 + 260)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 66, 76)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    _rr(cr, wx0, wy0, wx1, wy1, 60)
    cr.stroke()

    # today's plant: the first share, marked on the glass
    ly = wy1 - (wy1 - wy0) * frac0
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.set_dash([18, 12])
    cr.move_to(wx0 - 40, ly)
    cr.line_to(wx1 + 10, ly)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])
    text(cr, "today", wx0 - 50, ly + 12, 34, P["accent2"], anchor="right")

    # ladder and platform
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 120, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for lx in (840, 900):
        cr.move_to(lx, 790)
        cr.line_to(lx, 1480)
    for r_ in range(13):
        cr.move_to(840, 820 + r_ * 52)
        cr.line_to(900, 820 + r_ * 52)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 116, 126)))
    cr.rectangle(800, 790, 180, 14)
    cr.fill()

    # the pour stream, while the bucket is tipped
    if u0 <= u < u1 and 0.42 < ph < 0.78:
        sa = clamp(min(ph - 0.42, 0.78 - ph) / 0.06)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 96, 106), sa))
        cr.set_line_width(22)
        cr.move_to(835, 640)
        cr.curve_to(790, 650, 750, 680, 742, 728)
        cr.stroke()

    # Data's bit: points up at the tank, climbs, pours, cheers
    if u < 0.1:
        host("point", 960 - 90 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), 1480, 210)
    elif u < u0:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.1, u0))
        host("climb", 870, 1480 - 690 * c, 210)
    elif u < u1:
        host("pour", 890, 790, 210, beat=k)
    else:
        host("cheer", 890, 790, 210)

    # readouts
    full = u >= u1 - per * 0.3
    val, lab = (big, lb) if full else (small, ls)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(val)):,} lb/yr", lab.lower(), 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=110, max_w=620)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.94))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}× more meat", "same tank, next plant",

                    size=64, max_w=520)

def drumstick(cr, x, y, s, ang, a=1.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 226, 204), a))          # the bone
    cr.set_line_width(11 * s)
    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.line_to(40 * s, 0)
    cr.stroke()
    for oy in (-6 * s, 6 * s):                            # the knuckle
        cr.arc(42 * s, oy, 7 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    cr.save()                                             # the meat: a teardrop
    cr.translate(-16 * s, 0)
    cr.move_to(14 * s, -9 * s)
    cr.curve_to(-6 * s, -34 * s, -46 * s, -22 * s, -44 * s, 0)
    cr.curve_to(-46 * s, 22 * s, -6 * s, 34 * s, 14 * s, 9 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((188, 108, 44), a))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((118, 60, 22), a))
    cr.set_line_width(3 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 166, 84), 0.8 * a))      # the crispy highlight
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(-20 * s, -9 * s)
    cr.scale(16 * s, 7 * s)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    cr.restore()


def dish(cr, x, y, s=1.0, a=1.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(s, s * 0.42)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 30, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 236, 246), 0.55 * a))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 252, 255), a))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 128, 140), a))           # the cultivated morsel
    cr.arc(x, y - 4 * s, 7 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a mountain of chicken drumsticks
    SUBSTANCE: fried chicken drumsticks
    CAUSE: Data pours buckets of drumsticks onto the heap, then places one pink cultivated morsel on its peak
    The traditional industry's year is a mountain of drumsticks, already
    huge, and every bucket Data tips onto it piles it higher; the upgraded
    cultivated plant's whole year is one pink morsel in a dish he sets on
    the summit — a speck beside the mountain."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])
    lb, big = rows[0]
    ls, small = rows[-1]
    ratio = big / (small or 1.0)
    pct = small / (big or 1.0) * 100

    # the plant floor: a warm warehouse wall, then concrete
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (58, 46, 40)), (0.55, (120, 84, 58)), (1.0, (196, 140, 86))],
          0, 1300)
    glow(cr, 540, 900, 620, (255, 196, 120), 0.35)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (110, 96, 84)), (1.0, (64, 56, 50))], 1300, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 34, 30), 0.5))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1296, W, 8)
    cr.fill()

    # Data's path: setup on the floor, climb the slope, pour three
    # buckets, climb to the summit, place the morsel, react
    pours = [(0.20, 0.36), (0.36, 0.52), (0.52, 0.66)]
    up1 = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.20))
    up2 = ease(seg(u, 0.66, 0.72))
    hx = 90 + 160 * up1 + 150 * up2
    fy = 1500 - 210 * up1 - 190 * up2
    sx, sy = 250 + 100, 1290 - 170          # the bucket's lip while pouring

    # the mountain: the bottom rows are there from the first frame; each
    # bucket Data tips adds the next rows, tumbling from the lip
    counts = [15, 13, 12, 10, 8, 7, 5, 3, 2]
    adds = {5: 0, 6: 1, 7: 2, 8: 2}          # row -> which pour brings it
    groups = {0: [], 1: [], 2: []}
    for r_, k in adds.items():
        groups[k] += [(r_, c) for c in range(counts[r_])]
    idx = 0
    for r_, cnt in enumerate(counts):
        y = 1470 - r_ * 62
        for c in range(cnt):
            x = 540 - (cnt - 1) * 32 + c * 64 + (14 if r_ % 2 else 0)
            ang = ((idx * 137) % 360) * math.pi / 180 * 0.6 - 0.9
            idx += 1
            if r_ not in adds:
                drumstick(cr, x, y, 1.0, ang)
                continue
            k = adds[r_]
            g = groups[k]
            j = g.index((r_, c))
            a, b = pours[k]
            s0 = a + (b - a) * (0.35 + 0.45 * j / max(1, len(g)))
            p = seg(u, s0, s0 + 0.05)
            if p <= 0:
                continue                      # still in the bucket
            px = sx + (x - sx) * p
            py = sy + (y - sy) * p * p - 90 * 4 * p * (1 - p)
            drumstick(cr, px, py, 1.0, ang + 2.4 * (1 - p))
    fresh = ease(seg(u, 0.3, 0.45))
    for k, stx in enumerate((330, 540, 760)):
        steam(cr, stx, 1180 - 60 * (k == 1), t + k, strength=0.6 * fresh)

    if u < 0.08:
        role, bt = "point", 0
    elif u < 0.20:
        role, bt = "climb", 0
    elif u < 0.66:
        role = "pour"
        bt = 1 + sum(1 for a, _ in pours if u >= a) - 1
    elif u < 0.72:
        role, bt = "climb", 4
    elif u < 0.86:
        role, bt = "place", 5
    else:
        role, bt = "shock", 5
    host(role, hx, fy, 210, beat=bt)

    # the cultivated plant's year: one morsel in a dish, set on the peak
    if u >= 0.72:
        drop = ease(seg(u, 0.75, 0.83))
        hand = (hx + 60, fy - 150)
        peak = (580, 950)
        dx = hand[0] + (peak[0] - hand[0]) * drop
        dy = hand[1] + (peak[1] - hand[1]) * drop
        dish(cr, dx, dy, 0.9)
        ring = ease(seg(u, 0.83, 0.9))
        if ring > 0:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], ring))
            cr.set_line_width(5)
            cr.arc(dx, dy - 4, 34 + 6 * math.sin(t * 3), 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.stroke()
            text(cr, f"{small:,.0f} lb", dx + 50, dy - 40, 44, P["accent2"],
                 alpha=ring)

    # readouts
    a1 = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)) * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.80, 0.85)))
    if a1 > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{big / 1e9:,.0f} billion lb", f"{lb} · every year",
                    80, 520, a=a1, size=130)
    a2 = ease(seg(u, 0.85, 0.92))
    if a2 > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{pct:.4f}%", f"1 lb for every {ratio:,.0f} lb of chicken",
                    80, 520, a=a2, rgb=P["accent2"], size=130)

def _ledger_x(y, side):
    """Page edge of the open register at height y (it lies flat, seen from above)."""
    f = (y - 760.0) / 710.0
    return (170 - 100 * f) if side < 0 else (910 + 100 * f)


def _seal(cr, x, y, r, col, a=1.0):
    """A round approval seal: inked disc, double rim, a tick, APPROVED."""
    if a <= 0 or r <= 1:
        return
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, 0.82 * a))
    cr.arc(x, y, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 248, 236), 0.9 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(1.0, r * 0.07))
    cr.arc(x, y, r * 0.84, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, r * 0.13))
    cr.move_to(x - r * 0.38, y - r * 0.12)
    cr.line_to(x - r * 0.08, y + r * 0.2)
    cr.line_to(x + r * 0.42, y - r * 0.36)
    cr.stroke()
    text(cr, "APPROVED", x, y + r * 0.58, max(8, int(r * 0.24)), (250, 248, 236),
         anchor="center", alpha=a, shadow=False)


def _when(label, fallback):
    """A sort key that does not depend on the order the rows arrived in:
    a year sorts as that year, 'today'/'now' sorts after every year."""
    s = str(label).strip().lower()
    head = s[:4]
    if len(head) == 4 and head.isdigit():
        return (int(head), s)
    for w in ("today", "now", "current", "latest", "present"):
        if w in s:
            return (100000, s)
    return (fallback, s)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: an open approval register book
    SUBSTANCE: green approval stamps
    CAUSE: Data stamps each pending entry in the register with a green approval seal
    The US regulator's register of cultivated-meat approvals, lying open on
    a desk under a lamp. The 2023 entries already carry their green seals;
    the rest of the entries are written in but un-sealed, a dashed ring
    where the seal goes. Data walks down the page and stamps each one in
    turn, the seal landing on the strike, until the register holds today's
    count, then he cheers."""
    raw = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    keyed = [(_when(l, 50000 + i), l, v) for i, (l, v) in enumerate(raw)]
    rows = [(l, v) for _, l, v in sorted(keyed, key=lambda r: (r[0], r[2]))]
    l0, v0 = rows[0][0], rows[0][1]
    l1, v1 = rows[-1][0], rows[-1][1]
    n0 = max(0, int(round(v0)))
    n1 = max(n0, int(round(v1)))
    total = max(1, min(n1, 8))
    old = min(n0, total)
    new = total - old
    dur = t / u if u > 0.02 else 7.0
    lag = clamp(0.42 / max(dur, 1.0), 0.02, 0.12)

    # the office: wall, lamp light, desk
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (24, 30, 48)), (0.6, (38, 46, 70)), (1.0, (56, 52, 60))], 0, 1180)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (92, 58, 36)), (0.5, (70, 42, 26)), (1.0, (44, 26, 16))], 1160, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 80, 50)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1160, W, 14)
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 540, 1050, 620, (255, 226, 160), 0.30)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 34, 44)))      # the lamp shade overhead
    cr.move_to(430, 0)
    cr.line_to(650, 0)
    cr.line_to(700, 120)
    cr.line_to(380, 120)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 540, 130, 90, (255, 236, 180), 0.8)

    # the register: leather cover, two cream pages, the spine
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 30, 34)))
    cr.move_to(150, 744)
    cr.line_to(930, 744)
    cr.line_to(1040, 1492)
    cr.line_to(40, 1492)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    for side in (-1, 1):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 236, 214) if side > 0 else (236, 226, 200)))
        cr.move_to(540, 760)
        cr.line_to(_ledger_x(760, side), 760)
        cr.line_to(_ledger_x(1470, side), 1470)
        cr.line_to(540, 1470)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 130, 100), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(540, 760)
    cr.line_to(540, 1470)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((130, 40, 40), 0.9))   # red ribbon marker
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(560, 760)
    cr.line_to(575, 1500)
    cr.stroke()

    # left page: ruled, written-up history
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for i in range(14):
        y = 800 + i * 48
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((160, 170, 190), 0.6))
        cr.move_to(_ledger_x(y, -1) + 20, y)
        cr.line_to(520, y)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 50, 80), 0.55))
        x = _ledger_x(y, -1) + 40
        cr.move_to(x, y - 10)
        for j in range(9):
            cr.line_to(x + j * 32 + 16, y - 10 - 8 * ((i + j) % 2))
        cr.stroke()

    # right page: one entry per company, seal ring at its left
    top, bot = 880, 1420
    gap = (bot - top) / max(1, total - 1) if total > 1 else 0
    slots = [(650 + 12 * k * (1 if total < 2 else 4.0 / (total - 1)), top + gap * k)
             for k in range(total)]
    strikes = [0.24 + (0.48 * i / max(1, new - 1) if new > 1 else 0.0) for i in range(new)]
    for k, (sx, sy) in enumerate(slots):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((160, 170, 190), 0.6))
        cr.set_line_width(2)
        cr.move_to(570, sy + 46)
        cr.line_to(_ledger_x(sy + 46, 1) - 20, sy + 46)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 50, 80), 0.6))   # the written application
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        x = sx + 70
        cr.move_to(x, sy + 10)
        for j in range(7):
            cr.line_to(x + j * 26 + 13, sy + 10 - 9 * ((k + j) % 2))
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 120, 130), 0.6))  # where the seal goes
        cr.set_dash([8, 8])
        cr.arc(sx, sy, 40, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])
        if k < old:
            _seal(cr, sx, sy, 44, (58, 128, 80))
        else:
            i = k - old
            lu = strikes[i] + lag
            p = seg(u, lu, lu + 0.06)
            if p > 0:
                glow(cr, sx, sy, 110, (120, 230, 140), 0.6 * (1 - seg(u, lu, lu + 0.2)))
                _seal(cr, sx, sy, 44 * pop(p), (40, 170, 90))

    # Data: points at the first pending entry, stamps each in turn, cheers
    landed_n = sum(1 for s in strikes if u >= s + lag)
    hit = sum(1 for s in strikes if u >= s)
    if new == 0:
        role, bk, at = ("point" if u < 0.5 else "cheer"), 0, max(0, total - 1)
        pos = (slots[at][0] + 130, slots[at][1] + 30)
    else:
        def spot(i):
            sx, sy = slots[old + i]
            return sx + 130, sy + 30
        pos = spot(0)
        for i in range(1, new):
            m = ease(seg(u, strikes[i - 1] + lag + 0.05, strikes[i] - 0.01))
            a, b = spot(i - 1), spot(i)
            if m > 0:
                pos = (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * m, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * m)
        if u < strikes[0]:
            pos = (pos[0] + 60 * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.1, strikes[0]))),
                   pos[1] - 150 * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.1, strikes[0]))))
        if u < 0.22:
            role, bk = "point", 0
        elif u < 0.88:
            role, bk = "stamp", max(0, hit - 1)
        else:
            role, bk = "cheer", 0
    host(role, pos[0], min(pos[1], 1500), 210, beat=bk)

    # readout: the earlier count, then the later one, then the difference
    done = landed_n >= new
    val, lab = (n1, l1) if done else (n0, l0)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val} approved", f"US cultivated-meat companies · {lab.lower()}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=140)
    b = ease(seg(u, (strikes[-1] + lag + 0.06) if new else 0.6, 0.86))
    if b > 0 and n1 > n0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"+{n1 - n0}", f"since {l0}", W - 80, 700, anchor="right",
                    a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=96)

def _ell(cr, x, y, rx, ry):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(max(rx, 0.1), max(ry, 0.1))
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()


def _rrect(cr, x, y, w, h, r):
    r = min(r, w / 2, h / 2)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + h - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + h - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


def _when(row):
    # a year sorts by its number; a word like "Today" is always the latest
    try:
        return (0, float(row[0]))
    except ValueError:
        return (1, 0.0)


def _layer(cr, kind, cx, yb, w, h, a=1.0):
    x0, x1, yt = cx - w / 2, cx + w / 2, yb - h
    if kind == "bread_bot":
        _rrect(cr, x0, yt, w, h, 24)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 132, 66), a))
        cr.fill()
        _rrect(cr, x0 + 10, yt + 4, w - 20, h * 0.42, 14)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 220, 168), a))
        cr.fill()
    elif kind == "lettuce":
        cr.move_to(x0 - 26, yt + 10)
        n = 14
        for i in range(n + 1):
            x = x0 - 26 + (w + 52) * i / n
            cr.line_to(x, yt + 6 * math.sin(i * 1.7))
        for i in range(n, -1, -1):
            x = x0 - 26 + (w + 52) * i / n
            cr.line_to(x, yb + (16 if i % 2 else 2))
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((112, 184, 70), a))
        cr.fill_preserve()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 120, 40), a))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.stroke()
    elif kind == "tomato":
        for i in range(5):
            tx = x0 + 40 + (w - 80) * i / 4
            _ell(cr, tx, yb - h / 2, w / 9 + 8, h / 2)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((206, 52, 42), a))
            cr.fill()
            _ell(cr, tx, yb - h / 2, w / 9 - 6, h / 2 - 9)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 104, 84), a))
            cr.fill()
            for s in (-1, 1):
                _ell(cr, tx + s * 14, yb - h / 2, 5, 3)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 214, 150), a))
                cr.fill()
    elif kind == "cheese":
        cr.move_to(x0 - 14, yt)
        cr.line_to(x1 + 14, yt)
        cr.line_to(x1 + 14, yb)
        cr.line_to(x1 - 30, yb)
        cr.line_to(x1 - 50, yb + 34)
        cr.line_to(x1 - 70, yb)
        cr.line_to(x0 + 90, yb)
        cr.line_to(x0 + 66, yb + 40)
        cr.line_to(x0 + 42, yb)
        cr.line_to(x0 - 14, yb)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((248, 196, 56), a))
        cr.fill()
    elif kind == "ham":
        cr.move_to(x0 - 10, yt + 8)
        n = 10
        for i in range(n + 1):
            cr.line_to(x0 - 10 + (w + 20) * i / n, yt + 8 * math.sin(i * 1.3))
        for i in range(n, -1, -1):
            cr.line_to(x0 - 10 + (w + 20) * i / n, yb + 6 * math.sin(i * 1.1 + 1))
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((234, 146, 156), a))
        cr.fill_preserve()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((186, 88, 104), a))
        cr.set_line_width(4)

    elif kind == "bread_top":
        cr.move_to(x0, yb)

        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((198, 128, 58), a))
        cr.fill()
        cr.move_to(x0 + 70, yb - h * 0.55)
        cr.curve_to(cx - 80, yt + 26, cx + 40, yt + 22, cx + 120, yt + 34)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 176, 104), a))
        cr.set_line_width(14)
        cr.stroke()
        for i in range(11):
            sx = x0 + 70 + (w - 140) * ((i * 37) % 11) / 10
            sy = yb - h * (0.3 + 0.4 * ((i * 53) % 7) / 6)
            _ell(cr, sx, sy, 7, 4)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((252, 238, 204), a))

def _dish(cr, x, y, s, new):
    if s <= 0:
        return
    _ell(cr, x, y, 28 * s, 13 * s)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["glass"], 0.9))

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a towering deli sandwich
    SUBSTANCE: bread, lettuce, tomato, ham
    CAUSE: Data places each layer on the stack by hand, then takes a bite
    The closing: the US now has approved lab-meat makers, their petri
    dishes lined up on a tray with green seals, the earlier year's count
    first and the rest arriving now. Data looks them over, shoves the tray
    aside along the counter, climbs a stepladder and builds a sandwich
    layer by layer, then a bite comes out of it. He would still rather
    have a sandwich."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=_when)
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    n0, n1 = int(round(v0)), int(round(v1))

    # the deli the story ends in
    vgrad(cr, P["cafe_wall"], 0, H)
    glow(cr, 600, 760, 520, P["sun_glow"], 0.35)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["counter_top"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1228, W, 96)
    cr.fill()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, P["counter"]), (1.0, (40, 24, 20))], 1324, H)

    # the plate
    cx, w, plate = 600, 640, 1242
    _ell(cr, cx, plate + 6, 360, 36)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 236, 230)))
    cr.fill()
    _ell(cr, cx, plate, 300, 22)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 250, 246)))
    cr.fill()

    # the stepladder at the sandwich's right
    lx0, lx1 = 922, 1018
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 154, 162)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for lx in (lx0, lx1):
        cr.move_to(lx, 1300)
        cr.line_to(lx + (12 if lx == lx0 else -12), 900)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for k in range(7):
        ry = 1290 - k * 62
        cr.move_to(lx0 + k * 1.8, ry)
        cr.line_to(lx1 - k * 1.8, ry)
        cr.stroke()

    layers = [("bread_bot", 84), ("lettuce", 36), ("tomato", 50), ("cheese", 30),
              ("ham", 58), ("lettuce", 36), ("bread_top", 120)]
    s0, step = 0.36, 0.085
    lands = [0.0] + [s0 + (i - 1) * step + 0.05 for i in range(1, len(layers))]
    bases = []
    y = plate
    for _, h in layers:
        bases.append(y)
        y -= h
    top_cont = plate - layers[0][1] - sum(
        layers[i][1] * ease(seg(u, lands[i], lands[i] + 0.04))
        for i in range(1, len(layers)))

    # Data: think at the tray, shove it aside, walk to the ladder, build, bite
    pace, k = False, 0
    if u < 0.10:
        role, dx, fy = "think", 600, 1312
    elif u < 0.22:
        p = ease(seg(u, 0.10, 0.22))
        role, dx, fy = "shove", 600 - 180 * p, 1312
    elif u < s0:
        p = ease(seg(u, 0.22, s0))
        role, dx, fy, pace = "point", 420 + 548 * p, 1312 - 50 * p, True
    elif u < 0.90:
        k = 1 + max(0, min(len(layers) - 2, int((u - s0) / step)))
        role, dx, fy = "place", 968, min(1262, top_cont + 150)
    else:
        role, dx, fy = "hold_up", 968, min(1262, top_cont + 150)
    fy = min(fy, 1500)
    trayx = (600 - 40 if u < 0.10 else dx - 40) if u < 0.22 else 380

    # the tray of approved lab meats, pushed aside
    tx1 = min(trayx, 560)
    _rrect(cr, tx1 - 300, 1296, 300, 34, 14)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.fill()
    for i in range(n1):
        new = i >= n0
        s = 1.0 if not new else pop(seg(u, 0.01 + 0.03 * (i - n0), 0.06 + 0.03 * (i - n0)))
        _dish(cr, tx1 - 270 + i * (240 / max(1, n1 - 1)), 1302, s, new)

    # the sandwich, drawn into a group so the bite can come out of it
    cr.push_group()
    for i, (kind, h) in enumerate(layers):
        if i == 0:
            _layer(cr, kind, cx, bases[0], w, h)
            continue
        st = s0 + (i - 1) * step
        if u < st:
            continue
        p = seg(u, st + 0.015, lands[i])
        hx, hy = dx - 50, fy - 150
        px = hx + (cx - hx) * ease(p)
        py = hy + (bases[i] - hy) * p * p - 90 * math.sin(math.pi * p)
        if p >= 1:
            sq = 1.0 + 0.06 * (1 - ease(seg(u, lands[i], lands[i] + 0.02)))
            _layer(cr, kind, cx, bases[i], w * sq, h)
        else:
            sc = 0.55 + 0.45 * ease(p)
            _layer(cr, kind, px, py, w * sc, h * sc)
    bite = ease(seg(u, 0.92, 0.95))
    if bite > 0:
        cr.set_operator(cairo.OPERATOR_CLEAR)
        bx, by = cx + w / 2 - 10, bases[-1] - 70
        for j in range(3):
            cr.arc(bx + 6 * j, by + 46 * j - 46, 44 * bite, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
        cr.set_operator(cairo.OPERATOR_OVER)
    cr.pop_group_to_source()
    cr.paint()

    host(role, dx, fy, 220, pace=pace, beat=k)

    fit_readout(cr, f"{n1} approved", f"US lab-meat makers · {l1.lower()}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=120)
    text(cr, f"{n0} in {l0}", 80, 700, 52, look.INK, face="display",
         alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.12)))

def _rock(cr, x, y, r, seed, rgb=(156, 74, 44)):
    # an angular Martian boulder: a flat-bottomed, faceted outline, lit
    n = 9
    for i in range(n):
        ang = math.pi + i * math.pi / (n - 1)
        rr = r * (0.74 + 0.26 * ((seed * 7.31 + i * 0.6180339) % 1.0))
        px = x + 1.35 * rr * math.cos(ang)
        py = y + 0.85 * rr * math.sin(ang)
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(px, py)
        else:
            cr.line_to(px, py)
    cr.line_to(x + 1.2 * r, y + 0.12 * r)
    cr.line_to(x - 1.2 * r, y + 0.12 * r)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb)


def _blade(cr, x0, x1, y, s, a=1.0):
    # one rotor blade seen edge-on: wide chord near the root, tapering to the tip
    d = 1.0 if x1 >= x0 else -1.0
    L = abs(x1 - x0)
    if L < 6:
        return
    cr.move_to(x0, y - 6 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x0 + d * L * 0.3, y - 13 * s, x0 + d * L * 0.7, y - 9 * s, x1, y - 3 * s)
    cr.line_to(x1, y + 3 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x0 + d * L * 0.7, y + 6 * s, x0 + d * L * 0.3, y + 8 * s, x0, y + 6 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (58, 58, 66), finish="metal", a=a)


def _ingenuity(cr, cx, by, t, snap, s=1.3, a=1.0):
    # Ingenuity: four bowed carbon legs, a gold-foil fuselage with its camera,
    # a tall mast, two counter-rotating paddle rotors, the solar panel on top
    for dx in (-118, -42, 42, 118):
        fx = cx + dx * s
        cr.move_to(cx + dx * 0.38 * s, by - 66 * s)
        cr.curve_to(cx + dx * 0.75 * s, by - 52 * s, fx, by - 30 * s, fx, by - 6 * s)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 34, 40), a))
        cr.set_line_width(11 * s)
        cr.stroke_preserve()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((172, 172, 180), a))
        cr.set_line_width(6 * s)
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, fx, by - 6 * s, 10 * s, (120, 120, 128), finish="metal", a=a)
    # the fuselage, wrapped in crinkled gold foil
    bw, bh = 150 * s, 100 * s
    box(cr, cx - bw / 2, by - 56 * s, bw, bh, (214, 170, 84), depth=40 * s,
        finish="metal", a=a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 108, 40), 0.55 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(2.5 * s)
    for i in range(6):
        y0 = by - 56 * s - bh * (0.12 + 0.15 * i)
        cr.move_to(cx - bw / 2 + 6, y0)
        for j in range(1, 7):
            cr.line_to(cx - bw / 2 + 6 + j * (bw - 12) / 6,
                       y0 + (5 if (i + j) % 2 else -5) * s)
        cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, cx - bw * 0.22, by - 56 * s - bh * 0.38, 13 * s, (30, 34, 44), finish="glass", a=a)
    # the mast
    cylinder(cr, cx - 10 * s, by - 150 * s, 20 * s, 100 * s, (70, 70, 78), finish="metal", a=a)
    cylinder(cr, cx - 6 * s, by - 265 * s, 12 * s, 120 * s, (52, 52, 60), finish="metal", a=a)
    L = 245.0 * s
    A = t * 2 * math.pi * 0.55
    for ry, ang, upper in ((by - 195 * s, -A, False), (by - 248 * s, A, True)):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx, ry)
        cr.scale(1, 0.08)
        cr.arc(0, 0, L, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46), 0.14 * a))
        cr.fill()
        for k_ in (0.0, math.pi):
            c = math.cos(ang + k_)
            reach = L * (0.45 if (snap and upper and k_ == 0.0) else 1.0)
            _blade(cr, cx, cx + reach * c, ry, s, a)
        disc(cr, cx, ry, 15 * s, (96, 96, 104), finish="metal", a=a)
    box(cr, cx - 62 * s, by - 268 * s, 124 * s, 14 * s, (40, 58, 120), depth=26 * s,
        finish="glass", a=a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 170, 220), 0.6 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for j in range(1, 6):
        gx = cx - 62 * s + j * 124 * s / 6
        cr.move_to(gx, by - 282 * s)
        cr.line_to(gx, by - 268 * s)
        cr.stroke()
    return by - 285 * s


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: Mars helicopter on a rock tower
    SUBSTANCE: stacked red rock slabs
    CAUSE: Data places slab after slab under the helicopter and it climbs with every block
    Ingenuity's flight count is the height of the tower of red Martian rock
    slabs it stands on: Data stacks the slabs and the little helicopter rides
    the tower up, first flight to the 50th to the final one, where a rotor
    blade snaps and falls to the sand. The labels carry no year, so the rows
    are ordered by the count itself (a running flight tally only ever climbs)
    — never by list order. The flight before the last stays on the tower as
    a ghost of its top, so the last climb reads against it at a glance."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: (r[1], r[0]))
    n = len(rows)
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.54
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    slide = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.8))
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
    val = 0.0 if u < a0 else prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * slide
    landed_to = k if slide >= 0.999 else k - 1
    shown = rows[landed_to] if (u >= a0 and landed_to >= 0) else None
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and slide >= 0.999

    BASE, PAD, SH = 1440, 60, 46
    PX = 340.0 / top
    X0, X1 = 200, 840
    top_y = lambda v: BASE - PAD - PX * v
    ty = top_y(val)

    # Mars: a rust sky, a small pale sun, crater rims fading into the dust
    landscape(cr, t, "desert")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 92, 50), 0.38))
    cr.paint()
    glow(cr, 250, 760, 160, (250, 222, 190), 0.5)
    disc(cr, 250, 760, 34, (252, 236, 214), finish="gloss")
    ridge(cr, 1150, 120, seed=4.1, n=4)
    solid(cr, (186, 104, 70), edge=False)
    haze(cr, 880, 1220, (230, 168, 128), a=0.55)
    ridge(cr, 1230, 80, seed=1.3)
    solid(cr, (166, 82, 50), edge=False)
    haze(cr, 1080, 1300, (226, 156, 116), a=0.3)
    for i, (rx, ry, rr) in enumerate(((60, 1300, 26), (960, 1290, 22), (1030, 1330, 30))):
        contact_shadow(cr, rx, ry + 4, rr * 2.6, a=0.3)
        _rock(cr, rx, ry, rr, i + 3, (150, 72, 44))

    # spare slabs waiting on the sand behind Data
    for j in range(3):
        contact_shadow(cr, 960, 1462 - j * 30, 190, a=0.3)
        box(cr, 868 + 8 * (j % 2), 1462 - j * 30, 170, 30, (170, 78, 46), depth=30)

    # the tower: red rock slabs stacked one on another
    h_tot = BASE - ty
    full = int(h_tot // SH)
    rem = h_tot - full * SH
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1, BASE, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2, BASE + 4, X1 - X0 + 60, a=0.45)
    for i in range(full + 1):
        hh = SH if i < full else rem
        if hh < 1:
            continue
        jx = (((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) - 0.5) * 36
        wv = ((i * 0.4142136) % 1.0) * 36
        sh_ = int(((i * 37) % 23) - 11)
        col = (178 + sh_, 82 + sh_ // 2, 48 + sh_ // 3)
        box(cr, X0 + jx + wv / 2, BASE - i * SH, (X1 - X0) - wv, hh, col, depth=40)
        if hh > 20:                               # a chip in the slab's face
            cx_ = X0 + 80 + ((i * 211) % 440)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((112, 46, 26), 0.55))
            cr.set_line_width(3)
            cr.move_to(cx_, BASE - i * SH - hh * 0.25)
            cr.line_to(cx_ + 18, BASE - i * SH - hh * 0.55)
            cr.line_to(cx_ + 8, BASE - i * SH - hh * 0.8)
            cr.stroke()

    # THE SCALE on the tower: where the flight before the last left it
    if n >= 2 and landed_to >= n - 2 and u >= a0:
        pl, pv = rows[n - 2]
        y_prev = top_y(pv)
        cr.rectangle(X0, y_prev, X1 - X0, BASE - y_prev)
        ghost(cr, a=0.85)
        then_mark(cr, X0 - 30, X1 - 30, y_prev, pl)

    S = 1.3
    hx = 470
    _ingenuity(cr, hx, ty - 14, t, done, s=S)

    # the snapped blade tip whirls down and lands on the sand by the tower
    if done:
        fl = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.06))
        sx, sy = hx + 0.72 * 245 * S, ty - 14 - 248 * S
        ex, ey = 120, 1500
        bx = sx + (ex - sx) * fl
        bly = sy + (ey - sy) * fl * fl - 120 * math.sin(math.pi * fl)
        if fl >= 1:
            contact_shadow(cr, ex, ey + 10, 170, a=0.4)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(bx, bly)
        cr.rotate(5.0 * fl + 0.15)
        _blade(cr, -75, 75, 0, 1.5)
        cr.restore()

    # right by the camera: Martian boulders in the sand
    for i, (rx, ry, rr) in enumerate(((120, 1720, 70), (930, 1790, 90), (560, 1870, 46))):
        contact_shadow(cr, rx, ry + 10, rr * 3.0, a=0.4)
        _rock(cr, rx, ry, rr, i + 1)
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points from the ground, steps onto the tower, stacks it as it rises
    if u < a0:
        m = ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
        host("point", 960 - 190 * m, BASE, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("place", 770, ty - 14, 220, beat=k * 4 + int(clamp(f, 0, 0.999) * 4))
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", 770, ty - 14, 220)
    else:
        host("shock", 770, ty - 14, 220)

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        unit = "flight" if int(round(v)) == 1 else "flights"
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))} {unit}", f"Ingenuity on Mars · {lab.lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Ingenuity", "NASA's Mars helicopter", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a towering heap of collection letters
    SUBSTANCE: paper bills and envelopes
    CAUSE: Data stamps the medical letters with a red cross, column by column across the heap
    One whole, split: the heap is every collection on US credit reports.
    Data climbs along its face stamping a red medical cross on each column
    of letters; the stamped part stops at the true area share (58%), the
    rest stays plain paper. Lands by 0.56 and holds; after it, loose letters
    keep sliding off the plain side and Data keeps stamping at the cut."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    med = next((r for r in rows if "medical" in r[0].lower()), max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    share = med[1] / tot
    rest = 1.0 - share

    CX, BASE, HH, HW = 560, 1440, 640.0, 440.0
    xL, xR = CX - HW, CX + HW
    # the x where the heap's AREA reaches the share
    N = 240
    dens = []
    for i in range(N):
        x = xL + (xR - xL) * (i + 0.5) / N
        dens.append(max(0.0, BASE - heap_top(CX, BASE, HH, HW, x)))
    area = sum(dens) or 1.0
    acc, xs = 0.0, xR
    for i, d in enumerate(dens):
        acc += d
        if acc / area >= share:
            xs = xL + (xR - xL) * (i + 1) / N
            break

    n = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    strike = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.5))
    if u < a0:
        prog = 0.0
    else:
        prog = (k + strike) / n
    split = xL + (xs - xL) * prog
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and strike >= 0.999

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    # a street of offices behind, fading into the haze
    building(cr, -40, 200, 1190, 300, (150, 140, 128), roof="flat", boards=False)
    building(cr, 880, 1120, 1190, 360, (138, 128, 120), roof="flat", boards=False)
    haze(cr, 700, 1190, (236, 214, 190), a=0.45)
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    cast_shadow(cr, xL, xR, BASE, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2 * HW + 60, a=0.4)
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, HH, HW)
    solid(cr, (196, 190, 178))
    cr.save()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, HH, HW)
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(150):
        dx = ((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) * 1.9 - 0.95
        py = (i * 0.4142136) % 1.0
        px = CX + HW * dx
        top_y = heap_top(CX, BASE, HH, HW, px)
        y_ = BASE - (BASE - top_y) * py * 0.97 - 4
        _envelope(cr, px, y_, (i * 1.3) % 1.2 - 0.6, 1.2 + 0.4 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0),
                  px < split)
    cr.restore()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, HH, HW)
    edge(cr, (40, 36, 32))

    # THE SCALE in the heap: the cut between the two parts of the one whole
    if done:
        ty = heap_top(CX, BASE, HH, HW, xs)
        cr.save()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.9))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.set_dash([18, 12])
        cr.move_to(xs, BASE)
        cr.line_to(xs, ty - 30)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()

    # after it lands, loose letters keep sliding off the plain side
    if u > a1:
        for j in range(3):
            ph = ((u - a1) / 0.18 + j / 3) % 1.0
            bx = xs + 40 + (xR - xs - 20) * ph
            by = heap_top(CX, BASE, HH, HW, bx) - 12
            _envelope(cr, bx, by, ph * 5 + j, 1.6, False)

    # right by the camera: letters blown into the street
    for i in range(5):
        _envelope(cr, 120 + i * 210, 1650 + (i % 2) * 70 + i * 12, i * 0.7 - 1.0,
                  2.4 + 0.4 * (i % 2), i % 3 != 2)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data works ON the heap: he climbs its face column by column, the stamp
    # landing on the letters at his feet
    def col(i):
        return xL + 60 + (xs - xL - 90) * (i + 0.5) / n

    def foot(x):
        return clamp(heap_top(CX, BASE, HH, HW, x) + 150, 940, 1500)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", xL - 40, 1500, 230)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        x_prev = col(k - 1) if k > 0 else xL - 40
        y_prev = foot(x_prev) if k > 0 else 1500
        m = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.25))
        hx = x_prev + (col(k) - x_prev) * m
        hy = y_prev + (foot(col(k)) - y_prev) * m
        host("stamp", hx, hy, 230, beat=k)
    else:
        hx = col(n - 1)
        host("stamp", hx, foot(hx), 230, beat=n + int((u - a1) / 0.1))

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%", "of credit-report collections were medical",
                    80, 520, size=160)
        a = ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.04, a1 + 0.02))
        text(cr, f"{int(round(rest * 100))}%", W - 80, 700, 90, look.INK,
             face="display", anchor="right", alpha=a)
        text(cr, "everything else", W - 80, 750, 36, look.INK, anchor="right", alpha=a)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Collections", "on US credit reports", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
